混乱する-
{
混乱する (こんらんする) - To be confused, to be in chaos
The suru-verb form of 混乱, used to describe the action of becoming or being in a state of disorder.
Memory Tip: Combine the concept of 'chaos' (混乱) with 'to do' (する) to express the process of getting muddled.
Example: 頭が混乱する。 (あたまがこんらんする。)
-My mind is confused.
}

活動-
{
活動 (かつどう) - Activity, action
A noun or suru-verb referring to energetic engagement, social activities, or physical movement.
Memory Tip: To have life/vigor (活) and to move (動) is to be in a state of activity.
Example: 彼は活動的な人だ。 (かれはかつどうてきなひとだ。)
-He is an active person.
}

文章-
{
文章 (ぶんしょう) - Sentence / Composition
Refers to written text, a prose piece, or the formal structure of writing.
Memory Tip: 文 (writing) + 章 (chapter/badge) = the building blocks that make up a written chapter.
Example: 短い文章を書く。 (みじかいぶんしょうをかく。)
-Write a short sentence.
}

加わる-
{
加わる (くわわる) - To join / To be added
An intransitive verb meaning to join a group or for an intensity (like force or heat) to increase.
Memory Tip: Think of adding (加) power (力) to a mouth (口) to speak up and join the team.
Example: 新しいメンバーが加わった。 (あたらしいめんばーがくわわった。)
-A new member joined.
}

武士-
{
武士 (ぶし) - Warrior / Samurai
A formal term for a member of the military class in pre-modern Japan.
Memory Tip: 武 (military/martial) + 士 (gentleman/professional) = a professional martial man.
Example: 武士は刀を持っている。 (ぶしはかたなをもっている。)
-Samurai carry swords.
}

効果-
{
効果 (こうか) - effect, effectiveness, result
This noun refers to the efficacy or outcome of an action or medicine.
Memory Tip: Combining 'merit/efficacy' (効) with 'fruit/result' (果) equals the overall effect.
Example: この薬はすぐに効果が出ます。 (このくすりはすぐにこうかがでます。)
-This medicine takes effect immediately.
}

紺-
{
紺 (こん) - navy blue, deep blue
A noun identifying a dark blue color, common in Japanese uniforms and traditional clothing.
Memory Tip: The 'thread' (糸) radical suggests dyeing fabric a deep navy blue color.
Example: 彼は紺色のスーツを着ている。 (かれはこんいろのすーつをきている。)
-He is wearing a navy blue suit.
}

単に-
{
単に (たんに) - simply, merely, only
An adverb used to emphasize that something is just a particular thing and nothing more.
Memory Tip: 'Tan' means simple or single; adding 'ni' turns it into the adverb 'simply'.
Example: それは単に不注意でした。 (それはたんにふちゅういでした。)
-That was simply carelessness.
}

進める-
{
進める (すすめる) - to advance, to promote, to move forward
A transitive verb used for moving something forward physically or progressing a project.
Memory Tip: The 'road' radical (⻌) combined with 'bird' (隹) depicts a bird moving forward along a path.
Example: 計画を前に進める必要があります。 (けいかくをまえにすすめるひつようがあります。)
-We need to move the plan forward.
}

登場-
{
登場 (とうじょう) - Appearance (on stage), entry, introduction
This noun (often a suru-verb) combines 'climb' (登) and 'place' (場). It refers to a character appearing in a story or a person stepping onto a stage.
Memory Tip: You climb (登) onto the stage area (場) to make your grand appearance.
Example: 新しいキャラクターが登場した。 (あたらしいきゃらくたーがとうじょうした。)
-A new character appeared.
}

頂戴-
{
頂戴 (ちょうだい) - Receiving, please give me
A humble word for receiving or a polite yet informal way to ask for something. It uses the kanji for 'summit/top' (頂) and 'receive' (戴).
Memory Tip: Holding an item at the top (頂) of your head (戴) in a traditional gesture of humble receipt.
Example: そのお菓子を頂戴。 (そのおかしをちょうだい。)
-Please give me that candy.
}

開始-
{
開始 (かいし) - Start, commencement
A formal noun or suru-verb consisting of 'open' (開) and 'begin' (始). It is often used for events or processes.
Memory Tip: You open (開) the doors for the event to begin (始).
Example: 会議は十時に開始します。 (かいぎはじゅうじにかいしします。)
-The meeting will start at ten o'clock.
}

河-
{
河 (かわ) - River (large)
While 'kawa' is often written as 川, this kanji (河) usually refers to larger, more significant rivers.
Memory Tip: Water (氵) that makes it possible (可) for a civilization to thrive along its banks.
Example: 広い河が流れている。 (ひろいかわがながれている。)
-A wide river is flowing.
}

価値-
{
価値 (かち) - Value, worth
A noun combining 'price/value' (価) and 'price/cost' (値). It refers to both monetary and abstract worth.
Memory Tip: The price (価) meets the set value (値) to determine if something is worthwhile.
Example: この絵には価値がある。 (このえにはかちがある。)
-This painting has value.
}

単純-
{
単純 (たんじゅん) - Simple, straightforward
Formed by 単 (single) and 純 (purity), it refers to something lacking complexity or being uncomplicated.
Memory Tip: A single (単) pure (純) idea is simple.
Example: 彼は単純な人だ。 (かれはたんじゅんなひとだ。)
-He is a simple person.
}

足りる-
{
足りる (たりる) - To be sufficient, to be enough
An ichidan verb meaning to satisfy a requirement. It is related to the kanji for 'foot' (足), implying a standing base.
Memory Tip: If your legs (足) are strong, they are enough to support you.
Example: 時間が足りない。 (じかんがたりない。)
-There is not enough time.
}

冷静-
{
冷静 (れいせい) - Calm, composed, cool-headed
Composed of 冷 (cold/cool) and 静 (quiet/still), describing a state of emotional stability.
Memory Tip: A cool (冷) and quiet (静) mind keeps you calm.
Example: 冷静に判断する。 (れいせいにはんだんする。)
-To judge calmly.
}

裏切る-
{
裏切る (うらぎる) - To betray
A compound godan verb combining 'back' (裏) and 'cut' (切る).
Memory Tip: Imagine someone 'cutting' (切る) you from 'behind/the back' (裏). It is the literal visualization of betrayal.
Example: 彼は友人を裏切った。 (かれはゆうじんをうらぎった。)
-He betrayed his friend.
}

惜しい-
{
惜しい (おしい) - Regrettable/Close (almost)
An i-adjective used when something is a pity, a waste, or when one falls just short of a goal.
Memory Tip: Includes the radical for 'Heart' (忄) and 'Ancient' (昔). Think of an old feeling in your heart when you regret a missed chance.
Example: あと一点で合格だったので、惜しかった。 (あといってんでごうかくだったので、おしかった。)
-It was regrettable because I was only one point away from passing.
}

癖に-
{
癖に (くせに) - Despite, although, even though
A conjunctive particle used to express criticism, blame, or contempt regarding someone's behavior.
Memory Tip: Treat it as 'despite having the (bad) habit of...', which highlights the speaker's annoyance.
Example: 知らない癖に、知っているふりをする。 (しらないくせに、しっているふりをする。)
-Even though he doesn't know, he pretends he does.
}

好む-
{
好む (このむ) - To prefer, to like
A more formal or literary version of 'suki'. It implies a general preference or taste.
Memory Tip: Kanji is Woman (女) + Child (子). A mother naturally 'prefers' her own child over anything else.
Example: 彼は静かな場所を好む。 (かれはしずかなばしょをこのむ。)
-He prefers quiet places.
}

〜っぽい-
{
〜っぽい (〜っぽい) - -ish / -like
A suffix added to nouns or verb stems to describe a quality or tendency.
Memory Tip: Think of "popping" a trait onto something; "childish" is kodomo-ppoi.
Example: 忘れっぽい性格です。 (わすれっぽいせいかくです。)
-I have a forgetful nature.
}

取り戻す-
{
取り戻す (とりもどす) - To take back / To recover
A compound verb combining 'tori' (to take) and 'modosu' (to return). It is used for physical objects or abstract concepts like health or consciousness.
Memory Tip: First you take (取り) it, then you bring it back (戻す) to its original place.
Example: 奪われた財布を取り戻した。 (うばわれたさいふをとりもどした。)
-I got back the stolen wallet.
}

押さえる-
{
押さえる (おさえる) - To hold down / To suppress
This verb refers to applying pressure to prevent movement or to keep something (like feelings or prices) under control.
Memory Tip: Use your hand (the left radical) to push (押) down and secure something.
Example: 風で帽子を押さえた。 (かぜでぼうしをおさえた。)
-I held down my hat because of the wind.
}

丁寧-
{
丁寧 (ていねい) - Polite / Careful
A na-adjective used for social manners as well as doing a task with meticulous attention to detail.
Memory Tip: The characters originally referred to an ancient musical instrument used for signaling; signals must be clear and precise.
Example: 彼はいつも丁寧な言葉を使う。(かれはいつもていねいなことばをつかう。)
-He always uses polite language.
}

教育-
{
教育 (きょういく) - Education / Training
Combines 教 (to teach) and 育 (to bring up/nurture). It encompasses school schooling and general upbringing.
Memory Tip: You teach (教) a child so they can grow and be nurtured (育) into an adult.
Example: 彼は教育の仕事に就きたい。(かれはきょういくのしごとにつきたい。)
-He wants to get a job in education.
}

文学-
{
文学 (ぶんがく) - Literature
Combines 文 (sentence/writing) and 学 (study/learning), referring to the academic study of written works.
Memory Tip: It is the study (学) of the art of the sentence (文).
Example: 彼女はフランス文学を研究している。(かのじょはふらんすぶんがくをけんきゅうしている。)
-She is researching French literature.
}

脳-
{
脳 (のう) - Brain
A single kanji noun. The left radical is 月 (flesh/body), indicating it is a physical organ.
Memory Tip: The right side looks like a head full of complex hair or neurons inside a container.
Example: 脳の働きはとても複雑だ。(のうのはたらきはとてもふくざつだ。)
-The functions of the brain are very complex.
}

争う-
{
争う (あらそう) - To compete / to argue
A transitive godan verb describing a conflict, competition, or dispute between two or more parties.
Memory Tip: The kanji represents hands struggling over a central object to win it.
Example: 彼らは優勝を争った。(かれらはゆうしょうをあらそった。)
-They competed for the championship.
}

愛情-
{
愛情 (あいじょう) - Love / Affection
A noun describing the deep emotional feeling of love or care for a person, animal, or thing.
Memory Tip: This word is a direct combination of 'love' (愛) and 'feelings/emotion' (情).
Example: 母の愛情を感じる。(ははのあいじょうをかんじる。)
-I feel my mother's love.
}

〜にしては-
{
〜にしては (ni shite wa) - Considering that / For a...
Used to express that something is surprising or different from what one would expect based on a certain standard.
Memory Tip: Think of it as "ni" (at) + "shite" (doing) + "wa" (topic) — regarding the state of doing X, the result is unexpected.
Example: 彼は外国人にしては日本語が上手だ。 (かれはいこくじんにしてはにほんごがじょうずだ。)
-Considering he is a foreigner, his Japanese is good.
}

弁護士-
{
弁護士 (べんごし) - Lawyer
Combines 弁 (speech/pleading), 護 (protect), and 士 (professional/gentleman).
Memory Tip: A professional (士) who uses speech (弁) to protect (護) their client.
Example: 彼は弁護士になりたい。 (かれはべんごしになりたい。)
-He wants to become a lawyer.
}

合図-
{
合図 (あいず) - Signal / Cue
Combines 合 (fitting/meeting) and 図 (diagram/plan). A prearranged sign for coordination.
Memory Tip: When the plans (図) fit together (合), it is time for the signal.
Example: 彼は合図を送った。 (かれはあいずをおくった。)
-He sent a signal.
}

読者-
{
読者 (どくしゃ) - Reader
A compound noun combining 'read' (読) and 'person' (者) to describe an audience of a publication.
Memory Tip: The person (者) who reads (読) the words on the page.
Example: この雑誌は若い読者に人気がある。 (このざっしはわかいどくしゃににんきがある。)
-This magazine is popular among young readers.
}

証明-
{
証明 (しょうめい) - Proof, verification
A noun or Suru-verb used when providing evidence to clarify the truth of a matter.
Memory Tip: Using words (言) to make the truth clear (明) and correct (正).
Example: 警察に身分を証明した。 (けいさつにみぶんをしょうめいした。)
-I proved my identity to the police.
}

模様-
{
模様 (もよう) - Pattern, design, state
Refers to decorative patterns on surfaces or the developing appearance/condition of a situation.
Memory Tip: An imitation (模) of the appearance (様) of something results in a pattern.
Example: 彼女は水玉模様の服を着ている。 (かのじょはみずたまもようのふくをきている。)
-She is wearing clothes with a polka-dot pattern.
}

〜札-
{
〜札 (〜さつ) - Counter for banknotes/bills
A specific counter used when counting paper currency or bills.
Memory Tip: Wood (木) used to be the material for labels, but now we use it for paper bills (札).
Example: 千円札を二枚持っています。 (せんえんさつをにまいもっています。)
-I have two 1,000-yen bills.
}

札-
{
札 (ふだ) - Card, tag, label
Refers to physical tags, signs, or cards used in traditional Japanese games.
Memory Tip: A wooden (木) slip used to display (乚) a label or price.
Example: 玄関の札を見てください。 (げんかんのふだをみてください。)
-Please look at the tag on the front door.
}

溶ける-
{
溶ける (とける) - To melt/dissolve
An intransitive Ichidan verb used when a solid substance turns into a liquid due to heat or immersion.
Memory Tip: The water radical (氵) on the left side of the kanji indicates the final state of the object.
Example: 氷が太陽で溶ける。 (こおりがたいようでとける。)
-The ice melts in the sun.
}

自宅-
{
自宅 (じたく) - One's own home
Formed by 'self' (自) and 'house' (宅), this is a polite way to refer to one's own residence.
Memory Tip: Your 'self' (自) is naturally located at your 'house' (宅).
Example: 彼は自宅で仕事をしている。 (かれはじたくでしごとをしている。)
-He is working at his own home.
}

計算-
{
計算 (けいさん) - Calculation/Counting
A noun (often used with 'suru') that combines 'measure/plan' (計) and 'calculate' (算). It covers arithmetic and general counting.
Memory Tip: Using a 'gauge' (計) and an 'abacus' (the top of 算) to figure out the total.
Example: 彼は計算がとても速い。 (かれはけいさんがとてもはやい。)
-He is very fast at calculations.
}

試す-
{
試す (ためす) - To try out, to test
A Godan transitive verb used when putting something to the test to check its quality or ability.
Memory Tip: The kanji features 言 (words) and 式 (ceremony/formula) — testing if the words match the formula.
Example: 新しい靴を試す。 (あたらしいくつをためす。)
-To try out new shoes.
}

嵐-
{
嵐 (あらし) - Storm
A noun representing a storm, often used literally for weather or metaphorically for trouble.
Memory Tip: Look at the kanji structure: Mountain (山) on top of Wind (風). A wind blowing over a mountain creates a storm.
Example: 昨夜はひどい嵐だった。 (さくやはひどいあらしだった。)
-It was a terrible storm last night.
}

関心-
{
関心 (かんしん) - Interest, concern
A noun describing mental interest in a topic; not to be confused with 'kanshinn' (admiration).
Memory Tip: Barrier/Gate (関) + Heart (心). This is the gate that allows something to enter your heart or mind.
Example: 私は宇宙に関心がある。 (わたしはうちゅうにかんしんがある。)
-I am interested in space.
}

〜位-
{
〜位 (〜い) - ...place (rank), position
A counter suffix used for rankings (1st, 2nd, etc.) or indicating degree/status.
Memory Tip: Person (亻) + Stand (立). Where a person stands in the final lineup/ranking.
Example: 私のチームは3位だった。 (わたしのちーむはさんいだった。)
-My team came in third place.
}

適当-
{
適当 (てきとう) - Appropriate, suitable; irresponsible, careless
This word has two faces: in formal settings, it means 'proper,' but in casual speech, it often means doing something 'any which way.'
Memory Tip: Suitable (適) hitting the mark (当).
Example: 適当な返事をしてその場を凌いだ。(てきとうなへんじをしてそのばをしのいだ。)
-I gave a random answer to get through the situation.
}

硬い-
{
硬い (かたい) - Hard, stiff, solid
Specifically used for the physical hardness of materials or the formal/stiff nature of speech and writing.
Memory Tip: Stone (石) radical combined with 'convenience/change' (更); a stone that doesn't change is hard.
Example: このパンは焼きたてなのに硬い。(このぱんはやきたてなのにかたい。)
-Even though this bread is freshly baked, it is hard.
}

熊-
{
熊 (くま) - Bear
A noun referring to the large mammal. Often associated with strength or forest danger in Japanese culture.
Memory Tip: Capacity/ability (能) on top of fire/feet (灬); a bear has great capacity for movement on its four feet.
Example: 山で熊に遭遇した。(やまでくまにそうぐうした。)
-I encountered a bear in the mountains.
}

豊か-
{
豊か (ゆたか) - Rich/Abundant
A na-adjective used to describe material wealth, natural resources, or a rich heart and imagination.
Memory Tip: The kanji (豊) looks like a vessel (豆) overflowing with wealth and harvest.
Example: 彼女は豊かな才能を持っている。(かのじょはゆたかなさいのうをもっている。)
-She has abundant talent.
}

損-
{
損 (そん) - Loss/Damage/Disadvantage
A noun or na-adjective indicating a financial loss or a situation that is not beneficial.
Memory Tip: The 'hand' radical (扌) on the left suggests losing or dropping items/members (員), resulting in a loss.
Example: 彼は株で大損をした。(かれはかぶでおおぞんをした。)
-He suffered a heavy loss on stocks.
}

集中-
{
集中 (しゅうちゅう) - Concentration, focus
A noun describing the act of gathering one's attention or resources into a single point. It combines "gather" (集) and "center" (中).
Memory Tip: Imagine "gathering" (集) all your thoughts into the "center" (中) of your mind.
Example: 集中が必要です (しゅうちゅうがひつようです)
-Concentration is necessary.
}

集中する-
{
集中する (しゅうちゅうする) - To concentrate
The verb form of the noun "shuchu," created by adding "suru." It describes the action of focusing on a specific task.
Memory Tip: Combine "gathering at the center" (集中) with "to do" (する) to perform the act of focusing.
Example: 仕事に集中する (しごとにしゅうちゅうする)
-I concentrate on my work.
}

制服-
{
制服 (せいふく) - Uniform
A noun referring to standardized clothing worn by members of an organization. It consists of "system/control" (制) and "clothes" (服).
Memory Tip: These are the clothes (服) governed by the rules or system (制) of the school or job.
Example: 学校で制服を着る (がっこうでせいふくをきる)
-I wear a uniform at school.
}

越す-
{
越す (こす) - To cross, to move, to exceed
A godan verb indicating movement over a physical boundary or exceeding a numerical limit. It can also be a polite way to say "to go/come."
Memory Tip: The radical for "run" is on the left; imagine running to "cross" over a hurdle.
Example: 山を越す (やまをこす)
-To cross a mountain.
}

学者-
{
学者 (がくしゃ) - Scholar
Combining 'study' (学) and 'person' (者), it refers to a professional academic or researcher.
Memory Tip: Think of a "study person" who spends all their time immersed in books.
Example: 彼は有名な歴史学者です。 (かれはゆうめいなれきしがくしゃです。)
-He is a famous historian (history scholar).
}

完成-
{
完成 (かんせい) - Completion/Perfection
A noun or suru-verb meaning to finish or perfect a task or product.
Memory Tip: 'Complete' (完) plus 'Become' (成) — a thing has finally become complete.
Example: ついに新しい家が完成した。 (ついにあたらしいいえがかんせいした。)
-The new house was finally completed.
}

預ける-
{
預ける (あずける) - To entrust/leave something with
A transitive verb used for leaving an item, money, or even a child in someone's care.
Memory Tip: You "add" (sounds like azu) a responsibility to someone else's plate.
Example: 荷物を駅のロッカーに預けた。 (にもつをえきのろっかーにあずけた。)
-I left my luggage in a station locker.
}

きつい-
{
きつい (きつい) - Tight/Tough/Severe
An i-adjective used for physical tightness (like shoes) or mental/physical strain.
Memory Tip: Imagine a 'kit' that's too small for you to wear; it feels tight and tough to fit.
Example: この靴は少しきついです。 (このくつはすこしきついです。)
-These shoes are a bit tight.
}

懐かしい-
{
懐かしい (なつかしい) - Nostalgic/Dear
An i-adjective describing a feeling of fondly remembering a past person, place, or thing.
Memory Tip: 'Natsu' (summer) often brings back 'natsukashii' memories of childhood breaks.
Example: この曲はとても懐かしい。 (このきょくはとてもなつかしい。)
-This song is very nostalgic.
}

塔-
{
塔 (とう) - Tower, pagoda
This kanji is used for tall, slender structures. It includes the radicals for earth (土) and grass (艹).
Memory Tip: A tall structure built from earth (土) that rises above the grass (艹) to answer (合) the sky.
Example: 公園の真ん中に高い塔がある。 (こうえんのまんなかにたかいとうがある。)
-There is a tall tower in the middle of the park.
}

速度-
{
速度 (そくど) - Speed/Velocity
This noun combines the kanji for fast (速) and degree/measure (度) to describe the rate of movement.
Memory Tip: The "degree" of how "fast" an object moves defines its speed.
Example: 速度を落としてください。 (そくどをおとしてください。)
-Please reduce your speed.
}

〜方面-
{
〜方面 (〜ほうめん) - Direction of; area of; field of
A suffix used for transportation directions or to specify a particular field of interest or expertise.
Memory Tip: Imagine the 'direction' (方) on the 'surface' (面) of a map.
Example: 新宿方面の電車 (しんじゅくほうめんのでんしゃ)
-Train bound for the Shinjuku area.
}

方面-
{
方面 (ほうめん) - Direction; district; field
A noun referring to a certain direction, geographical area, or a specific branch of activity.
Memory Tip: Square (方) face (面) - looking at one specific side or angle of a situation.
Example: あらゆる方面から検討する (あらゆるほうめんからけんとうする)
-To consider from all angles and directions.
}

珍〜-
{
珍〜 (ちん〜) - Rare; unusual; curious
A prefix added to nouns to highlight that something is uncommon, strange, or an oddity.
Memory Tip: The 'king' (王) holding a rare 'umbrella-like' (㐱) treasure.
Example: 珍百景 (ちんひゃっけい)
-Rare and curious scenery.
}

輪-
{
輪 (わ) - Wheel/Ring/Loop
This noun denotes a circular shape or object, often used for physical rings or people standing in a circle.
Memory Tip: The "car" (車) radical on the left points to the round wheels of a vehicle.
Example: 子供たちは輪になって踊った。 (こどもたちはわになっておどった。)
-The children danced in a circle.
}

天皇-
{
天皇 (てんのう) - Emperor (of Japan)
A noun specifically referring to the Japanese Emperor, combining the kanji for "heaven" and "sovereign."
Memory Tip: The ruler who represents "heaven" (天) as the ultimate "emperor" (皇).
Example: 日本の天皇は象徴です。 (にほんのてんのうはしょうちょうです。)
-The Emperor of Japan is a symbol.
}

個人-
{
個人 (こじん) - Individual
This noun combines 'individual' (個) and 'person' (人). It refers to a person as a single unit distinct from a group or the state.
Memory Tip: A 'counter' (個) for a single 'person' (人) specifies them as an individual.
Example: 個人の自由を守る。 (こじんのじゆうをまもる。)
-Protect individual freedom.
}

勝利-
{
勝利 (しょうり) - Victory
Compound of 勝 (win) and 利 (profit/benefit), implying a beneficial win.
Memory Tip: To win (勝) is to gain profit (利).
Example: チームは勝利を収めた。 (ちーむはしょうりを おさめた。)
-The team achieved victory.
}

習慣-
{
習慣 (しゅうかん) - Habit, custom
A noun used for personal habits or cultural customs that are practiced repeatedly.
Memory Tip: Learning (習) a behavior until you are accustomed (慣) to it creates a habit.
Example: 早寝早起きは良い習慣だ。 (はやねはやおきはよいしゅうかんだ。)
-Sleeping early and waking early is a good habit.
}

根-
{
根 (ね) - Root
Refers to the roots of a plant or the figurative origin/basis of a problem or personality.
Memory Tip: The wood (木) part of the plant that stays firmly in the ground (艮 - limit/stable).
Example: 植物が根を張る。 (しょくぶつがねをはる。)
-The plant takes root.
}

迷惑-
{
迷惑 (めいわく) - Trouble/Nuisance/Annoyance
A noun or na-adjective meaning 'getting lost' (迷) in 'confusion' (惑) due to someone's actions.
Memory Tip: When someone causes trouble, it makes you lose your way (迷) and feel confused (惑).
Example: 近所に迷惑をかけてはいけない。(きんじょにめいわくをかけてはいけない。)
-You must not cause trouble for the neighbors.
}

奴-
{
奴 (やつ) - Guy, fellow, thing
A very casual, often blunt way of referring to people or objects depending on the speaker's tone.
Memory Tip: A guy who handles things with a hand (又) like a servant (奴).
Example: あんな奴は嫌いだ。 (あんなやつはきらいだ。)
-I hate that guy.
}

昇る-
{
昇る (のぼる) - To rise, to ascend
Commonly used for the sun rising or moving to a higher physical position.
Memory Tip: The kanji contains 'sun' (日) over 'ascend', like the sun rising in the sky.
Example: 太陽が東から昇る (たいようがひがしからのぼる)
-The sun rises from the east.
}

退屈-
{
退屈 (たいくつ) - Boredom, tedious
Often used as a na-adjective to describe a situation where one has nothing to do.
Memory Tip: Imagine 'retreating' (退) and 'bending' (屈) over from sheer boredom.
Example: 授業が退屈で寝てしまった (じゅぎょうがたいくつでねてしまった)
-The class was so boring that I fell asleep.
}

遠慮-
{
遠慮 (えんりょ) - Restraint/Reserve
Formed by 'far' (遠) and 'thought' (慮), meaning to think ahead to avoid social friction.
Memory Tip: Thinking far ahead about others' feelings leads to acting with social restraint.
Example: 遠慮は入りません。 (えんりょはいりません。)
-No need for reserve.
}

遠慮する-
{
遠慮する (えんりょする) - To hold back/Refrain
The verb form of 'enryo', used to politely decline an offer or exercise modesty.
Memory Tip: Combine 'far-thinking' with the verb 'to do' to act with polite hesitation.
Example: 甘いものは遠慮します。 (あまいものはえんりょします。)
-I will refrain from eating sweets.
}

針-
{
針 (はり) - Needle/Pin
Combines the metal radical (金) with a component representing a needle-like point.
Memory Tip: A small metal tool used for piercing fabric or stitching things together.
Example: 針に糸を通す。 (はりにいとをとおす。)
-Thread a needle.
}

生物-
{
生物 (せいぶつ) - Living thing, creature, biology
A combination of 生 (life) and 物 (thing), referring to all biological organisms.
Memory Tip: Literally 'living (生) things (物)' found in nature.
Example: 海には多くの生物がいる。 (うみにはおおくのせいぶつがいる。)
-There are many living things in the sea.
}

編む-
{
編む (あむ) - To knit / to braid
A Godan verb used for interlacing threads, yarn, or hair into a pattern.
Memory Tip: The left side radical 糸 means 'thread'. Think 'I am (Amu) knitting with thread.'
Example: 祖母はセーターを編んでいる。 (そぼはせーたーをあんでいる。)
-My grandmother is knitting a sweater.
}

画面-
{
画面 (がめん) - Screen
Refers to the display surface of a TV, computer, or digital device.
Memory Tip: 画 (picture) + 面 (surface/face) = The surface where the picture is shown.
Example: 画面が割れてしまった。 (がめんがわれてしまった。)
-The screen broke.
}

評判-
{
評判 (ひょうばん) - Reputation, fame, rumor
Combines 評 (evaluate) and 判 (judge), referring to the collective judgment others have of someone.
Memory Tip: People evaluate (評) and judge (判) you to create your reputation.
Example: その店は評判がいい。 (そのみせはひょうばんがいい)
-That shop has a good reputation.
}

防ぐ-
{
防ぐ (ふせぐ) - To prevent, to defend
A transitive verb used for stopping unwanted events or defending against attacks.
Memory Tip: The left radical (阜) suggests a mound or wall used to 'defend' or 'prevent' entry.
Example: 事故を防ぐ。 (じこをふせぐ)
-To prevent an accident.
}

一般-
{
一般 (いっぱん) - General, common, ordinary
Combines 一 (one) and 般 (sort/kind), meaning a 'single sort' that applies across the board.
Memory Tip: If everyone follows 'one kind' (一般) of rule, it is general or common knowledge.
Example: それは一般常識だ。 (それはいっぱんじょうしきだ)
-That is common sense.
}

滝-
{
滝 (たき) - Waterfall
A noun referring to a vertical stream of falling water.
Memory Tip: The water radical (氵) on the left meets the dragon radical (竜) on the right; think of a waterfall as a descending water dragon.
Example: 滝の音が聞こえる。 (たきのおとがきこえる。)
-The sound of a waterfall can be heard.
}

資料-
{
資料 (しりょう) - Materials, data, documents
A noun used for reference materials or informational documents used for work or study.
Memory Tip: 資 means resources and 料 means materials/fee; think of the raw informational resources needed for a project.
Example: 会議の資料を準備する。 (かいぎのしりょうをじゅんびする。)
-Prepare the materials for the meeting.
}

服装-
{
服装 (ふくそう) - Clothing, attire, garments
A noun referring to the specific style or set of clothes a person is wearing.
Memory Tip: 服 (clothes) combined with 装 (attire/equip); think of how you "equip" yourself with specific clothing for an event.
Example: パーティーの服装に迷う。 (ぱーてぃーのふくそうにまよう。)
-I'm undecided about what attire to wear for the party.
}

開発-
{
開発 (かいはつ) - Development/Exploitation
A compound verb/noun where 'open' (開) meets 'depart/emit' (発), often used for software, land, or resources.
Memory Tip: To develop something, you must open (開) up new ideas and emit (発) them to the world.
Example: 新しいソフトウェアを開発する。(あたらしいそふとうぇあをかいはつする。)
-To develop new software.
}

掘る-
{
掘る (ほる) - To dig/excavate
A transitive u-verb typically used for physical digging in the earth or searching for information.
Memory Tip: The hand radical (扌) on the left shows that you use your hands/tools to dig a hole.
Example: 庭に大きな穴を掘る。(にわにおおきなあなをほる。)
-To dig a large hole in the garden.
}

乱暴-
{
乱暴 (らんぼう) - Rough/Violent/Rude
A na-adjective combining 'chaos' (乱) and 'outburst' (暴) to describe aggressive behavior or sloppy work.
Memory Tip: When there is disorder (乱) and an outburst (暴) of anger, the behavior becomes violent.
Example: 乱暴にドアを閉めないで。(らんぼうにどあをしめないで。)
-Don't close the door roughly.
}

国王-
{
国王 (こくおう) - King/Monarch
A noun combining 'country' (国) and 'king' (王) to denote the male ruler of a sovereign nation.
Memory Tip: The king (王) who resides inside the borders (囗) of the country (国).
Example: 国王が国民に演説をした。(こくおうがこくみんにえんぜつをした。)
-The king gave a speech to the people.
}

国民-
{
国民 (こくみん) - Citizen, national, the people
This noun combines 'country' (国) and 'people' (民) to represent the collective populace of a nation.
Memory Tip: Think of 'Country People' to remember the people belonging to a specific nation.
Example: 国民の祝日 (こくみんのしゅくじつ)
-A national holiday
}

支度-
{
支度 (したく) - Preparation, arrangements
Often used for routine preparations, like getting ready for school or preparing a meal.
Memory Tip: You 'support' (支) your 'plans/rules' (度) by preparing ahead of time.
Example: 出かける支度をする (でかけるしたくをする)
-To get ready to go out.
}

性質-
{
性質 (せいしつ) - Nature, property, disposition
Refers to the inherent character of a person or the physical properties of an object.
Memory Tip: A person's 'nature' (性) and 'quality' (質) make up their core character.
Example: この物質の性質を調べる (このぶっしつのせいしつをしらべる)
-Investigate the properties of this substance.
}

自慢-
{
自慢 (じまん) - Pride, boast
A noun or suru-verb used when someone is showing off their achievements, possessions, or skills.
Memory Tip: 'Self' (自) combined with 'lazy/unrestrained' (慢) - someone who is unrestrained in talking about themselves.
Example: 彼は自分の車を自慢した。 (かれはじぶんのくるまをじまんした。)
-He boasted about his car.
}

尊敬-
{
尊敬 (そんけい) - Respect, esteem
A noun denoting a high regard for someone's character, qualities, or status.
Memory Tip: 'Noble/precious' (尊) plus 'respect/honor' (敬) - treating someone as both precious and honorable.
Example: 彼は周囲から尊敬を集めている。 (かれはしゅういからそんけいをあつめている。)
-He commands respect from those around him.
}

尊敬する-
{
尊敬する (そんけいする) - To respect
The suru-verb form of 尊敬, expressing the active process of holding someone in high regard.
Memory Tip: Combine the concepts of 'noble' and 'respect' with the action 'to do' (する).
Example: 私は先生を尊敬する。 (わたしはせんせいをそんけいする。)
-I respect my teacher.
}

実験-
{
実験 (じっけん) - Experiment
Formed from 実 (reality/truth) and 験 (testing). It refers to scientific or empirical trials.
Memory Tip: You 'Check' (ken) the 'Jitsu' (truth/reality) by doing an experiment.
Example: 新しい薬の実験を行う。(あたらしいくすりのじっけんをおこなう。)
-Conduct an experiment for a new medicine.
}

天使-
{
天使 (てんし) - Angel
Composed of heaven (天) and messenger (使). It is used both religiously and to describe a kind person.
Memory Tip: An angel is literally a 'messenger sent from heaven.'
Example: 彼女は天使のような笑顔だ (かのじょはてんしのようなえがおだ)
-She has an angel-like smile
}

王女-
{
王女 (おうじょ) - Princess
Literally 'king' (王) and 'woman/daughter' (女). It specifically refers to the daughter of a monarch.
Memory Tip: The 'king's' (王) 'daughter' (女) is the princess.
Example: 王女は美しいドレスを着ている (おうじょはうつくしいどれすをきている)
-The princess is wearing a beautiful dress
}

猿-
{
猿 (さる) - Monkey
This is the standard noun for a monkey or ape, often appearing in Japanese folklore.
Memory Tip: The radical on the left (犭) represents a beast, and the right looks like a monkey with a long tail.
Example: 猿も木から落ちる。 (さるもきからおちる。)
-Even monkeys fall from trees.
}

戦士-
{
戦士 (せんし) - Warrior, soldier
A formal term for someone who engages in combat or battle.
Memory Tip: A PERSON (士) who is specialized in WAR (戦).
Example: 古代の戦士は勇敢だった。 (こだいのせんしはゆうかんだった。)
-The ancient warriors were brave.
}

特徴-
{
特徴 (とくちょう) - Characteristic, feature
Refers to a distinctive trait or a prominent quality that sets something apart.
Memory Tip: A SPECIAL (特) sign or INDICATION (徴) that identifies someone.
Example: この街の最大の特徴は古い建物だ。 (このまちのさいだいのとくちょうはふるいたてものだ。)
-The biggest feature of this town is the old buildings.
}

竹-
{
竹 (たけ) - Bamboo
A pictographic kanji representing the stalks and leaves of a bamboo plant.
Memory Tip: Look at the two vertical strokes; they resemble hollow bamboo stalks growing upward.
Example: 竹でかごを作りました。(たけでかごをつくりました。)
-I made a basket out of bamboo.
}

贈る-
{
贈る (おくる) - To give (a gift)
Used for giving something of sentimental or high value, distinguished from the generic 'ageru' by its focus on the act of gifting.
Memory Tip: You use money/shells (貝) to purchase a gift to present to someone.
Example: 母に花を贈りました。(ははにはなをおくりました。)
-I gave my mother flowers as a gift.
}

探偵-
{
探偵 (たんてい) - Detective
Combines 'search' (探) and 'spy/investigate' (偵). Used for both private investigators and fictional sleuths.
Memory Tip: A person who searches (探) with their hands to spy (偵) out the truth.
Example: 有名な探偵に依頼した。(ゆうめいなたんていにいらいした。)
-I made a request to a famous detective.
}

提案-
{
提案 (ていあん) - Proposal/Suggestion
A noun for presenting an idea, common in formal or business discussions.
Memory Tip: 'Presenting' (提) a new 'plan' (案) on the table.
Example: 新しい提案があります。 (あたらしいていあんがあります。)
-I have a new proposal.
}

提案する-
{
提案する (ていあんする) - To propose/suggest
The verb form of 'teian', used when actively offering an idea for consideration.
Memory Tip: Combine 'present' (提) and 'plan' (案) with the action 'to do' (する).
Example: 改善策を提案する。 (かいぜんさくをていあんする。)
-I will suggest an improvement plan.
}

巨人-
{
巨人 (きょじん) - Giant
A noun describing a person of immense size or a mythological being.
Memory Tip: A 'gigantic' (巨) 'person' (人).
Example: 伝説の巨人が現れた。 (でんせつのきょじんがあらわれた。)
-A legendary giant appeared.
}

急-
{
急 (きゅう) - Sudden / Urgent
This kanji represents speed or pressure. It can function as a noun, a na-adjective, or a prefix.
Memory Tip: A heart (心) feeling pressure to move fast like a hand reaching for a tool.
Example: 急に雨が降り出した。(きゅうにあめがふりだした。)
-It suddenly started raining.
}

深夜-
{
深夜 (しんや) - Late at night / Midnight
Formed by 'deep' (深) and 'night' (夜). It refers to the hours very late at night or early morning.
Memory Tip: When the night (夜) is at its deepest (深) point.
Example: 深夜まで勉強した。(しんやまでべんきょうした。)
-I studied until late at night.
}

斜め-
{
斜め (ななめ) - Diagonal / Slanted
Describes a position or direction that is not vertical or horizontal.
Memory Tip: Think of the number 7 (Nana), which is written with a sharp diagonal slant.
Example: 斜めに線を引く。 (ななめにせんをひく。)
-Draw a diagonal line.
}

預かる-
{
預かる (あずかる) - To look after / To keep
To take temporary custody of an object or a person (like a child).
Memory Tip: Turn your head (頁) in advance (予) toward an item to keep a watch on it.
Example: 荷物を預かる。 (にもつをあずかる。)
-To look after the luggage.
}

軍人-
{
軍人 (ぐんじん) - Military personnel
A noun combining the kanji for "army/military" (軍) and "person" (人).
Memory Tip: Think of a person (人) who belongs to the army (軍) driving a tank.
Example: 私の祖父は軍人でした。(わたしのそふはぐんじんでした。)
-My grandfather was a soldier.
}

先程-
{
先程 (さきほど) - A short while ago
A formal or polite way to refer to the immediate past, combining "before" (先) and "degree/extent" (程).
Memory Tip: Just a small "degree" (程) of time "before" (先) this current moment.
Example: 先程、お電話がありました。(さきほど、おでんわがありました。)
-There was a phone call a short while ago.
}

都合-
{
都合 (つごう) - Circumstances, convenience
This noun describes the state of one's schedule or the conditions surrounding a situation. It is frequently used with the verbs 'ii' (good) or 'warui' (bad) to indicate availability.
Memory Tip: Think of a 'city' (都) where everything 'fits' (合) together perfectly to make things convenient.
Example: 明日は都合が悪いです。 (あしたはつごうがわるいです。)
-Tomorrow is inconvenient for me.
}

主人公-
{
主人公 (しゅじんこう) - Protagonist, main character
Used in literature, film, and games to identify the lead role. It combines 'master', 'person', and 'public'.
Memory Tip: The 'master' (主) 'person' (人) who is 'publicly' (公) the face of the story.
Example: 物語の主人公は勇敢だ。 (ものがたりのしゅじんこうはゆうかんだ。)
-The protagonist of the story is brave.
}

軍隊-
{
軍隊 (ぐんたい) - Army, military forces
This noun combines 軍 (military/war) and 隊 (squad/group) to describe organized armed forces.
Memory Tip: Imagine a large group (隊) of chariots or vehicles (軍 contains the car radical 車) moving into battle.
Example: 彼は軍隊に入った。 (かれはぐんたいにはいった。)
-He joined the army.
}

別荘-
{
別荘 (べっそう) - Villa, holiday home, summer house
A compound noun combining 別 (separate) and 荘 (villa/manor).
Memory Tip: A separate (別) grand building (荘) used only for vacations.
Example: 彼らは軽井沢に別荘を持っている。 (かれらはかるいざわにべっそうをもっている。)
-They have a villa in Karuizawa.
}

金属-
{
金属 (きんぞく) - metal
A noun combining 'gold/money' (金) and 'belonging to/genus' (属).
Memory Tip: All metals 'belong' (属) to the same category as 'gold' (金).
Example: 鉄は金属です。 (てつはきんぞくです。)
-Iron is a metal.
}

実-
{
実 (み) - fruit / nut / seed / substance
Refers to the physical fruit of a plant or the core substance/truth of a matter.
Memory Tip: A tree under a roof bearing its 'real' fruit or essence.
Example: 柿の実がなった。 (かきのみがなった。)
-The persimmon tree bore fruit.
}

日常-
{
日常 (にちじょう) - everyday, daily life
Combining 'day' and 'usual', this word refers to the ordinary routine of life. It can act as a noun or a no-adjective.
Memory Tip: What is usual (常) every day (日) constitutes your daily life (日常).
Example: 日常の生活を楽しむ。 (にちじょうのせいかつをたのしむ。)
-To enjoy one's daily life.

看板-
{
看板 (かんばん) - signboard, sign
Uses the kanji for 'watch/see' and 'board'. It refers to physical signs used for advertising or information.
Memory Tip: Look at (看) the wooden board (板) to see the shop's sign.

-The shop's sign has become new.

筆-
{
筆 (ふで) - writing brush, brush
A noun specifically referring to traditional calligraphy brushes or paintbrushes. It features the bamboo radical.
Memory Tip: Traditional brushes (筆) were made using bamboo (竹) for the handle.
Example: 彼は筆で美しい字を書く。 (かれはふででうつくしいじをかく。)
-He writes beautiful characters with a brush.

映像-
{
映像 (えいぞう) - Image, video, film
This noun combines 映 (reflect/project) and 像 (image/statue). It refers to visual media or moving pictures on a screen.
Memory Tip: Think of a reflection (映) that takes the form of a solid image (像) on your TV screen.
Example: 彼はその映像を見て驚いた。(かれはそのえいぞうをみておどろいた。)
-He was surprised to see the video.
}

当たり前-
{
当たり前 (あたりまえ) - Natural, obvious
Describes something that is common sense or to be expected.
Memory Tip: When you Hit (当) the truth, it's right in front of you (前).
Example: 困った人を助けるのは当たり前だ。 (こまったひとをたすけるのはあたりまえだ。)
-It is natural to help someone in trouble.

御覧になる-
{
御覧になる (ごらんになる) - To see/look (honorific)
The respectful honorific form of 'miru', used when speaking about the actions of a superior.
Memory Tip: The prefix 'go' (御) adds honor to 'ran' (覧), which means to look or view.
Example: 資料を御覧になりましたか。 (しりょうをごらんになりましたか。)
-Have you seen the documents?
}

瓶-
{
瓶 (びん) - Bottle; jar; vial
Refers to glass or ceramic containers, usually with a narrow neck.
Memory Tip: The right side contains the radical for pottery/tile (瓦), indicating its container nature.
Example: 空の瓶を捨てる。 (あきのびんをすてる。)

}

両腕-
{
両腕 (りょううで) - Both arms
This noun combines '両' (both) and '腕' (arm) to describe both limbs simultaneously.
Memory Tip: Two (両) arms (腕) are better than one when reaching for something.
Example: 彼は両腕を広げた。 (かれはりょううでをひろげた。)
-He spread both his arms.
}

兄貴-
{
兄貴 (あにき) - Older brother (informal/senior)
A masculine way to refer to an older brother or a respected senior male leader.
Memory Tip: Adding 貴 (precious/noble) to 兄 (older brother) makes him a 'big boss' brother.
Example: 兄貴に相談しよう。 (あにきにそうだんしよう。)
-Let's consult with my big brother.

女神-
{
女神 (めがみ) - Goddess
A compound of 女 (woman) and 神 (god), used for female deities in mythology or metaphor.

-She is the goddess of victory.

整理-
{
整理 (せいり) - Sorting / Organization
The act of putting things in order, tidying up, or eliminating unnecessary items.
Memory Tip: Putting things in logical (理) order to organize (整) them properly.
Example: 荷物の整理をする。 (にもつのせいりをする。)
-To organize one's luggage.
}

整理する-
{
整理する (せいりする) - To organize / To sort
The verb form of the noun 整理, used for the action of tidying physical or abstract things.
Memory Tip: Adding 'suru' makes the act of logical ordering (整理) an action.
Example: 部屋を整理する。 (へやをせいりする。)
-To tidy up the room.
}

職業-
{
職業 (しょくぎょう) - Occupation, profession, job
This word combines 職 (employment/post) and 業 (business/work) to represent one's career or trade.
Memory Tip: Your 'job' is the 'work' (業) you perform at your 'post' (職).
Example: あなたの職業は何ですか？ (あなたのしょくぎょうはなんですか？)
-What is your occupation?
}

笛-
{
笛 (ふえ) - Flute / whistle
A general term for wind instruments, including orchestral flutes and signal whistles.
Memory Tip: The bamboo radical (竹) on top indicates flutes were traditionally made of bamboo.
Example: 審判が笛を吹いた。(しんぱんがふえをふいた。)
-The referee blew the whistle.
}

屋上-
{
屋上 (おくじょう) - Rooftop
A compound word combining 'house/roof' (屋) and 'above' (上).
Memory Tip: It literally means 'house-top'. Just look at the top (上) of the house (屋).
Example: 屋上で昼ご飯を食べた。(おくじょうでひるごはんをたべた。)
-I ate lunch on the rooftop.
}

羽-
{
羽 (はね) - Wing / feather
Refers to the wings of birds or insects; also used as a counter for birds (read as 'wa').
Memory Tip: The kanji 羽 is a pictograph of two symmetrical wings.
Example: 鳥が羽を広げた。(とりがはねをひろげた。)
-The bird spread its wings.
}

親戚-
{
親戚 (しんせき) - Relatives
Noun referring to extended family members beyond the immediate circle. '親' means parent/intimate and '戚' signifies relative.
Memory Tip: My parents (親) are related to these people through an old bond or family tree (戚).
Example: 盆には親戚が集まる。 (ぼんにはしんせきがあつまる。)
-Relatives gather during Obon.
}

両側-
{
両側 (りょうがわ) - Both sides
A compound noun formed by '両' (both) and '側' (side), used for physical locations or opposing viewpoints.
Memory Tip: Two (両) distinct sides (側) of the same coin or street.
Example: 道の両側に木がある。 (みちのりょうがわにきがある。)
-There are trees on both sides of the road.
}

情熱-
{
情熱 (じょうねつ) - Passion/Enthusiasm
A noun combining '情' (feelings/emotion) and '熱' (heat/fever), describing intense emotional drive.
Memory Tip: Emotional (情) feelings that are boiling hot (熱).
Example: 彼は仕事に情熱を持っている。 (かれはしごとにじょうねつをもっている。)
-He has passion for his work.
}

冷える-
{
冷える (ひえる) - To grow cold/cool down
An intransitive verb typically used when an object or the atmosphere loses heat or when the body feels chilly.
Memory Tip: When the 'hi' (fire) goes out, everything starts to 'hie' (cool down).
Example: 夜は足元が冷える。 (よるはあしもとがひえる。)
-My feet get cold at night.
}

化粧-
{
化粧 (けしょう) - Makeup/Cosmetics
A noun or suru-verb. '化' means to change and '粧' refers to adornment; it literally means changing one's appearance through decoration.
Memory Tip: A chemical change (化) involving powders (粧) on the face.
Example: 彼女は化粧が上手だ。 (かのじょはけしょうがじょうずだ。)
-She is good at putting on makeup.
}

景色-
{
景色 (けしき) - Scenery/Landscape
A noun used to describe a view. '景' stands for scene/bright and '色' means color.
Memory Tip: The bright (景) colors (色) of the natural landscape.
Example: 窓からの景色が綺麗だ。 (まどからのけしきがきれいだ。)
-The view from the window is beautiful.
}

産む-
{
産む (うむ) - To give birth/produce
A transitive verb used for biological birth or figuratively for producing results/products.
Memory Tip: New life is produced (産) on the earth.
Example: 彼女は先月、男の子を産んだ。 (かのじょはせんげつ、おとこのこをうんだ。)
-She gave birth to a boy last month.
}

目覚める-
{
目覚める (めざめる) - To wake up/awaken
A ru-verb combining '目' (eye) and '覚める' (to wake). It implies the physical act of opening eyes or a metaphorical awakening.
Memory Tip: Your eyes (目) realize (覚) it is morning and wake up.
Example: 私は毎朝６時に目覚める。 (わたしはまいあさろくじにめざめる。)
-I wake up at 6 every morning.
}

材料-
{
材料 (ざいりょう) - Ingredients / Materials
Composed of 材 (timber/resource) and 料 (fee/materials). It refers to the physical components of something.
Memory Tip: Think of building a house: you need wood/timber (材) and you pay a fee (料) for the supplies.
Example: カレーの材料を買いました。 (かれーのざいりょうをかいました。)
-I bought the ingredients for curry.
}

目標-
{
目標 (もくひょう) - Goal / Objective
A noun referring to a specific target or mark one aims to reach.
Memory Tip: Keep your "Eye" (目) fixed on the "Target Mark" (標).
Example: 今年の目標は合格です。 (ことしのもくひょうはごうかくです。)
-This year's goal is to pass.
}

筋肉-
{
筋肉 (きんにく) - muscle
This noun combines 筋 (fiber/line) and 肉 (meat) to describe physical muscle tissue. It is commonly used in fitness contexts.
Memory Tip: Think of "fibrous meat" to remember the tissues that make up your muscles.
Example: 毎日運動して筋肉を鍛える。 (まいにちうんどうしてきんにくをきたえる。)
-I exercise every day to strengthen my muscles.
}

管-
{
管 (くだ) - pipe, tube
A noun referring to any hollow cylinder, whether biological (vessels) or mechanical (plumbing).
Memory Tip: The top radical is bamboo (⺮), which was historically used to make hollow pipes.
Example: 管に水が通っている。 (くだにみずがとおっている。)
-Water is passing through the pipe.
}

挟む-
{
挟む (はさむ) - to sandwich, to insert, to pinch
A transitive verb used when placing an object between two other things, like a bookmark in a book.
Memory Tip: Use your hand (扌) to put something between two sides (the right side of the kanji).
Example: パンにハムを挟む。 (ぱんにはむをはさむ。)
-Put ham in the sandwich (between the bread).
}

許可-
{
許可 (きょか) - Permission/Authorization
A noun/suru-verb where 許 means 'permit' and 可 means 'acceptable/can.' It is used in formal or official contexts.
Memory Tip: A boss says it is 'acceptable' (可) and grants you the 'permit' (許).
Example: 外出の許可をもらった。 (がいしゅつのきょかをもらった。)
-I received permission to go out.
}

代わる-
{
代わる (かわる) - To substitute/To take someone's place
An intransitive verb used when one thing or person replaces another in a specific role or position.
Memory Tip: A person (亻) acting as a replacement or representative (代) for another.
Example: 選手が代わる。 (せんしゅがかわる。)
-A player is substituted.
}

仮面-
{
仮面 (かめん) - Mask
Often used for physical masks worn on the face or metaphorical disguises.
Memory Tip: 仮 (temporary/pseudo) + 面 (face). It is a "temporary face" worn over your real one.
Example: 彼は仮面を被っている。 (かれはかめんをかぶっている。)
-He is wearing a mask.
}

載せる-
{
載せる (のせる) - To place on, to publish
An ichidan verb used for putting items on a surface or putting information in a publication.
Memory Tip: Look for the 車 (car) radical at the bottom. Think of "loading" something onto a vehicle or a page.
Example: 写真をブログに載せる。 (しゃしんをブログにのせる。)
-I will post the photo on the blog.
}

不明-
{
不明 (ふめい) - Unknown, unclear, obscure
A na-adjective or noun used when something is not identified or lacks clarity.
Memory Tip: 不 (not) + 明 (bright/clear); if a situation is not bright, it is impossible to see clearly.
Example: 原因は不明だ (げんいんはふめいだ)
-The cause is unknown.
}

言い訳-
{
言い訳 (いいわけ) - Excuse, explanation
A noun describing a reason given to justify a fault or avoid blame.
Memory Tip: 言い (saying) + 訳 (reason/translation); saying your personal reason for why something happened.
Example: 言い訳は無用だ (いいわけはむようだ)
-Excuses are useless.
}

照れる-
{
照れる (てれる) - To feel shy / embarrassed
This verb is used when someone feels awkward or bashful due to praise or attention.
Memory Tip: The kanji 照 (shining) implies your face is glowing red like the sun when you are shy.
Example: 褒められて照れる。(ほめられててれる)
-To feel shy after being praised.
}

先日-
{
先日 (せんじつ) - The other day / recently
A formal or polite way to refer to a point in the recent past.
Memory Tip: Literally means "previous (先) day (日)," looking back at a recent time.
Example: 先日はありがとうございました。(せんじつはありがとうございました)
-Thank you for the other day.
}

見付ける-
{
見付ける (みつける) - To find; to discover
A transitive verb combining 見 (to see) and 付ける (to attach), implying fixing one's sight on something.
Memory Tip: You 'see' something and 'attach' your attention to it once it's found.
Example: 鍵を見付けました。 (かぎをみつけました。)
-I found the keys.
}

〜軒-
{
〜軒 (〜けん) - Counter for houses or shops
A counter used for buildings, often changing to 'gen' after certain numbers like three.
Memory Tip: The kanji shows a roof over a dry area, common in traditional Japanese houses.
Example: この道には店が三軒あります。 (このみちにはみせがさんげんあります。)
-There are three shops on this street.
}

叫び声-
{
叫び声 (さけびごえ) - Shout; scream; cry
A compound noun made of 叫ぶ (to shout) and 声 (voice).
Memory Tip: The 'voice' (goe) of someone 'shouting' (sakebi) out loud.
Example: 遠くで叫び声が聞こえた。 (とおくでさけびごえがきこえた。)
-A scream was heard in the distance.
}

{

}

球-
{
球 (たま) - Sphere/Ball
A noun referring to any spherical object, commonly used in sports or geometry.

Example: 野球の球を投げる。(やきゅうのたまをなげる。)
-Throw a baseball.
}

絹-
{
絹 (きぬ) - Silk
A noun for the natural fiber produced by silkworms, historically a luxury item.
Memory Tip: The thread (糸) produced by the small larva (肙) is silk.
Example: 絹のスカーフを買った。(きぬのすかーふをかった。)
-I bought a silk scarf.
}

発展する-
{
発展する (はってんする) - To develop, to expand
A suru-verb used to describe the growth or advancement of things like economies, cities, or technology.
Memory Tip: A bud departing/bursting (発) to unfold (展) its petals represents development.
Example: この町は急速に発展している。(このまちはきゅうそくにはってんしている。)
-This town is developing rapidly.
}

学問-
{
学問 (がくもん) - Scholarship, study, learning
Refers to the formal pursuit of knowledge or a field of academic study.
Memory Tip: True learning (学) always involves asking the right questions (問).
Example: 彼は一生を学問に捧げた。(かれはいっしょうをがくもんにささげた。)
-He devoted his life to scholarship.
}

治療-
{
治療 (ちりょう) - Medical treatment, cure
Describes the act of treating a disease or injury to restore health.
Memory Tip: Governing (治) the body's condition to provide a medical heal (療).
Example: 新しい治療法が開発された。(あたらしいちりょうほうがかいはつされた。)
-A new treatment method was developed.
}

放送する-
{
放送する (ほうそうする) - to broadcast
A suru-verb meaning to transmit audio or video signals to a wide audience.
Memory Tip: To release (放) information and send (送) it to the public.
Example: その試合はテレビで放送されます。(そのしあいはてれびでほうそうされます)
-The match will be broadcast on television.

建設-
{
建設 (けんせつ) - Construction
A noun/suru-verb referring to the large-scale building of structures or systems. It combines 建 (to build) and 設 (to establish).
Memory Tip: To build (建) and set (設) a new structure firmly into the ground.
Example: 新しいビルの建設が始まった。(あたらしいびるのけんせつがはじまった。)
-The construction of the new building has started.
}

貧しい-
{
貧しい (まずしい) - Poor/Needy
An i-adjective describing a lack of money, resources, or even spirit. The kanji 貧 combines "divide" and "money/shell."
Memory Tip: When your money (貝) is divided (分) too many times, you become poor.
Example: 彼は貧しい家庭で育った。(かれはまずしいかていでそだった。)
-He grew up in a poor household.
}

手首-
{
手首 (てくび) - Wrist
A compound noun literally meaning "hand neck." This follows the Japanese pattern of naming joints as "necks" (like ankle: 足首).
Memory Tip: Think of the wrist as the "neck" (首) of the hand (手).
Example: 手首を痛めてしまった。(てくびをいためてしまった。)
-I hurt my wrist.
}

憎い-
{
憎い (にくい) - Hateful/Abominable
An i-adjective used to express strong dislike or hatred. Not to be confused with the suffix -nikui (difficult to).
Memory Tip: A heart (忄) filled with something vile (the right side radical) makes a person hateful.
Example: 犯人が憎い。(はんにんがにくい。)
-I hate the criminal.
}

不足-
{
不足 (ふそく) - Shortage, insufficiency
Formed by 'not' (不) and 'foot/sufficiency' (足), indicating something is lacking or below a required level.
Memory Tip: When you are 'not' (不) on your 'feet' (足), you lack the support needed to stand.
Example: 寝不足で頭が痛い。 (ねぶそくであたまがいたい。)
-My head hurts due to lack of sleep.
}

劇場-
{
劇場 (げきじょう) - Theater
This specifically refers to the physical building or venue where plays, operas, or theatrical performances occur.
Memory Tip: A 'drama/play' (劇) 'place' (場) is where the actors perform for an audience.
Example: 彼は劇場で働いています。 (かれはげきじょうではたらいています。)
-He works at the theater.
}

載る-
{
載る (のる) - To be placed on, to be mentioned
An intransitive verb used when something is loaded onto a vehicle or when information appears in a publication.
Memory Tip: The 'car' (車) radical at the bottom suggests things being 'carried' or 'loaded' onto a page or platform.
Example: 私の記事が新聞に載った。 (わたしのきじがしんぶんのった。)
-My article appeared in the newspaper.
}

賛成-
{
賛成 (さんせい) - Approval, agreement
A noun indicating support for an idea or proposal; it implies alignment with a specific stance.
Memory Tip: Assisting (賛) in making something become (成) a reality by agreeing.
Example: 私は彼の案に賛成だ。 (わたしはかれのあんにさんせいだ。)
-I am in favor of his plan.
}

賛成する-
{
賛成する (さんせいする) - To agree, to approve
The verbal form of 'sansei,' created by adding the light verb 'suru'.
Memory Tip: Performing the action (する) of giving approval (賛成).
Example: 多数の人がその計画に賛成した。 (たすうのひとがそのけいかくにさんせいした。)
-Many people agreed with the plan.
}

蝶-
{
蝶 (ちょう) - Butterfly
An insect noun featuring the 虫 (bug) radical on the left and a phonetic component meaning thin/flat on the right.
Memory Tip: "Chō" sounds like "show" — think of the beautiful show butterflies put on when they fly.
Example: 蝶が花に止まっている (ちょうがはなにとまっている)
-A butterfly is perched on a flower.
}

阿呆-
{
阿呆 (あほう) - Idiot/Fool
A noun common in the Kansai dialect. It is often used more affectionately or lightly than the harsher "baka."
Memory Tip: "A-ho" sounds like the start of a silly, foolish laugh (A-ho-ho-ho!).
Example: 阿呆なことをするな (あほうなことをするな)
-Don't do such a foolish thing.
}

湿る-
{
湿る (しめる) - To become damp
A godan verb describing the state of becoming moist or wet, often used for clothes or air.
Memory Tip: When things are wet and "shimeru," they often "shimmer" in the light.
Example: 洗濯物がまだ湿っている (せんたくものがまだしめっている)
-The laundry is still damp.
}

旨い-
{
旨い (うまい) - Delicious/Skillful
An i-adjective that is a more casual/masculine version of "oishii" for food, or used for being "good at" a skill.
Memory Tip: "Umai" sounds like "Yummy," and both words have that "m" sound for delicious things.
Example: このスープは本当に旨い (このすーぷはほんとうにうまい)
-This soup is really delicious.
}

幸運-
{
幸運 (こううん) - Good luck/Fortune
A noun or na-adjective describing a state of being lucky. It combines happiness (幸) and fate (運).
Memory Tip: When your destiny (運) moves toward happiness (幸), you have good luck.
Example: 幸運にも宝くじに当たった。 (こううんにもたからくじにあたった。)
-Fortunately, I won the lottery.
}

手渡す-
{
手渡す (てわたす) - To hand over
A compound verb combining 'hand' (手) and 'to cross over' (渡す). It implies a direct physical transfer.
Memory Tip: Literally 'hand-crossing' an object from your hand to theirs.
Example: 先生に宿題を手渡した。 (せんせいにしゅくだいをてわたした。)
-I handed my homework to the teacher.
}

罰-
{
罰 (ばつ) - Punishment, penalty
This noun refers to a penalty or divine retribution for a bad deed.
Memory Tip: The kanji features 'words' (言) and a 'knife' (刂); if your words are bad, the law cuts you.
Example: 嘘をつくと罰が当たる。 (うそをつくとばつがあたる。)
-If you lie, you'll be punished.
}

曲げる-
{
曲げる (まげる) - To bend, to twist
A transitive verb used for physically bending objects or figuratively twisting facts.
Memory Tip: The kanji resembles a frame or grid that has been distorted or bent from a square shape.
Example: 針金を直角に曲げる。 (はりがねをちょっかくにまげる。)
-Bend the wire at a right angle.
}

了解-
{
了解 (りょうかい) - Understanding, Roger, Got it
Used to acknowledge instructions or information, common in business and radio communication.
Memory Tip: 了 (finish) and 解 (untie/solve) mean you have finished solving the meaning of the message.
Example: 了解しました。 (りょうかいしました。)
-Understood / Roger that.
}

鈴-
{
鈴 (すず) - Bell (small)
Refers to small, round bells often used for pets, shrines, or as ornaments.
Memory Tip: Metal (金) that is used to give a signal or order (令).
Example: 猫の首に鈴をつける。 (ねこのくびにすずをつける。)
-To put a bell on a cat's neck.

地区-
{
地区 (ちく) - District / Area
Refers to a specific geographical section or zone within a city or town.

破れる-
{
破れる (やぶれる) - To be torn, to be broken, to be defeated
An intransitive verb used for physical materials being torn or losing a competitive match.

Example: シャツが破れました。 (しゃつがやぶれました。)
-The shirt got torn.

一生懸命-
{
一生懸命 (いっしょうけんめい) - With all one's might, very hard
Formed from 一生 (whole life) and 懸命 (risking life). It expresses doing something with maximum effort.
Memory Tip: Imagine risking your life (命) for a single task for your whole life (一生).

体力-
{
体力 (たいりょく) - Physical strength, stamina
Made of 体 (body) and 力 (power). It refers to the inherent energy or endurance of one's physique.
Memory Tip: Simply the body's (体) power (力) to keep going.
Example: 最近、体力が落ちてきた。(さいきん、たいりょくがおちてきた)

芸術-
{
芸術 (げいじゅつ) - Art, the arts
Combines 芸 (technique/performance) and 術 (skill/means). It encompasses creative works and fine arts.

-He is interested in art.

法律-
{
法律 (ほうりつ) - Law
This noun combines 'method/law' and 'regulation' to denote the formal legal systems of a society.
Memory Tip: Think of 'method' (法) plus 'regulation' (律) to establish the order of the land.

借金-
{
借金 (しゃっきん) - Debt/Loan
A compound of 'borrow' and 'money' that refers to money owed to another party.

植物-
{
植物 (しょくぶつ) - Plant/Vegetation
A biological term combining 'to plant' and 'thing', covering all types of flora.
Memory Tip: A 'thing' (物) that is 'planted' (植) in the ground using a tree (木).

管理-
{
管理 (かんり) - Management/Control
A noun/verb referring to the administration, maintenance, or supervision of a system or property.
Memory Tip: Managing involves using a pipe/supervisor (管) to apply logic/reason (理).

-He is managing an apartment.

住人-
{
住人 (じゅうにん) - Resident/Inhabitant
Composed of 住 (to live) and 人 (person). It refers to an individual living in a specific house or building.

乗客-
{
乗客 (じょうきゃく) - Passenger
Combines 乗 (to ride) and 客 (guest/customer). It specifically refers to people using public transportation.

枯れる-
{
枯れる (かれる) - To wither / To die (plants)
An intransitive ichidan verb used for plants losing vitality and drying up.
Memory Tip: A "tree" (木) that has become "old" (古) will eventually wither.
Example: 水をやらなかったので花が枯れた。 (みずをやらなかったのではながかれた。)
-The flower withered because I didn't water it.

資格-
{
資格 (しかく) - Qualification / License / Entitlement
A noun combining "resources/capital" (資) and "status/standard" (格).
Memory Tip: Your "status" (格) is determined by your "resources/skills" (資).
Example: 弁護士の資格を取る。 (べんごしのしかくをとる。)
-To obtain a lawyer's qualification.
}

質-
{
質 (しつ) - Quality
Used to refer to the nature, character, or caliber of an object or person.
Memory Tip: Two axes (斤) weighing down on a shell (貝 - money) to determine its true worth or quality.
Example: 質のいい紙を使ってください。 (しつのいいかみをつかってください。)
-Please use high-quality paper.
}

陰-
{
陰 (かげ) - Shade/Shadow/Behind
Refers to an area protected from light or the space behind an object.
Memory Tip: On the side of the 'mound' (阝), 'clouds' cover the 'sun' (bottom right) to create shade.
Example: 木の陰で休みましょう。 (きのかげでやすみましょう。)
-Let's rest in the shade of the tree.
}

灰-
{
灰 (はい) - Ash
Composed of elements representing a cliff/shelter and fire, showing what is left after combustion.
Memory Tip: Imagine a fire (火) burning out under a cliff, leaving only gray ash behind.
Example: タバコの灰を捨てる。 (たばこのはいをすてる。)
-Throw away the cigarette ash.
}

埋まる-
{
埋まる (うまる) - To be buried, to be filled up
An intransitive verb where the 'earth' (土) radical suggests being covered by ground.
Memory Tip: See the earth (土) next to a town (里); the town is being buried under the soil.
Example: 街が落ち葉で埋まる。 (まちがおちばでうまる。)
-The town is buried in fallen leaves.
}

大陸-
{
大陸 (たいりく) - Continent
A combination of 'tai' (large) and 'riku' (land). It refers to the world's main continuous expanses of land.
Memory Tip: A massive expanse of big land separated by oceans.
Example: 彼は大陸を横断した (かれはたいりくをおうだんした)
-He crossed the continent.
}

爆弾-
{
爆弾 (ばくだん) - Bomb
Combines 'baku' (explode) and 'dan' (bullet/shell). It refers to any explosive device.
Memory Tip: An exploding bullet that causes a massive blast.
Example: 警察が爆弾を処理した (けいさつがばくだんをしょりした)
-The police disposed of the bomb.
}

妖怪-
{
妖怪 (ようかい) - Yokai/Monster/Phantom
Combines 'you' (bewitching) and 'kai' (suspicious/mystery). Refers to supernatural creatures in Japanese folklore.
Memory Tip: Bewitching mysteries that haunt the shadows of Japanese legends.
Example: 彼は日本の妖怪に詳しい (かれはにほんのようかいにくわしい)
-He is knowledgeable about Japanese yokai.
}

再度-
{
再度 (さいど) - Once more/Again
An adverbial noun where 'sai' means 're-' or 'again' and 'do' means 'degree' or 'occurrence'.
Memory Tip: Going through the same degree of action a second time.
Example: 再度、確認してください (さいど、かくにんしてください)
-Please check it once more.
}

障子-
{
障子 (しょうじ) - Paper sliding door
A traditional Japanese sliding door or partition made of translucent paper over a wooden frame.
Memory Tip: The kanji 障 (block) indicates a partition that blocks the view while letting light through.
Example: 障子を閉めてください (しょうじをしめてください)
-Please close the paper sliding door.
}

交換-
{
交換 (こうかん) - Exchange/Swap
A noun/suru-verb for trading items or replacing a part with a new one.
Memory Tip: Think of paths intersecting (交) to change (換) what you are carrying for something else.
Example: 名刺を交換しましょう (めいしをこうかんしましょう)
-Let's exchange business cards.
}

賢い-
{
賢い (かしこい) - Wise/Smart/Clever
An i-adjective used for intelligence, resourcefulness, or well-behaved pets.
Memory Tip: The bottom radical 貝 (shell/money) suggests one is wise enough to manage valuable resources.
Example: 彼はとても賢い子供だ (かれはとてもかしこいこどもだ)
-He is a very smart child.
}

悔しい-
{
悔しい (くやしい) - Frustrated/Regrettable
An i-adjective used to express frustration or bitterness due to a failure or being treated unfairly. It conveys a strong emotional reaction to personal loss.
Memory Tip: The 'heart' radical (忄) on the left of 'every' (毎) shows your heart feeling regret every time you fail.
Example: 試合に負けて悔しいです (しあいにまけてくやしいです)
-I'm frustrated because I lost the match.
}

足跡-
{
足跡 (あしあと) - Footprint
A compound noun formed by 'foot' (足) and 'trace/mark' (跡). It refers to physical prints or a metaphorical trail left behind.
Memory Tip: Combine the radical for foot (足) with the kanji for a mark (跡) to visualize a step left in the sand.
Example: 雪の上に足跡があります (ゆきのうえにあしあとがあります)
-There are footprints on the snow.
}

品物-
{
品物 (しなもの) - Goods/Article
A noun referring to physical products or merchandise. It combines 'quality/item' (品) and 'thing' (物).
Memory Tip: The three boxes in '品' look like boxes in a warehouse filled with 'things' (物).
Example: 品物を箱に入れました (しなものをはこにいれました)
-I put the goods into the box.
}

誕生-
{
誕生 (たんじょう) - Birth, creation
This noun combines 誕 (nativity) and 生 (life). It refers to the birth of a person or the grand emergence of a significant concept or event.
Memory Tip: Visualize a newborn (生) having a grand (誕) debut on their 'tan-jou' day.
Example: 新しい命が誕生した。 (あたらしいいのちがたんじょうした。)
-A new life was born.
}

検査-
{
検査 (けんさ) - Inspection, examination, test
A noun formed by 検 (examine) and 査 (investigate). It refers to a systematic checkup, a medical test, or an industrial inspection.
Memory Tip: You 'Ken' (can) investigate 'Sa' (the details) to find the truth.
Example: 血液検査を受けた。 (けつえきけんさをうけた。)
-I had a blood test.
}

検査する-
{
検査する (けんさする) - To inspect, to examine
The verb form of 検査, describing the active process of conducting a formal check or looking for defects/conditions.
Memory Tip: Think of performing the action of investigating details (Sa) with a critical eye (Ken).
Example: 部品を検査する。 (ぶひんをけんさする。)
-Inspect the parts.
}

天国-
{
天国 (てんごく) - Heaven, paradise
Consists of 天 (sky/heaven) and 国 (country). It refers to a blissful afterlife or a place of perfect happiness.
Memory Tip: It is literally the 'country' (国) located in the 'sky' (天).
Example: ここは天国のようだ。 (ここはてんごくのようだ。)
-This place is like heaven.
}

羨ましい-
{
羨ましい (うらやましい) - Envious, jealous
An i-adjective used to express that one desires the qualities or fortune of another person. It is often used in a social/casual context.
Memory Tip: Think of looking from behind the 'mountain' (yama) and feeling 'ura' (back/inner) envy for others.
Example: 彼の才能が羨ましい。 (かれのさいのうがうらやましい。)
-I am envious of his talent.
}

商品-
{
商品 (しょうひん) - Product/Merchandise
Formed by 商 (commerce) and 品 (goods/item). It refers to any item specifically intended for sale in a market.
Memory Tip: A good (品) used specifically for commerce (商) is a product.
Example: この商品は人気がある。 (このしょうひんはにんきがある。)
-This product is popular.
}

指導-
{
指導 (しどう) - Guidance/Leadership
Composed of "finger" (指) and "lead" (導). It refers to the act of pointing someone in the right direction.
Memory Tip: You point your finger (指) to lead (導) a student toward the goal.
Example: 先生の指導を受ける。 (せんせいのしどうをうける。)
-Receive guidance from a teacher.
}

感想-
{
感想 (かんそう) - Impressions/Thoughts
Refers to the subjective feelings or ideas formed after experiencing or seeing something.
Memory Tip: A combination of your "Feelings" (感) and your "Ideas" (想).
Example: 映画の感想を教えてください。 (えいがのかんそうをおしえてください。)
-Please tell me your thoughts on the movie.

寮-
{
寮 (りょう) - Dormitory
This noun refers to a residential building for students or company employees.
Memory Tip: Under the roof (宀), many people live together in this large facility (寮).
Example: 彼は大学の寮に住んでいる。 (かれはだいがくのりょうにすんでいる。)
-He lives in a university dormitory.

米国-
{
米国 (べいこく) - USA
A formal term for the United States using the kanji for 'rice' (米) and 'country' (国).
Memory Tip: Think of the USA as the 'Rice Country' in traditional Japanese kanji choices.
Example: 彼は米国に留学した。 (かれはべいこくにりゅうがくした。)
-He studied abroad in the USA.

胃-
{
胃 (い) - Stomach
This noun refers specifically to the anatomical organ responsible for digestion.
Memory Tip: The top part represents a field (田) full of food, and the bottom is the meat/body (月) radical.
Example: 胃が痛いです。 (いがいたいです。)
-My stomach hurts.
}

英国-

英国 (えいこく) - United Kingdom/Britain

専門-

Refers to a specific field of expertise or a person's major in school.

冒険-
{
冒険 (ぼうけん) - Adventure
Comprised of 冒 (to risk/dare) and 険 (steep/precipitous), implying a journey involving risks.

差し上げる-
{
差し上げる (さしあげる) - To give (humble)
The humble (kenjougo) form of 'ageru', used when the speaker is giving something to a superior.

-I gave this to the teacher.

村人 (むらびと) - Villager

言語-

言語 (げんご) - language

革-

成績-
{
成績 (せいせき) - Grades, performance
Explanation: Composed of 成 (to become/achieve) and 績 (achievements). It refers to the outcome of one's efforts, commonly in academic or business contexts.
Memory Tip: You achieve (成) a high rank by accumulating achievements (績) on your score sheet.

-His grades are wonderful.

両者-

両者 (りょうしゃ) - Both parties, both people

基本的-
{
基本的 (きほんてき) - Fundamental, basic

互い-

互い (たがい) - Mutual/Each other

警告 (けいこく) - Warning, caution
Formed by 警 (admonish/guard) and 告 (announce). It represents a formal or severe warning.

広告 (こうこく) - Advertisement, publicity

非常-
{
非常 (ひじょう) - Emergency, extraordinary, unusual

予測 (よそく) - Prediction, forecast

勘違い-

勘違い (かんちがい) - Misunderstanding / Mistake
Combines 'intuition/perception' (勘) with 'mistake/difference' (違い).

-It was my misunderstanding.
}

被害-
{
被害 (ひがい) - Damage/Harm
Consists of 被 (to incur/receive) and 害 (harm). It refers to damage suffered by a person or entity.
Memory Tip: Think of 'wearing' (被) the 'harm' (害) like a heavy cloak of destruction.
Example: 台風で大きな被害が出た。 (たいふうでおおきなひがいがでた。)
-The typhoon caused great damage.
}

提出-
{
提出 (ていしゅつ) - Submission
Formed by 提 (to present/carry) and 出 (to go out/exit). Commonly used for turning in documents.
Memory Tip: You use your hand (扌 radical in 提) to put a document 'out' (出) to the teacher.
Example: 宿題を先生に提出した。 (しゅくだいをせんせいにていしゅつした。)
-I submitted my homework to the teacher.
}

荒れる-
{
荒れる (あれる) - To be rough/To be wild
An intransitive verb used for stormy weather, rough skin, or rowdy behavior.
Memory Tip: The 'grass' (艹) radical on top suggests a field that has grown wild and neglected.
Example: 海がひどく荒れている。 (うみがひどくあれている。)
-The sea is very rough.
}

拡大-
{
拡大 (かくだい) - Expansion
A compound of 拡 (stretch) and 大 (large), used for zooming in or physical/metaphorical expansion.
Memory Tip: Use your hand (扌) to stretch something to make it big (大).
Example: 地図を拡大して見る。(ちずをかくだいしてみる。)
-View the map by enlarging it.
}

上品-
{
上品 (じょうひん) - Elegant/Refined
Literally 'upper quality.' Used to describe people's manners, appearance, or items.
Memory Tip: Someone who possesses the 'upper' (上) class 'items/quality' (品) is elegant.
Example: 彼女はいつも上品な服を着ている。(かのじょはいつもじょうひんなふくをきている。)
-She always wears elegant clothes.
}

沈める-
{
沈める (しずめる) - To sink (something)
A transitive verb where an agent causes an object to submerge in liquid.
Memory Tip: Use water (氵) to make something disappear out of sight.
Example: 彼は船を海に沈めた。(かれはふねをうみにしずめた。)
-He sank the ship in the sea.
}

検討する-
{
検討する (けんとうする) - To consider/examine
A formal verb for investigating or reviewing a plan or proposal.
Memory Tip: To examine (検) something by discussing (討) it thoroughly.
Example: その案を前向きに検討する。(そのあんをまえむきにけんとうする。)
-We will consider that proposal positively.
}

全国-
{
全国 (ぜんこく) - Nationwide; Whole country
Formed by combining the kanji for "whole/all" and "country."
Memory Tip: The WHOLE (全) COUNTRY (国) is involved.
Example: 全国で雨が降っています。(ぜんこくであめがふっています。)
-It is raining all over the country.
}

変更-
{
変更 (へんこう) - Change; Modification
Used for changes in plans, schedules, or settings. It is more formal than the simple verb "kaeru."
Memory Tip: To CHANGE (変) something AGAIN (更) until it is correct.
Example: 予定を変更しました。(よていをへんこうしました。)
-I changed the schedule.
}

例外-
{
例外 (れいがい) - Exception
Literally translates to "outside the example."
Memory Tip: This case is OUTSIDE (外) of the typical EXAMPLE (例).
Example: これには例外がありません。(これにはれいがいがありません。)
-There are no exceptions to this.
}

航空-
{
航空 (こうくう) - Aviation; Air travel
Refers to the industry or movement of navigating through the air.
Memory Tip: To NAVIGATE (航) through the empty SKY (空).
Example: 航空券を予約しました。(こうくうけんをよやくしました。)
-I booked a flight ticket.
}

関連-
{
関連 (かんれん) - Relation, connection, relevance
A noun or suru-verb that denotes a logical or physical link between two or more things.
Memory Tip: 関 (barrier/connection) and 連 (to link/take along) create a chain of connection.
Example: この二つは関連がある。 (このふたつはかんれんがある。)
-These two are related.
}

豪華-
{
豪華 (ごうか) - Gorgeous, luxurious, extravagant
A na-adjective used for things that look expensive, grand, or impressively splendid.
Memory Tip: Combine 豪 (great/overpowering) and 華 (flower/splendor) to picture a grand, flowery display.
Example: 豪華な食事。 (ごうかなしょくじ。)
-A luxurious meal.
}

独身-
{
独身 (どくしん) - Single, unmarried
A noun used to describe a person who is not currently in a marriage or partnership.
Memory Tip: 独 means "alone" and 身 means "body"; you are just one body by yourself.
Example: 私はまだ独身です。 (わたしはまだどくしんです。)
-I am still single.
}

中止-
{
中止 (ちゅうし) - Cancellation, suspension
A noun/suru-verb indicating that a planned event or action is stopped before completion.
Memory Tip: You stop (止) right in the middle (中) of what you were doing.
Example: 祭りは中止になった。 (まつりはちゅうしになった。)
-The festival was cancelled.
}

劇-
{
劇 (げき) - Drama, play
A noun referring to a theatrical performance or dramatic situation.
Memory Tip: A tiger (虍) and a pig (豕) fighting with a sword (刂) creates a dramatic scene.
Example: 彼は学校の劇に出た。 (かれはがっこうのげきにでた。)
-He was in the school play.
}

店内-
{
店内 (てんない) - Inside the store
This is a compound noun formed by 店 (store) and 内 (inside), commonly used in retail and service contexts.
Memory Tip: 店 (store) + 内 (inside) = store interior.
Example: 店内は禁煙です。 (てんないはきんえんです。)
-Smoking is prohibited inside the store.
}

以降-
{
以降 (いこう) - From then on / Thereafter
A formal time-related noun/suffix that follows a specific time point to indicate everything from that point forward.
Memory Tip: 以 (from) + 降 (descending/after) = descending from that point forward in time.
Example: 4月以降、忙しくなります。 (しがついこう、いそがしくなります。)
-I will be busy from April onwards.
}

不自由-
{
不自由 (ふじゆう) - Inconvenience / Disability / Lack of freedom
Formed by adding the negative prefix 不 (not) to 自由 (freedom/liberty). It can describe a physical impairment or a general lack of resources.
Memory Tip: 不 (not) + 自由 (freedom) = No freedom of movement or ease.
Example: 生活に不自由はない。 (せいかつにふじゆうはない。)
-There is no inconvenience in my life.
}

翌年-
{
翌年 (よくねん) - The following year / Next year
A formal term often used in narrative writing or history to denote the year immediately after a reference year.
Memory Tip: 翌 (next/following) + 年 (year) = the very next year.
Example: 翌年に日本へ行った。 (よくねんににほんへいった。)
-I went to Japan the following year.
}

数年-
{
数年 (すうねん) - Several years
Combines 'number/count' (数) with 'year' (年) to indicate an indefinite but small number of years.
Memory Tip: Count (数) + Year (年) = A count of several years.
Example: 数年前にここに来た。 (すうねんまえにここにきた。)
-I came here several years ago.
}

営業-
{
営業 (えいぎょう) - Business, sales, operations
A noun describing the running of a business or the sales department within a company.
Memory Tip: Managing (営) the business/trade (業) activities.
Example: 当店は営業中です。(とうてんはおえいぎょうちゅうです。)
-This shop is open for business.
}

営業する-
{
営業する (えいぎょうする) - To do business, to operate, to engage in sales
The verb form of 営業, used to describe the act of conducting business or active sales prospecting.
Memory Tip: Taking action (する) to manage (営) a trade (業).
Example: 彼は外回りで営業する。(かれはそとまわりでえいぎょうする。)
-He goes out to do sales calls.
}

翻訳-
{
翻訳 (ほんやく) - Translation
Specifically refers to written translation (as opposed to interpretation).
Memory Tip: Flipping (翻) the meaning/reason (訳) into a new language.
Example: 論文を日本語に翻訳する。(ろんぶんをにほんごにほんやくする。)
-I will translate the thesis into Japanese.
}

憎しみ-
{
憎しみ (にくしみ) - Hatred
The noun form of the verb 'nikumu' (to hate). It describes a deep, lingering feeling of animosity or resentment.
Memory Tip: The heart radical (忄) on the left of 憎 shows this word describes an intense internal emotional state.
Example: 二人の間には深い憎しみがある。(ふたりのあいだにはふかいにくしみがある。)
-There is a deep hatred between the two.
}

職員-
{
職員 (しょくいん) - Staff / Employee
A compound of 'job/employment' and 'member'. It is typically used for staff in public offices, schools, or organizations.
Memory Tip: Think of a person (員) performing their professional duty or job (職).
Example: 学校の職員が会議室に集まった。(がっこうのしょくいんがかいぎしつにあつまった。)
-The school staff gathered in the meeting room.
}

乳-
{
乳 (ちち) - Milk / Breasts
When used alone, it refers to milk (especially breast milk or milk from a cow) or the breasts themselves.
Memory Tip: The kanji depicts a hand over a child, representing the act of nursing or providing milk.
Example: 赤ん坊が乳を欲しがって泣いている。(あかんぼうがちちをほしがってないている。)
-The baby is crying because they want milk.

黒人-
{
黒人 (こくじん) - Black person
A straightforward combination of the kanji for 'black' and 'person'.
Memory Tip: Simply 'black' (黒) plus 'person' (人).
Example: 彼は有名な黒人作家だ (かれはゆうめいなこくじんさっかだ)
-He is a famous Black author.

別人-
{
別人 (べつじん) - Different person
Used when someone has changed so much they seem like a different person, or to indicate a different individual.
Memory Tip: A separate (別) person (人) from the one we knew.
Example: 彼は病気で別人のようになった (かれはびょうきでべつじんのようになった)
-He became like a different person due to illness.

大広間-
{
大広間 (おおひろま) - Great hall/Grand hall
A noun for a large ceremonial room in a castle or palace used for gatherings and audiences.
Memory Tip: 'Oo' (big) + 'hiroma' (wide room) — a very big, wide room indeed.
Example: 騎士たちが大広間に集まった。 (きしたちがおおひろまにあつまった。)

大理石-
{
大理石 (だいりせき) - Marble
A noun for the smooth, polished stone used in fine architecture, sculpture, and flooring.
Memory Tip: 'Dairi' sounds like 'dairy' — imagine a marble-white dairy carton, cold and smooth.
Example: 床は白い大理石でできていた。 (ゆかはしろいだいりせきでできていた。)
-The floor was made of white marble.

熱病-
{
熱病 (ねつびょう) - Fever/Febrile illness
A noun for a disease characterized by high fever, often serious and historically feared.
Memory Tip: 'Netsu' (heat) + 'byō' (illness) — a 'heat illness', your body burning from within.
Example: 村人たちは熱病に苦しんだ。 (むらびとたちはねつびょうにくるしんだ。)
-The villagers suffered from the fever.
}

顧問官-
{
顧問官 (こもんかん) - Advisor/Counselor
A noun for an official who provides expert advice to a ruler or leader, especially in formal or historical settings.
Memory Tip: 'Komon' means advisor, and 'kan' means official — an officially appointed advisor.
Example: 王は顧問官の意見を聞いた。 (おうはこもんかんのいけんをきいた。)
-The king listened to the counselor's opinion.
}

係-
{
係 (かかり) - Person in charge/Staff member
A noun for someone assigned responsibility for a particular task or department.
Memory Tip: Think of 'kakari' as someone who 'catches' tasks — they're the one responsible for catching and handling things.
Example: 受付係に聞いてください。 (うけつけがかりにきいてください。)
-Please ask the person at the reception desk.
}

へだたり-
{
へだたり - Distance/Gap/Separation
A noun expressing physical or emotional distance between two things or people.
Memory Tip: 'Hedatari' contains 'heda' — imagine a 'header' dividing two sides, creating a gap between them.
Example: 二人の間には大きなへだたりがあった。 (ふたりのあいだにはおおきなへだたりがあった。)
-There was a great distance between the two of them.

おきて-
{
おきて - Law/Rule/Code of conduct
A noun for an established rule or code that governs behavior within a group, clan, or society.
Memory Tip: 'Okite' sounds like 'okay-te' — these are the rules everyone must say 'okay' to.

うなずく-
{
うなずく - To nod
A verb describing the act of moving one's head up and down to signal agreement or understanding.
Memory Tip: 'Una-zuku' — 'una' sounds like 'yeah' and 'zuku' like a bobbing motion. Nod yeah!
Example: 彼はうなずいて同意した。 (かれはうなずいてどういした。)
-He nodded in agreement.

各地-
{
各地 (かくち) - Various places
Refers to 'each place' or 'every region' within a certain area.

芸者-
{
芸者 (げいしゃ) - Geisha
A traditional Japanese female entertainer skilled in classical music, dance, and games.

大騒ぎ-
{
大騒ぎ (おおさわぎ) - Big fuss, uproar
A noun derived from the verb 'sawagu' (to make noise) prefixed with 'oo' (big).
Memory Tip: When something is 'Big' (大) and everyone is 'Making a Noise' (騒ぎ), it’s an uproar.
Example: パーティーは大騒ぎだった。 (パーティーはおおさわぎだった。)
-The party was a huge uproar.

郊外-
{
郊外 (こうがい) - Suburbs, outskirts
Refers to the residential areas located on the edge of a city.
Memory Tip: The area 'Outside' (外) the main 'City/District' (郊).

-I live in a quiet suburb.

給料-
{
給料 (きゅうりょう) - Salary, wages
A noun referring to the payment received for work or services.
Memory Tip: A 'Supply' (給) of 'Material/Fee' (料) given to you at the end of the month.

-My salary went up.

超す-
{
超す (こす) - To cross, to exceed
A transitive verb used for moving across a physical point or surpassing a numerical limit.
Memory Tip: Visualize someone 'Running' (走 radical) to go 'Beyond' (超) a finish line.
Example: 気温が三十度を超す。 (きおんがさんじゅうどをこす。)

詳細-
{
詳細 (しょうさい) - Details, particulars
Combines 'detailed/refined' (詳) and 'fine/thin' (細).
Memory Tip: When you break things down into very fine (細) parts, you get the details (詳).

悪夢-
{
悪夢 (あくむ) - Nightmare
A straightforward combination of 'bad/evil' (悪) and 'dream' (夢).

観客-
{
観客 (かんきゃく) - Audience, spectators
Combines 'observe/view' (観) and 'guest/customer' (客).

-The audience gave a big round of applause.

設定-
{
設定 (せってい) - Setting, configuration, establishment
A noun used for system options, movie backgrounds, or established rules.
Memory Tip: Words (言) used to establish (設) fixed (定) rules or parameters.

設定する-
{
設定する (せっていする) - To set, to configure, to establish
The suru-verb form of 設定, indicating the action of setting something up.

新鮮-
{
新鮮 (しんせん) - Fresh
Used for food, air, or novel ideas. It implies something is "new and vivid."

強調-

強調 (きょうちょう) - Emphasis / Stress

角度-

角度 (かくど) - Angle

拝む-

拝む (おがむ) - To worship/pray
A verb meaning to pray with hands pressed together or to look at something with deep respect. Often used for deities or sunrises.

青春-

青春 (せいしゅん) - Youth/Adolescence

込める-
{
込める (こめる) - To include, to put into (feelings, bullet, etc.)

盛り上がる-

一般的-
{
一般的 (いっぱんてき) - general, common, typical
Combination of 一般 (general) and the suffix 的 (-like) which turns nouns into na-adjectives.

殿様-

A historical title composed of 殿 (palace/mister) and 様 (honorific suffix).

庭園-

庭園 (ていえん) - Garden (especially formal or landscape)

委員会-

挑戦-

濁る-

濁る (にごる) - To become muddy/cloudy
An intransitive verb used for liquids losing transparency or voices becoming husky.

機嫌-
{
機嫌 (きげん) - Mood/temper
Refers to one's state of mind, often used with 'ii' (good) or 'warui' (bad).
Memory Tip: The 'machine/opportunity' (機) of your internal 'dislike/aversion' (嫌) controls your mood.
Example: 今日の彼女は機嫌が良い。 (きょうのかのじょはきげんがよい。)
-She is in a good mood today.
}

仏教-
{
仏教 (ぶっきょう) - Buddhism
A compound of 'Buddha' (仏) and 'teaching' (教).
Memory Tip: The person radical (亻) in 仏 represents the human nature of the Buddha's teachings.
Example: 彼は大学で仏教を学んでいる。 (かれはだいがくでぶっきょうをまなんでいる。)
-He is studying Buddhism at university.

伊勢-

伊勢 (いせ) - Ise (place name)

Example: 伊勢神宮を訪れた。 (いせじんぐうをおとずれた。)
-I visited the Ise Grand Shrine.

休暇-

正す (ただす) - To correct, to rectify

注ぐ-

注ぐ (そそぐ) - To pour, to fill

聖書 (せいしょ) - Bible, holy scripture

Memory Tip: The sun rises in the East (東) to show the way or direction (方).
Example: 東方の空が明るくなった。 (とうほうのそらがあかるくなった。)
-The eastern sky grew bright.
}

洞穴-
{
洞穴 (ほらあな) - Cave
A noun describing a natural underground chamber or grotto. It uses 洞 (cave/den) and 穴 (hole).
Memory Tip: A large den (洞) that is essentially a giant hole (穴) in the earth.
Example: 彼らは洞穴の中で雨宿りをした。 (かれらはほらあなのなかであまやどりをした。)
-They took shelter from the rain inside a cave.

販売-
{
販売 (はんばい) - Sales/Selling
A formal word for the act of selling goods. It joins 販 (marketing) with 売 (sell).
Memory Tip: Focus on the double 'selling' nuance: marketing (販) leading to the actual sale (売).
Example: この商品はオンラインで販売されている。 (このしょうひんはオンラインではんばいされている。)
-This product is being sold online.
