親父-
{
親父 (おやじ) - Father / Old man / One's dad
An informal and colloquial term used primarily by men to refer to their father or a familiar older man.
Memory Tip: A combination of the kanji for 'parent' (親) and 'father' (父) to mean 'my old man'.
Example: うちの親父は元気だ。 (うちのおやじはげんきだ。)
-My old man is doing well.

指示-
{
指示 (しじ) - instruction / indication
A noun or suru-verb that involves giving specific directions or pointing out something to be followed.

Example: 社長が指示を出す。 (しゃちょうがしじをだす。)
-The president gives instructions.

備える-
{
備える (そなえる) - To prepare, to provide for
This is a transitive Ichidan verb used for making preparations or bracing for future events and needs.
Memory Tip: Imagine a person (亻) standing by equipment (𠀐) to ensure everything is ready for a mission.
Example: 万一に備える。 (まんいちにそなえる。)
-Prepare for the worst.

親分-
{
親分 (おやぶん) - Boss / Leader
Combining 'parent' (親) and 'part/share' (分), this term refers to a leader in a hierarchical group, often with a paternal role.
Memory Tip: Think of the boss as the 'parent portion' of the group who takes care of the family.

-He is the boss of that group.

崖-

崖 (がけ) - Cliff / Precipice
A noun describing a steep, vertical rock face or the edge of a high drop-off.

逮捕-
{
逮捕 (たいほ) - arrest, capture
A noun referring to the legal act of taking someone into custody.
Memory Tip: Both kanji feature the 'hand' (扌) radical, used to grab and catch a suspect.

-The police announced the arrest of the suspect.

逮捕する-
{
逮捕する (たいほする) - to arrest
The verbal form of 'arrest', created by adding the verb 'suru' to the noun 'taiho'.
Memory Tip: Think of 'arrest' (逮捕) + 'action' (する) to describe the police catching a criminal.
Example: 警察は泥棒を逮捕しました。 (けいさつはどろぼうをたいほしました。)
-The police arrested the thief.
}

保つ-
{
保つ (たもつ) - To keep, to maintain, to preserve
A transitive Godan verb used for maintaining a state, distance, or balance.
Memory Tip: A person (亻) standing by a tree (呆/historical form) to protect and maintain it.
Example: 健康を保つために運動する。 (けんこうをたもつためにうんどうする。)
-I exercise to maintain my health.
}

台詞-
{
台詞 (せりふ) - Speech, lines (in a play), words
Originally an ateji (phonetic use of kanji). It refers to the scripted lines an actor speaks.
Memory Tip: Words (詞) spoken by someone standing on a platform or stage (台).
Example: 俳優が台詞を忘れた。 (はいゆうがせりふをわすれた。)
-The actor forgot his lines.

用いる-
{
用いる (もちいる) - To use, to utilize
A formal verb for using a tool, method, or material, often used in professional or academic contexts.

Example: 新しい技術を用いる。 (あたらしいぎじゅつをもちいる。)
-Use new technology.
}

誇る-
{
誇る (ほこる) - To be proud of, to boast
A godan verb expressing pride in achievements, history, or qualities.
Memory Tip: When you are proud, you hold (ho) your head high like a core (ko) value.
Example: 日本が誇る技術。 (にほんがほこるぎじゅつ。)
-Technology that Japan is proud of.
}

襟-
{
襟 (えり) - Collar
This noun refers to the neck part of a garment, often used in expressions about posture or attitude.
Memory Tip: The left radical is clothing (衣) and the right side is 'forbidden' (禁). Think of the collar as the boundary of clothes where the skin is forbidden from being covered.
Example: 彼は襟を正した。 (かれはえりをただした。)
-He straightened his collar.
}

皮肉-
{
皮肉 (ひにく) - Irony/Sarcasm
Originally a Buddhist term meaning 'skin and flesh,' it evolved to mean superficial or biting criticism.
Memory Tip: Sarcasm is a 'skin' (皮) and 'flesh' (肉) comment—it cuts deep and gets right under the skin.
Example: 彼は皮肉な笑みを浮かべた。 (かれはひにくなえみをうかべた。)
-He gave an ironic smile.
}

衝撃-
{
衝撃 (しょうげき) - Shock/Impact
Refers to a physical collision or a powerful emotional or social shock.
Memory Tip: 'Collision' (衝) and 'Strike' (撃). Imagine a 'car' (車) inside the character for 衝 hitting a target.
Example: そのニュースは世界に衝撃を与えた。 (そのにゅーすはせかいにしょうげきをあたえた。)
-That news gave a shock to the world.
}

袖-
{
袖 (そで) - Sleeve
The part of a garment that covers the arm. Also used in idioms regarding proximity or help.
Memory Tip: The left radical means 'clothing', and the right part looks like a hand tucked into a sleeve.
Example: 袖が濡れてしまった。 (そでがぬれてしまった。)
-My sleeve got wet.

弓-
{
弓 (ゆみ) - Bow
A noun referring to the weapon used for shooting arrows.

-He is practicing with the bow.

雄-
{
雄 (おす) - Male (animal/plant)
This term is used specifically for non-human males. The kanji can also represent 'hero' or 'bravery' in other contexts (read as 'yuu').
Memory Tip: The kanji features a radical that looks like an old man or bird wings, representing the dominant male leader of the flock.
Example: この鳥は雄です。 (このとりはおすです。)
-This bird is male.

{
〜どころか (〜どころか) - Far from... / Not just... but...
A grammar particle used to emphasize that the reality is significantly different or more extreme than a stated point.
Memory Tip: Dokoro means "place"—you are not even at that place; you are somewhere much further away.

人類-
{
人類 (じんるい) - Humanity / Mankind
Combines 人 (person) and 類 (kind/category), referring to the human species as a whole.

-Humanity has been to the moon.

背負う-

背負う (せおう) - To carry on one's back / to shoulder

展開-

展開 (てんかい) - Development / Expansion

潰す-

不満-

不満 (ふまん) - Dissatisfaction/Discontent
Consists of the prefix 'non-' (不) and 'satisfied/full' (満). It describes a state where one's desires or needs are not fully met.

{
帝国 (ていこく) - Empire

裸-
{
裸 (はだか) - Nakedness/Nude
A single kanji noun. It describes the state of being unclothed, but can also describe a bare sword or 'bare' financial facts.

自己-
{
自己 (じこ) - Self, oneself
This is a formal noun used to refer to the individual self, frequently seen in professional or academic contexts. Both kanji (自 and 己) individually mean "self."

監督-
{
監督 (かんとく) - Supervision, director, coach
A noun used for a person who oversees a group, such as a film director or a sports coach. It combines "oversee" (監) with "command" (督).

以後-
{
以後 (いご) - After this, from now on
A time-related noun/adverb that indicates a starting point in time moving forward. It combines "from/by" (以) and "after" (後).
Memory Tip: Focus on the "Go" (後) meaning after; this word marks the period "after" a specific moment.
Example: 四時以後に来てください (よじいごにきてください)

固まる-
{
固まる (かたまる) - To harden, to solidify
An intransitive verb describing the process of a liquid becoming solid or a group becoming firm in their decision. The kanji (固) represents a closed perimeter.
Memory Tip: The "Kata" sound is found in "katai" (hard), and "maru" implies forming a solid round shape.
Example: コンクリートが固まる (こんくりーとがかたまる)
-The concrete hardens.

宗教-
{
宗教 (しゅうきょう) - Religion
Combines 'sect/ancestor' (宗) with 'teaching' (教) to describe an organized belief system.
Memory Tip: Focus on the 'teaching' (教) provided by a specific ancestral 'sect' (宗).

-He is studying about religion.

装置-
{
装置 (そうち) - Device/Apparatus
Combines 'equip' (装) and 'place' (置), referring to technical equipment or mechanisms.

A noun representing a task one is required to perform based on law, social custom, or morality.

Example: 納税は国民の義務だ。(のうぜいはこくみんのぎむだ。)
-Paying taxes is a duty of the citizens.
}

取材-
{
取材 (しゅざい) - News coverage/Data collection
The act of gathering information or materials for reporting or research.
Memory Tip: 'Taking' (取) the raw 'material' (材) needed for a story.
Example: 記者が事件を取材する。 (きしゃがじけんをしゅざいする。)
-The reporter is covering the incident.
}

離婚-
{
離婚 (りこん) - Divorce
A noun or suru-verb formed by 'separate' (離) and 'marriage' (婚). It refers to the legal dissolution of marriage.
Memory Tip: Deciding to leave (離) the state of marriage (婚) forever.
Example: 両親が離婚した。(りょうしんがりこんした。)
-My parents got divorced.
}

一致する-
{
一致する (いっちする) - To match / coincide
Composed of 'one' (一) and 'reach/do' (致). It describes things coming together to become identical or unified.
Memory Tip: When two things reach (致) the same point, they become one (一).
Example: 二人の意見が一致した。(ふたりのいけんがいっちした。)
-The two opinions coincided.
}

告白-
{
告白 (こくはく) - Confession
Commonly used for confessing romantic feelings or admitting a secret or crime.
Memory Tip: To announce (告) something until the truth becomes clear/white (白).
Example: 彼女に告白する。 (かのじょにこくはくする。)
-To confess one's love to her.
}

縄-
{
縄 (なわ) - Rope
A noun referring to traditional cord or rope, often made of hemp or straw.
Memory Tip: The left side is "thread" (糸); imagine twisting many threads together to make a thick rope.
Example: 縄で荷物を縛る。(なわでにもつをしばる。)
-Tie the luggage with a rope.
}

魔力-
{
魔力 (まりょく) - Magical power
A noun describing supernatural or enchanting power, combining "magic/demon" (魔) and "power" (力).
Memory Tip: The inner "strength/power" (力) of a "demon" (魔) or sorcerer.
Example: 彼女は不思議な魔力を持っている。(かのじょはふしぎなまりょくをもっている。)
-She possesses a mysterious magical power.

恥-
{
恥 (はじ) - Shame/Embarrassment
A noun referring to a sense of dishonor, humiliation, or feeling shy/ashamed.
Memory Tip: Look at the radicals: your "ear" (耳) turns red when your "heart" (心) feels shame.
Example: 恥をかく。(はじをかく。)
-To lose face/be embarrassed.

不機嫌-
{
不機嫌 (ふきげん) - Bad mood, displeasure
An adjective/noun describing an outwardly grumpy or sullen state. It combines the negative prefix 'fu' with 'kigen' (mood).
Memory Tip: When you are 'not' (不) in a good 'mood' (機嫌), you are fukigen.
Example: 彼女は不機嫌そうだ。 (かのじょはふきげんそうだ。)
-She looks like she is in a bad mood.

畜生-
{
畜生 (ちくしょう) - Beast, brute; Damn it!
An interjection or noun derived from the Buddhist term for the realm of animals. It is used to express frustration.
Memory Tip: A 'livestock' (畜) 'living' (生) being; calling someone a beast or yelling it when things go wrong.
Example: 畜生！鍵を忘れた。 (ちくしょう！かぎをわすれた。)
-Damn it! I forgot my keys.

傾く-
{
傾く (かたむく) - To lean, to tilt, to incline
An intransitive verb used for physical objects tilting or abstract things like a business declining.
Memory Tip: The kanji contains the radical for 'head' (頁); imagine someone tilting their head to one side.
Example: 塔が少し傾いている。 (とうがすこしかたむいている。)
-The tower is leaning slightly.

構造-
{
構造 (こうぞう) - structure / construction
Combines 'construct' (構) and 'create/build' (造), used for buildings or abstract systems.
Memory Tip: To 'construct' (構) a plan to 'build' (造) a giant structure.
Example: 建物の構造を調べる。 (たてもののこうぞうをしらべる。)
-Examine the structure of the building.

雇う-
{
雇う (やとう) - to hire / to employ
A transitive verb used when a company or person takes on a new worker.
Memory Tip: Imagine a 'bird' (radical) at the 'door' (radical) looking for a job to be hired.
Example: 新しい社員を雇う。 (あたらしいしゃいんをやとう。)
-Hire a new employee.

契約-
{
契約 (けいやく) - contract, agreement
A formal noun that can become a suru-verb. It combines 'pledge' and 'promise'.
Memory Tip: A contract is a pledge (契) to keep a promise (約) in writing.
Example: 彼は契約にサインした。 (かれはけいやくにさいんした。)
-He signed the contract.

醜い-
{
醜い (みにくい) - Ugly, unsightly, shameful
An i-adjective used for physical appearance or shameful behavior. It is a homophone with 見にくい (hard to see), so kanji is vital.
Memory Tip: The kanji 醜 contains "alcohol/sake" (酉) and "ghost/demon" (鬼) - drinking too much makes one look like an ugly demon.
Example: 醜い争いはやめよう。(みにくいあらそいはやめよう。)
-Let's stop this ugly fighting.

見渡す-
{
見渡す (みわたす) - To look out over, to survey
A compound verb consisting of 見 (see) and 渡 (cross/hand over). It describes looking across a wide span of land or a crowd.
Memory Tip: Imagine your vision (見) crossing (渡) over a vast landscape from one side to the other.
Example: 山頂から街を見渡した。(さんちょうからまちをみわたした。)
-I looked out over the town from the mountain top.

成立する-
{
成立する (せいりつする) - To be established, to be formed, to materialize
Combines 成 (become) and 立 (stand). Used when a deal is struck, a law is passed, or an organization is officially formed.
Memory Tip: When something "becomes (成) and stands (立)" on its own, it has been successfully established.
Example: 交渉が成立した。(こうしょうがせいりつした。)
-The negotiations were concluded.
}

固める-
{
固める (かためる) - To harden, to freeze
A transitive verb used for making something solid or firming up a decision.
Memory Tip: Imagine putting something in a square box (the radical 囗) to make it hard (固).
Example: ゼリーを冷蔵庫で固める。 (ぜりーをれいぞうこでかためる。)

鮮やか-
{
鮮やか (あざやか) - Vivid; bright; skillful
A na-adjective describing colors that pop or a performance that is exceptionally clean/skillful.
Memory Tip: Combining 'fish' (魚) and 'sheep' (羊) results in something 'fresh' and 'vivid' in appearance.
Example: 鮮やかな色のドレス。 (あざやかないろのどれす。)
-A vividly colored dress.

環境-
{
環境 (かんきょう) - Environment
Formed by 環 (circle/ring) and 境 (border), referring to the surrounding conditions around us.

-To protect the natural environment.

大量-
{
大量 (たいりょう) - Large quantity

翌朝-
{
翌朝 (よくあさ) - Next morning
Specifically refers to the morning of the day following today or a specific date.

Example: 翌朝、早く出発した。 (よくあさはやくしゅっぱつした。)
-We departed early the next morning.

特殊-
{
特殊 (とくしゅ) - Special, unique, peculiar
This noun-adjective describes something that is out of the ordinary or technical. It is formed by 特 (special) and 殊 (particularly).

憧れる-
{
憧れる (あこがれる) - To long for, to admire, to yearn for
A verb expressing a strong desire to be like someone or to possess something, used with the particle 'ni'.

{
崩す (くずす) - To destroy, to pull down, to break (a bill)

油断-

油断 (ゆだん) - Negligence / letting one's guard down

純粋-
{
純粋 (じゅんすい) - Pure / Genuine

推理 (すいり) - reasoning, inference, deduction

{
染まる (そまる) - to be dyed, to be tainted, to be steeped in

批判する (ひはんする) - To criticize
The verb form of 批判, used when someone points out the flaws in an idea or person's actions.

完璧-

占める-
{
占める (しめる) - To occupy, to hold, to account for
An Ichidan verb used for physical space, social positions, or percentages in data.

Example: 女性が全社員の半分を占めている。 (じょせいがぜんしゃいんのはんぶんをしめている。)
-Women account for half of all employees.
}

利益-
{
利益 (りえき) - Profit, benefit, gain
A noun used for financial profit or general advantages/interests in a situation.
Memory Tip: Harvesting grain with a knife (利 - profit/utility) leads to an increase or overflow (益 - benefit).

{

Refers to the act of bearing a difficult situation or suppressing one's feelings to get through a hardship.
Memory Tip: Spicy/Hard (辛) + To Embrace (抱). You are 'embracing' a 'spicy' (hard) situation with grit.
Example: 辛抱強く待つ (しんぼうづよくまつ)
-To wait patiently
}

食糧-
{
食糧 (しょくりょう) - Food supplies, provisions
Usually refers to staple foods (like grains) stored as a resource for survival or long-term supply.
Memory Tip: Food (食) + Measured Quantity (糧). Food that is rationed or calculated for long-term use.
Example: 震災に備えて食糧を蓄える (しんさいにそなえてしょくりょうをたくわえる)
-Store food supplies in preparation for an earthquake
}

宇宙船-
{
宇宙船 (うちゅうせん) - Spaceship
A compound of 'universe/space' (宇宙) and 'ship/boat' (船).
Memory Tip: Simply a 'boat' (船) that travels through the 'universe' (宇宙).
Example: 宇宙船が月に着陸した。 (うちゅうせんがつきにちゃくりくした。)
-The spaceship landed on the moon.
}

過程-
{
過程 (かてい) - Process / Course
Refers to the mechanism or stages of a development. '過' means to pass, and '程' means extent/degree.
Memory Tip: The 'extent' (程) of what you 'pass through' (過) to reach a goal.
Example: 実験の過程を記録する。 (じっけんのかていをきろくする。)
-Record the process of the experiment.
}

緩やか-
{
緩やか (ゆるやか) - Gentle, loose, slack
This is a na-adjective often used for describing slopes, speeds, or lenient regulations.
Memory Tip: Think of 'yurusu' (to permit); a loose or gentle approach permits more freedom.
Example: 緩やかな坂道を歩く。(ゆるやかなさかみちをあるく。)
-Walking up a gentle slope.
}

明確-
{
明確 (めいかく) - Clear/Explicit
Combines 明 (bright/light) and 確 (certain/sure) to describe something that is distinct and unambiguous.
Memory Tip: When something is 'bright' and 'certain', it is perfectly clear to see.
Example: 彼の説明は非常に明確だった。 (かれのせつめいはひじょうにめいかくだった。)
-His explanation was very clear.
}

緩む-
{
緩む (ゆるむ) - To loosen
An intransitive verb describing something becoming less tight, like a knot, a belt, or even focus.
Memory Tip: The radical for 'silk/thread' (糸) suggests a string that is no longer taut.
Example: 靴紐が緩んでしまった。 (くつひもがゆるんでしまった。)
-My shoelaces have come loose.
}

制度-
{
制度 (せいど) - System/Institution
Formed by 制 (control/rule) and 度 (degree/limit). It refers to formal social or organizational systems.
Memory Tip: Rules used to 'control' (制) the 'degree' (度) of how a society functions.
Example: 新しい教育制度が始まった。 (あたらしいきょういくせいどがはじまった。)
-A new education system has begun.
}

麻-
{
麻 (あさ) - Hemp/Flax/Linen
A noun referring to plant-based fibers used for clothing or materials.
Memory Tip: Imagine fibers (林) hanging to dry inside a shed or building (广).
Example: このシャツは麻でできている。(このしゃつはあさでできている。)
-This shirt is made of linen.
}

採用-
{
採用 (さいよう) - Adoption; Hiring
Used when picking up a new plan, policy, or hiring an employee. It combines "pick up" and "use."
Memory Tip: You PICK up (採) a candidate or idea to USE (用) it for your company.
Example: 会社は新しい案を採用した。(かいしゃはあたらしいあんをさいようした。)
-The company adopted the new proposal.
}

待機-
{
待機 (たいき) - Standing by; Waiting for an opportunity
A formal word for waiting, often used in professional, medical, or technical contexts.
Memory Tip: You WAIT (待) for the right MOMENT or MACHINE (機) to be ready.
Example: 救急車が現場で待機している。(きゅうきゅうしゃがげんばでたいきしている。)
-The ambulance is standing by at the scene.
}

誘惑-
{
誘惑 (ゆうわく) - Temptation; Seduction
A noun describing the pull of something alluring that might lead one astray.
Memory Tip: To INVITE (誘) someone until they are CONFUSED (惑) by desire.
Example: 甘いものの誘惑に勝てない。(あまいもののゆうわくにかてない。)
-I can't resist the temptation of sweets.
}

誘惑する-
{
誘惑する (ゆうわくする) - To tempt; To seduce
The suru-verb form of temptation, indicating the active act of enticement.
Memory Tip: Combine INVITE (誘) and CONFUSE (惑) with the verb to DO (する).
Example: 彼は私を誘惑しようとした。(かれはわたしをゆうわくしようとした。)
-He tried to tempt me.
}

絞る-
{
絞る (しぼる) - To wring; To squeeze; To narrow down
Used physically (wringing a towel) or metaphorically (narrowing down choices or raising focus).
Memory Tip: Using a THREAD (糸) to CROSS (交) over something and squeeze it tight.
Example: 候補を三人に絞った。(こうほをさんにんにしぼった。)
-We narrowed the candidates down to three.
}

収まる-
{
収まる (おさまる) - To be settled/To fit into
An intransitive verb meaning to stay within limits, fit in a space, or for a situation to calm down.
Memory Tip: Think of placing things into a box (収) until they "settle" neatly inside.
Example: 混乱は数日で収まった。(こんらんはすうじつでおさまった。)
-The chaos settled down in a few days.
}

失望-
{
失望 (しつぼう) - Disappointment/Despair
Formed by 失 (lose) and 望 (hope). It describes the feeling when your expectations are not met.
Memory Tip: When you "lose" (失) your "hope" (望), you are left with disappointment.
Example: その結果にひどく失望した。(そのけっかにひどくしつぼうした。)
-I was deeply disappointed with the result.
}

妊娠する-
{
妊娠する (にんしんする) - To get pregnant
A suru-verb used to describe the biological state or process of conception.
Memory Tip: Both kanji contain the radical for woman (女), representing the person carrying the child.
Example: 彼女は妊娠している。 (かのじょはにんしんしている。)
-She is pregnant.
}

見逃す-
{
見逃す (みのがす) - To miss, to overlook, to let slip
A compound verb made of 見る (to see) and 逃す (to let go/miss).
Memory Tip: You "see" (見) something but you let it "escape" (逃) your attention or grasp.
Example: チャンスを見逃した。 (ちゃんすをみのがした。)
-I missed the chance.
}

右腕-
{
右腕 (みぎうで) - Right hand (man), right arm
Refers literally to the right arm or figuratively to a person's most trusted and capable assistant.
Memory Tip: Your right (右) arm (腕) is usually your strongest and most helpful limb.
Example: 彼は私の右腕だ。(かれはわたしのみぎうでだ。)
-He is my right-hand man.
}

左腕-
{
左腕 (ひだりうで) - Left arm
This noun combines the kanji for 'left' and 'arm'. It can refer to the physical limb or figuratively to a most trusted subordinate.
Memory Tip: The 'arm' kanji (腕) includes the moon radical on the left, which often represents flesh or body parts.
Example: 彼は事故で左腕を痛めた。(かれはじこでひだりうでをいためた。)
-He hurt his left arm in an accident.
}

月光-
{
月光 (げっこう) - Moonlight
A poetic and formal way to say 'moonlight', combining the kanji for 'moon' and 'light'.
Memory Tip: Simply the literal combination of moon (月) and light (光).
Example: 湖の表面が月光で輝いている。(みずうみのひょうめんがげっこうでかがやいている。)
-The surface of the lake is shining in the moonlight.

液体-
{
液体 (えきたい) - Liquid
A scientific term combining 'fluid/juice' and 'body/state'. It describes the state of matter between solid and gas.
Memory Tip: The kanji 液 contains the water radical (氵), signaling that it relates to a fluid state.
Example: この容器には透明な液体が入っている。(このようきにはとうめいなえきたいがはいっている。)
-There is a transparent liquid in this container.

実力-
{
実力 (じつりょく) - True ability
This noun combines 'truth' and 'power' to describe actual competence as opposed to status or theory.

-He demonstrated his true ability.

一流-
{
一流 (いちりゅう) - First-class

{
精一杯 (せいいっぱい) - With all one's might; to the best of one's ability

伝統-

体内 (たいない) - Inside the body

講義-

講義 (こうぎ) - Lecture

溝-
{
溝 (みぞ) - Ditch/Groove/Gap

敏感 (びんかん) - Sensitive/Susceptible

敗れる-
{
敗れる (やぶれる) - To be defeated/beaten
An intransitive Ichidan verb used when losing a game, war, or competition. Do not confuse with the homophone for "to tear."
Memory Tip: The left side of 敗 is "money" (貝). When your money is struck (攵) and gone, you have been defeated.
Example: 試合に敗れる。 (しあいにやぶれる。)
-To be defeated in a match.

鍛える-
{
鍛える (きたえる) - To train/forge/discipline
A transitive Ichidan verb used for forging metal or, more commonly, training the body or mind.

-I train my body every day.

強盗-

強盗 (ごうとう) - Robbery / Robber

子孫-
{
子孫 (しそん) - descendants, offspring
Composed of 子 (child) and 孫 (grandchild), representing a lineage moving forward through generations.

渋い-
{
渋い (しぶい) - astringent, bitter, refined/understated

獲得-
{
獲得 (かくとく) - acquisition, possession, winning
A suru-verb consisting of 獲 (seize) and 得 (gain), typically used for obtaining prizes or rights.
Memory Tip: Kaku (write) to Toku (obtain virtue) — you must work and record your efforts to "acquire" a win.
Example: 彼は金メダルを獲得した。 (かれは きんめだるを かくとくした。)
-He won a gold medal.

逃亡-
{
逃亡 (とうぼう) - Escape, flight
A formal noun or suru-verb combining 逃 (run away) and 亡 (perish/disappear), often used for fugitives.

刑務所 (けいむしょ) - Prison

敗北 (はいぼく) - Defeat

{

Example: 地面の振動を感じる。 (じめんのしんどうをかんじる。)
-I feel the vibration of the ground.
}

論文-
{
論文 (ろんぶん) - Thesis, paper
Refers to an academic dissertation, scientific paper, or formal essay based on research.
Memory Tip: Logic/Argument (論) + Writing/Sentence (文) = A piece of writing based on logic.
Example: 卒業論文を書き終えた。 (そつぎょうろんぶんをかきおえた。)
-I finished writing my graduation thesis.

側面-
{
側面 (そくめん) - Side, aspect
Refers to the physical side of an object or a non-physical dimension/facet of a complex situation.

Example: この問題には別の側面もある。 (このもんだいにはべつのそくめんもある。)

軍艦-

軍艦 (ぐんかん) - Warship

Example: 港に巨大な軍艦が停泊している。 (みなとにきょだいなぐんかんがていはくしている。)

見返す-
{
見返す (みかえす) - To look back, triumph over
A compound verb meaning to look back again, or more figuratively, to show someone up by succeeding.

採る-

裏口 (うらぐち) - Back door / rear entrance

防御-

防御 (ぼうぎょ) - Defense / protection

決 (けつ) - Decision / vote

{
避難 (ひなん) - Evacuation
A noun referring to taking shelter or escaping danger. It uses 'avoid' (避) and 'difficulty/hardship' (難).
Memory Tip: To avoid (避) a difficult (難) disaster situation by leaving.
Example: 地震のときは避難が必要です。 (じしんのときはひなんがひつようです)
-Evacuation is necessary during an earthquake.
}

避難する-
{
避難する (ひないする) - To evacuate
The suru-verb version of 'evacuation', used when people actively move to a safe location.
Memory Tip: The action (する) of avoiding (避) the danger (難).
Example: 公園に避難する。 (こうえんにひなんする)
-To evacuate to the park.
}

目玉-
{
目玉 (めだま) - Eyeball / Main attraction
Literally 'eye ball'. In a commercial context, it refers to a centerpiece or a featured item that 'catches the eye'.
Memory Tip: A round ball (玉) for the eye (目) that stares at the best deals.
Example: この商品の目玉は安さだ。 (このしょうひんのめだまはやすさだ)
-The main attraction of this product is its low price.
}

吹き込む-
{
吹き込む (ふきこむ) - To breathe into/To record/To instill
A compound verb combining 'blow' and 'into.' It can mean physically blowing air, recording audio, or instilling ideas into someone's mind.
Memory Tip: 'Blow' (吹) an idea or sound deep 'into' (込む) a person or device.
Example: 留守電にメッセージを吹き込む。(るすでんにめっせーじをふきこむ。)
-Record a message on the answering machine.
}

損害-
{
損害 (そんがい) - Damage/Loss
Consists of 'loss' and 'harm.' It specifically refers to physical, financial, or material damage rather than emotional feelings.
Memory Tip: When you 'lose' (損) something because of 'harm' (害), the result is damage.
Example: 台風で大きな損害が出た。(たいふうでおおきなそんがいがでた。)
-The typhoon caused great damage.
}

損害する-
{
損害する (そんがいする) - To damage/To cause loss
The verbal form of 'damage.' While 'songai o ataeru' is more common, this verb form emphasizes the act of inflicting harm or financial loss.
Memory Tip: To actively 'do' (する) something that causes 'loss' (損) and 'harm' (害).
Example: 会社の利益を損害する行為。(かいしゃのりえきをそんがいするこうい。)
-An act that damages the company's profits.
}

引退-
{
引退 (いんたい) - retirement (from a position/career)
Combines 引 (pull/draw) and 退 (retreat/withdraw).
Memory Tip: To pull (引) oneself back and retreat (退) from professional life.
Example: 彼はプロ野球を引退した。 (かれはぷろやきゅうをいんたいした。)
-He retired from professional baseball.
}

限定-
{
限定 (げんてい) - Limitation, restriction
A noun or suru-verb often used to describe limited editions or restricted scopes of time and space.
Memory Tip: A 'limit' (限) that is 'fixed' (定) into a specific boundary.
Example: この商品は地域限定です (このしょうひんはちいきげんていです)
-This product is limited to this region.
}

上級-
{
上級 (じょうきゅう) - Advanced level, high grade
A noun used to categorize levels of skill or position, specifically the highest tiers.
Memory Tip: Literally 'upper' (上) 'grade/rank' (級), indicating someone at the top of their field.
Example: 彼女は上級のクラスに所属している (かのじょはじょうきゅうのくらすにしょぞくしている)
-She belongs to an advanced class.
}

仮定-
{
仮定 (katei) - Assumption, hypothesis
A noun or suru-verb used when setting up a theoretical premise or a 'what-if' scenario.
Memory Tip: A 'temporary' (仮) 'fix' (定) of a situation used for the sake of argument.
Example: それが事実だと仮定してみよう (それがじじつだとかていしてみよう)
-Let's assume that it is a fact.
}

活気-
{
活気 (かっき) - Liveliness, energy, vigor
A noun describing the animated or energetic atmosphere of a place or a group.
Memory Tip: The 'spirit/energy' (気) of being 'lively/active' (活).
Example: その市場は活気に溢れている (そのいちばはかっきにあふれている)
-That market is overflowing with energy.
}

昆虫-
{
昆虫 (こんちゅう) - Insect, bug
The formal, scientific term for insects, generally used in academic or nature contexts.
Memory Tip: Think of a 'multitude' (昆) of 'bugs' (虫) crawling together.
Example: 弟は昆虫を採集するのが好きだ (おとうとはこんちゅうをさいしゅうするのがすきだ)
-My younger brother likes collecting insects.
}

製作-
{
製作 (せいさく) - Production/Creation
Refers to the process of making things like films, art pieces, or furniture.
Memory Tip: 製 (manufacture) + 作 (make). Think of it as professional crafting or industrial creation.
Example: 新しい映画の製作が始まった (あたらしいえいがのせいさくがはじまった)
-Production of the new movie has begun.
}

容疑-
{
容疑 (ようぎ) - Suspicion/Charge
Legal term referring to the suspicion of having committed a crime; used for suspects.
Memory Tip: 容 (contain/form) + 疑 (doubt). It is the "form of doubt" cast upon a person.
Example: 彼は殺人の容疑で逮捕された (かれはさつじんのようぎでたいほされた)
-He was arrested on suspicion of murder.
}

無謀-
{
無謀 (むぼう) - Reckless/Rash
Describes an action taken without thinking or planning, often being dangerous.
Memory Tip: 無 (without) + 謀 (strategy/plan). Doing something without a plan is reckless.
Example: 無謀な挑戦は控えるべきだ (むぼうなちょうせんはひかえるべきだ)
-You should refrain from reckless challenges.
}

変態-
{
変態 (へんたい) - Transformation/Pervert
Biologically means metamorphosis; colloquially refers to abnormal sexual behavior or a pervert.
Memory Tip: 変 (change) + 態 (state/condition). A change in state or a "weird state" of mind.
Example: 蝶は変態を繰り返す (ちょうはへんたいをくりかえす)
-Butterflies undergo metamorphosis.
}

支援-
{
支援 (しえん) - Support/Aid
A noun referring to providing help, resources, or backup to someone in need.
Memory Tip: 支 (support) + 援 (assist). Both kanji have the 'hand' radical, implying a helping hand.
Example: 被災地に支援を送る (ひさいちにしえんをおくる)
-Send support to the disaster-stricken areas.
}

支援する-
{
支援する (しえんする) - To support/To assist
The verb form of 'shien', meaning to actively give aid or provide backup.
Memory Tip: Imagine using your 'hands' (radicals in both kanji) to actively help a friend.
Example: 彼の活動を支援する (かれのかつどうをしえんする)
-I support his activities.
}

承認-
{
承認 (しょうにん) - Approval/Recognition
Refers to formally accepting or authorizing something as valid or true.
Memory Tip: 承 (accept) + 認 (recognize). Officially recognizing and accepting a request.
Example: 上司の承認が必要だ (じょうしのしょうにんがひつようだ)
-The boss's approval is necessary.
}

各自-
{
各自 (かくじ) - Each/Everyone
Used to address people individually within a group, often in instructions.
Memory Tip: 各 (each) + 自 (self). Literally means "each self" or "everyone for themselves."
Example: 各自、お弁当を持参してください (かくじ、おべんとうをじさんしてください)
-Each of you, please bring your own lunch.
}

閉鎖-
{
閉鎖 (へいさ) - Closing/Shutdown
Used for the closing of facilities, buildings, or the ending of a service.
Memory Tip: 閉 (close) + 鎖 (chain/lock). To shut the gate and chain it up.
Example: その工場は閉鎖された (そのこうじょうはへいさされた)
-That factory was closed down.
}

名簿-
{
名簿 (めいぼ) - Register/Name list
A document or digital file containing a list of names (e.g., student roster).
Memory Tip: 名 (name) + 簿 (ledger/record). A record dedicated to names.
Example: 出席者の名簿を作成する (しゅっせきしゃのめいぼをさくせいする)
-Create a name list of the attendees.
}

走行-
{
走行 (そうこう) - Running/Traveling
Combines 走 (run) and 行 (go), usually referring to vehicle movement on a road.
Memory Tip: A vehicle "running" and "going" along its path.
Example: 車は高速道路を走行している。 (くるまはこうそくどうろをそうこうしている。)
-The car is traveling on the highway.
}

客観的-
{
客観的 (きゃっかんてき) - Objective
Combines 客 (guest/visitor), 観 (view), and 的 (-like).
Memory Tip: Seeing things from a "guest's" (客) "viewpoint" (観) rather than your own.
Example: 客観的な意見が必要です。 (きゃっかんてきないけんがひつようです。)
-An objective opinion is necessary.
}

典型的-
{
典型的 (てんけいてき) - Typical
Combines 典 (standard), 型 (mold), and 的 (-ish).
Memory Tip: Following a "standard" (典) "mold" (型) makes it "typical".
Example: これは典型的な日本の家です。 (これはてんけいてきなにほんのいえです。)
-This is a typical Japanese house.
}

粘る-
{
粘る (ねばる) - To be sticky, to persist
A godan verb that describes literal physical stickiness or the metaphorical quality of being tenacious and refusing to give up.
Memory Tip: Think of natto; it is physically sticky, and just like that, a persistent person "sticks" to their goal.
Example: 最後まで粘って勝った。(さいごまでねばってかった。)
-He persisted until the end and won.
}

家政婦-
{
家政婦 (かせいふ) - Housekeeper, maid
Composed of 家 (house), 政 (administration), and 婦 (woman). It literally means a woman who administers the household.
Memory Tip: A woman (婦) who handles the politics or administration (政) of the home (家).
Example: 家政婦が家を掃除した。(かせいふがいえをそうじした。)
-The housekeeper cleaned the house.

講師-
{
講師 (こうし) - Lecturer, instructor
Combines 講 (lecture) and 師 (master/teacher), typically used for guest speakers or part-time teachers.
Memory Tip: A master (師) who specializes in giving a lecture (講).
Example: 有名な作家が講師として招かれた。 (ゆうめいなさっかがこうしとしてまねかれた。)
-A famous author was invited as a lecturer.

一遍に-
{
一遍に (いっぺんに) - All at once / simultaneously
An adverb used when multiple actions or events happen at the same time or in a single stroke. '一' means one and '遍' means occurrence.
Memory Tip: Doing everything in one (一) single pass (遍).

-I finished all my homework at once.

火災-
{
火災 (かさい) - Conflagration / fire disaster

Memory Tip: A fire (火) that turns into a disaster (災).
Example: ビルで火災が発生した。 (びるでかさいがはっせいした。)
-A fire broke out in the building.

儲かる-

儲かる (もうかる) - To be profitable / to yield profit
An intransitive verb used when a business or action results in making money.

-This business is profitable.

聖地-
{
聖地 (せいち) - Sacred ground / holy land
A noun used for religious sites or, colloquially, locations significant to fans of media (anime, movies). '聖' is holy and '地' is land.
Memory Tip: Land (地) that is holy (聖).
Example: 多くの巡礼者が聖地を訪れる。 (おおくのじゅんれいしゃがせいちをおとずれる。)

夕刊-
{
夕刊 (ゆうかん) - Evening paper
A noun referring to the edition of a newspaper published in the afternoon/evening. '夕' means evening and '刊' means publication.

Example: 夕刊がポストに届いた。 (ゆうかんがぽすとにとどいた。)
-The evening paper arrived in the mailbox.

経由-
{
経由 (けいゆ) - Via / by way of
A noun or Suru-verb used to describe a route passing through a specific point. '経' means passage/sutra and '由' means reason/origin.
Memory Tip: Passage (経) originating (由) through a certain point.
Example: ロンドン経由でパリに行く。 (ろんどんけいゆでぱりにいく。)
-I am going to Paris via London.

徹夜-
{
徹夜 (てつや) - All-night; staying up all night
This word combines 徹 (penetrate/pierce) and 夜 (night), describing the act of staying awake from sunset to sunrise.
Memory Tip: You pierce (徹) right through the night (夜) until the sun comes up.
Example: 徹夜で勉強した。 (てつやでべんきょうした。)
-I stayed up all night studying.
}

条約-
{
条約 (じょうやく) - Treaty; pact
Composed of 条 (article/clause) and 約 (promise/contract), used for formal international agreements.
Memory Tip: A promise (約) made of many written articles (条).
Example: 両国は平和条約を結んだ。 (りょうこくはへいわじょうやくをむすんだ。)
-The two countries signed a peace treaty.

垂直-
{
垂直 (すいちょく) - Vertical; perpendicular
Combines 垂 (hang/dangle) and 直 (straight). It describes a line that is perfectly upright.
Memory Tip: Think of a weighted string hanging (垂) straight (直) down.
Example: この壁は地面に対して垂直だ。 (このかべはじめんたいしてすいちょくだ。)
-This wall is vertical to the ground.

延長-
{
延長 (えんちょう) - Extension; elongation
Combines 延 (prolong) and 長 (long). It refers to making something longer in time or space.
Memory Tip: To stretch out (延) the length (長) of something.
Example: 試合は延長戦に入った。 (しあいはえんちょうせんにはいった。)
-The match went into overtime (an extended round).
}

延長する-
{
延長する (えんちょうする) - To extend; to prolong
The verb form of 延長, often used for deadlines, time limits, or physical lengths.
Memory Tip: The action (する) of making the length (長) be prolonged (延).
Example: 滞在を一日延長する。 (たいざいをいちにちえんちょうする。)
-I will extend my stay by one day.

船員-
{
船員 (せんいん) - Sailor; crewman

不正 (ふせい) - Injustice; unfairness; illegality

蒸気-

蒸気 (じょうき) - Steam; vapor

凹む-

異性 (いせい) - Opposite sex
Combines 異 (different/strange) and 性 (gender/sex). It refers to people of a gender different from one's own.
Memory Tip: Focus on the "different" (異) "gender" (性).
Example: 彼は異性にとてもモテる。 (かれはいせいにとてももてる。)
-He is very popular with the opposite sex.
}

垣根-
{
垣根 (かきね) - Fence/Hedge
Refers to a boundary marker, often a natural hedge or a simple wooden fence around a property.
Memory Tip: 垣 (hedge) + 根 (root). A fence made of living things with roots.
Example: 隣との間に垣根がある。 (となりとのあいだにかきねがある。)
-There is a hedge between us and the neighbor.
}

情け-
{
情け (なさけ) - Compassion / Mercy / Pity
A noun describing the quality of having a warm, empathetic heart toward those in distress.
Memory Tip: The heart (忄) radical paired with 'blue/purity' (青) suggests pure, deep human feeling.
Example: 情けをかける。(なさけをかける。)
-To show mercy.
}

双眼鏡-
{
双眼鏡 (そうがんきょう) - Binoculars
A compound of 'pair' (双), 'eye' (眼), and 'mirror/lens' (鏡).
Memory Tip: Think of a pair (双) of eyes (眼) looking through mirrored lenses (鏡).
Example: 双眼鏡で鳥を観察する。 (そうがんきょうでとりをかんさつする。)
-Observe birds with binoculars.
}

裕福-
{
裕福 (ゆうふく) - Wealthy
This is a na-adjective meaning affluent or well-off, combining 'abundant' (裕) and 'fortune' (福).
Memory Tip: When your fortune (福) is abundant and provides leisure (裕), you are wealthy.
Example: 彼はとても裕福な家庭で育った。 (かれはとてもゆうふくなかていでそだった。)
-He grew up in a very wealthy family.
}

診断-
{
診断 (しんだん) - Diagnosis
A noun formed by 'medical examination' (診) and 'judgment/decision' (断).
Memory Tip: After an exam (診), the doctor gives a final decision or judgment (断) on your health.
Example: 医者の診断を仰ぐ。 (いしゃのしんだんをあおぐ。)
-Seek a doctor's diagnosis.
}

診断する-
{
診断する (しんだんする) - To diagnose
The suru-verb version of 'diagnosis', used when a professional identifies a medical condition.
Memory Tip: Just add 'suru' (to do) to the noun for diagnosis to perform the act of diagnosing.
Example: 医師は彼を風邪と診断した。 (いしはかれをかぜとしんだんした。)
-The doctor diagnosed him with a cold.
}

平安-
{
平安 (へいあん) - Peace/Tranquility
A noun or na-adjective combining 'flat/even' (平) and 'safe/quiet' (安). It also names a famous era of Japanese history.
Memory Tip: When things are flat (平) without obstacles and you feel safe (安), you are at peace.
Example: 心の平安を保つ。 (こころのへいあんをたもつ。)
-Maintain peace of mind.
}

怪談-
{
怪談 (かいだん) - Ghost story
Consists of 'mysterious' (怪) and 'talk' (談), referring to traditional Japanese supernatural tales.
Memory Tip: Think of 'mysterious talk' (怪談) often told on the 'stairs' (kaidan - 階段).
Example: 夏の夜に怪談を話す。 (なつのよにかいだんをはなす。)
-Telling ghost stories on a summer night.
}

鉱山-
{
鉱山 (こうざん) - Mine
Combines 鉱 (mineral/ore) and 山 (mountain), literally meaning a mountain where minerals are extracted.
Memory Tip: Imagine a mountain (山) filled with valuable minerals (鉱).
Example: その鉱山は閉鎖されました。(そのこうざんはへいさされました。)
-That mine was closed.
}

分離-
{
分離 (ぶんり) - Separation
This is a noun or suru-verb used for the detachment of physical components or abstract groups.
Memory Tip: To 'divide' (分) and 'detach' (離) creates a separation.
Example: 油と水を分離する (あぶらとみずをぶんりする)
-To separate oil and water
}

多忙-
{
多忙 (たぼう) - Very busy
A formal na-adjective often used in business or polite writing to mean extremely busy.
Memory Tip: When you have 'many' (多) tasks, your heart and mind feel 'busy' (忙).
Example: 先生は多忙のため欠席です (せんせいはたぼうのためけっせきです)
-The professor is absent due to being very busy
}

続々-
{
続々 (ぞくぞく) - One after another / Successively
An adverb formed by repeating the kanji for 'continue' (続), indicating a continuous stream of people or events.
Memory Tip: When things 'Continue' (続) and 'Continue' again (々), they arrive one after another.
Example: 新製品が続々と発表された。 (しんせいひんがぞくぞくとはっぴょうされた。)
-New products were announced one after another.

感染-
{
感染 (かんせん) - Infection / Contagion
Refers to the contraction of a disease or the spreading of an influence/emotion.
Memory Tip: You 'Feel' (感) a germ 'Dyeing' (染) or staining your body with illness.
Example: 風邪が家族に感染した。 (かぜがかぞくにかんせんした。)
-The cold infected the whole family.
}

再建-
{
再建 (さいけん) - Reconstruction
Often used for rebuilding structures, organizations, or finances after a collapse or disaster.

Example: 寺院の再建が始まった (じいんのさいけんがはじまった)
-The reconstruction of the temple has begun.
}

仏壇-
{
仏壇 (ぶつだん) - Buddhist altar
A household altar used to honor ancestors in Japanese Buddhist tradition.

Example: 仏壇に花を供える (ぶつだんにはなをそなえる)

}

一貫-
{
一貫 (いっかん) - Consistency, coherence
一貫 describes something that is consistent or remains the same from beginning to end.

Example: 彼の態度は最初から一貫している。 (かれはたいどはさいしょからいっかんしている。)
-His attitude has been consistent from the beginning.
}

開拓-
{
開拓 (かいたく) - Reclamation, cultivation, pioneering
開拓 means to open up new land for farming or to break ground in new markets or fields.
Memory Tip: Open (開) the wild land and expand (拓) your territory.
Example: 新しい市場を開拓する必要がある。 (あたらしいしじょうをかいたくするひつようがある。)
-It is necessary to develop new markets.
}

依頼人-
{
依頼人 (いらいにん) - Client
依頼人 specifically refers to a person who requests a service, often from a professional like a lawyer.
Memory Tip: A person (人) who makes a formal request (依頼) for professional help.
Example: 弁護士は依頼人と打ち合わせをした。 (べんごしはいらいにんとうちあわせをした。)
-The lawyer had a meeting with the client.

総合-
{
総合 (そうごう) - Synthesis / Comprehensive / Coordination
Refers to putting different parts together to form a whole or viewing something broadly.
Memory Tip: Taking the total (総) parts and making them fit/combine (合) together.
Example: 総合病院で検査を受けた。 (そうごうびょういんでけんさをうけた。)
-I had a check-up at a general hospital.

嫌味-
{
嫌味 (いやみ) - Sarcasm / Disagreeable remark
Refers to snide, sarcastic, or boastful comments that leave an unpleasant impression.
Memory Tip: A remark that leaves a dislikable (嫌) taste (味) in the listener's mouth.
Example: 彼は嫌味を言うのが得意だ。 (かれはいやみをいうのがとくいだ。)
-He is good at making sarcastic remarks.

運河-
{
運河 (うんが) - Canal
A compound noun referring to a man-made waterway. It consists of 'transport' (運) and 'river' (河).
Memory Tip: An artificial 'river' (河) designed specifically to 'transport' (運) goods by ship.
Example: パナマ運河は有名です。 (ぱなまうんがはゆうめいです。)
-The Panama Canal is famous.

睡眠薬-
{
睡眠薬 (すいみんやく) - Sleeping pill
A compound noun consisting of 'sleep' (睡眠) and 'medicine' (薬).
Memory Tip: Simply the 'medicine' (薬) used to induce 'sleep' (睡眠).
Example: 眠れないので睡眠薬を飲んだ。 (ねむれないのですいみんやくをのんだ。)
-I took a sleeping pill because I couldn't sleep.

克服-
{
克服 (こくふく) - Overcoming
A suru-verb used for overcoming hurdles, illnesses, or personal weaknesses. It combines 'conquer' (克) and 'submit/clothes' (服).
Memory Tip: To 'conquer' (克) a challenge and make it 'submit' (服) to your will.
Example: 弱点を克服するために練習する。 (じゃくてんをこくふくするためにれんしゅうする。)
-I practice to overcome my weaknesses.
}

克服する-
{
克服する (こくふくする) - to overcome / to conquer
This is a Suru-verb used for overcoming difficulties, illnesses, or personal weaknesses. It implies a struggle that was successfully dealt with.
Memory Tip: 克 (overcome) + 服 (submit). Imagine forcing a difficult situation to "submit" to your will.
Example: 彼は病気を克服した。 (かれはびょうきをこくふくした。)
-He overcame his illness.

衛星-
{
衛星 (えいせい) - satellite
Refers to both natural celestial bodies (like the moon) and man-made artificial satellites.

-The moon is a natural satellite of the Earth.

達人-
{
達人 (たつじん) - master / expert
Refers to someone who has reached the highest level of proficiency in a specific craft, art, or skill.

Example: 彼は料理の達人だ。 (かれはりょうりのたつじんだ。)
-He is a master of cooking.

省く-
{
省く (はぶく) - To omit; to skip; to curtail
A transitive Godan verb used when removing unnecessary details or parts to save time or effort. It is often used in technical or formal contexts.
Memory Tip: The kanji 省 combines 'few' (少) and 'eye' (目). Use your eyes to keep things few and simple by omitting the extra.
Example: 説明を省きます。 (せつめいをはぶきます。)
-I will omit the explanation.
}

移住-
{
移住 (いじゅう) - Migration; immigration; moving
A noun/suru-verb referring to changing one's place of residence, often on a large scale or across borders. It combines 'shift' (移) and 'dwell' (住).
Memory Tip: You 'shift' (移) where you 'dwell' (住) permanently when you migrate.
Example: 彼は海外へ移住しました。 (かれはかいがいへいじゅうしました。)
-He migrated abroad.

普及-
{
普及 (ふきゅう) - Diffusion; spread; popularization
This suru-verb describes the process of a product, technology, or idea becoming widespread and used by the general public. It uses 'universal' (普) and 'reach/extend' (及).
Memory Tip: When something becomes 'popular' (普及), its reach 'extends' (及) 'universally' (普).
Example: インターネットが普及しました。 (いんたーねっとがふきゅうしました。)
-The internet has become widespread.

曲線-
{
曲線 (きょくせん) - Curve, curved line
This noun describes any non-straight line, used in math, art, or to describe the physical shape of roads.

Example: この道路は曲線が多い。 (このどうろはきょくせんがおおい。)
-This road has many curves.

遺伝-
{
遺伝 (いでん) - Heredity / Inheritance
Consists of 遺 (leave behind/bequeath) and 伝 (transmit), describing the biological transmission of traits through generations.
Memory Tip: Leaving (遺) traits behind to be transmitted (伝) down the family line.

-Eye color is determined by heredity.

原子-
{
原子 (げんし) - Atom
Combines 原 (origin/source) with 子 (particle/child), denoting the most fundamental source particle of matter.
Memory Tip: The "original (原) tiny particle (子)" that forms the building block of everything.
Example: 水の分子は二つの水素原子を含む。 (みずのぶんしはふたつのすいそげんしをふくむ。)

指揮者-
{
指揮者 (しきしゃ) - Conductor / Leader
Combines 指 (finger/point), 揮 (wield/brandish), and 者 (person), most commonly used for an orchestra conductor.

-He is a famous conductor.

大幅-
{
大幅 (おおはば) - Drastic, substantial, big scale
Combines 'big' (大) and 'width/breadth' (幅) to describe a wide margin of change.
Memory Tip: If the 'width' (幅) of a change is 'big' (大), the change is substantial.
Example: 予算を大幅に削減した。 (よさんをおおはばにさくげんした。)
-We reduced the budget drastically.

西瓜-
{
西瓜 (すいか) - Watermelon
Written with characters meaning 'west' and 'gourd', reflecting its historical introduction from the west into Asia.
Memory Tip: Think of the watermelon as the giant melon (瓜) that traveled from the west (西).
Example: 夏に冷たい西瓜を食べるのが好きだ。 (なつにつめたいすいかをたべるのがすきだ。)

勝敗-

勝敗 (しょうはい) - Victory or defeat

投資-

近年-
{
近年 (きんねん) - In recent years
A formal temporal noun referring to the last few years leading up to the present. It combines 'near' (近) and 'year' (年).
Memory Tip: Focus on the 'years' (年) that are 'near' (近) to today on the timeline.

-In recent years, prices have been rising.

裸足-

裸足 (はだし) - Barefoot
A combination of 裸 (naked) and 足 (foot). Note the unique reading where the two characters blend together.

統合-
{
統合 (とうごう) - Integration / Unification
Combines 統 (unite/rule) and 合 (fit/join). It refers to merging separate entities, organizations, or systems into a single whole.

高等-
{
高等 (こうとう) - high-grade

-Advanced technology is required.

消化-
{
消化 (しょうか) - Digestion, consumption

Memory Tip: To consume/extinguish (消) food and change (化) it into energy for your body.

{
消化する (しょうかする) - To digest

劇的-

廃止-

近隣-

近隣 (きんりん) - Neighborhood/vicinity

木材-

気象-

気象 (きしょう) - weather, atmospheric phenomena

憎らしい-

憎らしい (にくらしい) - Odious, hateful, annoying

訳者-

草木-
{
草木 (くさき) - Plants and trees
A compound noun literalizing its components: "grass" (草) and "tree" (木). It encompasses all vegetation.

伝統的-
{
伝統적 (でんとうてき) - Traditional
Formed by adding the suffix 的 (teki) to 伝統 (tradition), turning it into a na-adjective.

進撃-

進撃 (しんげき) - Advance, charge, offensive

雑音-

雑音 (ざつおん) - Noise, static, interference

おしよせる - To surge/To push forward in great numbers

あざむく-
{
あざむく - To deceive/To trick
A verb for deliberately misleading or tricking someone, often with cunning or malicious intent.

Example: 彼は王をあざむいて城に入った。 (かれはおうをあざむいてしろにはいった。)

くすぶる-
{
くすぶる - To smolder/To simmer
A verb describing something burning slowly without flame, or a feeling of discontent quietly building inside.
Memory Tip: 'Kusuburu' — imagine something 'cushy' and 'blurry' with smoke — smoldering slowly.
Example: 火はまだくすぶっていた。 (ひはまだくすぶっていた。)
-The fire was still smoldering.
}

しばたたく-
{
しばたたく - To blink repeatedly
A verb describing the rapid, repeated blinking of the eyes, often from shock, dust, or bright light.
Memory Tip: 'Shiba' (a little bit) + 'tataku' (to tap) — to 'tap' your eyelids rapidly, again and again.
Example: 明るい光にしばたたいた。 (あかるいひかりにしばたたいた。)
-I blinked repeatedly in the bright light.
}

おかくれになる-
{
おかくれになる - To pass away (honorific)
A highly formal, respectful phrase used exclusively for the death of royalty or nobility.
Memory Tip: 'Okakure' means 'to become hidden' — a gentle way of saying the person has hidden themselves from the world forever.
Example: 王はおかくれになった。 (おうはおかくれになった。)
-The king passed away.
}

〜剤-
{
〜剤 (〜ざい) - agent; drug; medicine
A common suffix used to categorize types of medicines, chemical agents, or substances.
Memory Tip: The kanji 斉 means 'orderly' or 'together'; think of medicine as a substance that brings order back to the body.
Example: 彼は強力な洗剤を使った。(かれはきょうりょくなせんざいをつかった。)
-He used a powerful detergent.
}

脚本-
{
脚本 (きゃくほん) - script; screenplay
The written text of a play, film, or broadcast, serving as the foundational document for production.
Memory Tip: 脚 (leg/base) + 本 (book). The script is the 'book' that gives the play its 'legs' or foundation.
Example: この映画の脚本は素晴らしい。(このえいがのきゃくほんはすばらしい。)
-The script of this movie is wonderful.
}

褒美-
{
褒美 (ほうび) - reward; prize
A reward given for good deeds, hard work, or achievements; frequently used as 'gohoubi'.
Memory Tip: 褒 (praise) + 美 (beauty). A beautiful gift given as a sign of praise for your hard work.
Example: 優勝した褒美に時計をもらった。(ゆうしょうしたほうびにとけいをもらった。)
-I received a watch as a reward for winning the championship.
}

防止-
{
防止 (ぼうし) - Prevention, check
A noun/suru-verb referring to stopping something negative before it occurs. It uses 防 (defend/prevent) and 止 (stop).
Memory Tip: You defend (防) against a problem to stop (止) it from happening.
Example: 事故を防止する。 (じこをぼうしする。)
-To prevent accidents.
}

効率-
{
効率 (こうりつ) - Efficiency
A noun describing the ratio of useful work performed to resources used. It combines 効 (effect/efficacy) and 率 (ratio/rate).
Memory Tip: Efficiency is the rate (率) at which you can produce an effect (効).
Example: 効率よく作業する。 (こうりつよくさぎょうする。)
-To work efficiently.
}

有罪-
{
有罪 (ゆうざい) - guilty
A noun representing the state of having committed a crime, often used in legal contexts.
Memory Tip: Simply 'possessing' (有) 'guilt/crime' (罪) on your record.
Example: 被告人に有罪の判決が下った。 (ひこくにんにゆうざいのはんけつがくだった。)
-A guilty verdict was handed down to the defendant.
}

近代的-
{
近代的 (きんだいてき) - Modern
This word combines 近代 (modern era) with the suffix 的 to turn it into a na-adjective meaning modern-style.
Memory Tip: Near (近) + Generation (代) + Attribute (的な) = belonging to the most recent generation.
Example: 近代的なビルが立ち並んでいる。 (きんだいてきなびるがたちならんでいる。)
-Modern buildings are lined up.

伝記-
{
伝記 (でんき) - Biography
A noun meaning a written account of a person's life and achievements.
Memory Tip: To transmit or report (伝) the records (記) of a person's life history.
Example: 彼は偉人の伝記をよく読む。 (かれはいじんのでんきをよくよむ。)
-He often reads biographies of great people.

申請-
{
申請 (しんせい) - Application/Petition
Formed by 申 (to say/report) and 請 (request), this is used specifically for formal administrative procedures.
Memory Tip: Reporting (申) a formal request (請) to an authority or office.

中毒-
{
中毒 (ちゅうどく) - Poisoning/Addiction

Memory Tip: Having poison (毒) inside (中) your system results in toxic poisoning or addiction.

言葉遣い (ことばづかい) - wording, manner of speech
Combines 'words' (言葉) with 'usage/handling' (遣い). It refers to one's choice of words and level of politeness.

模型-
{
模型 (もけい) - model / scale model
Used for physical imitations like plastic kits or architectural mock-ups, combining 模 (imitation) and 型 (mold).

不完全-
{
不完全 (ふかんぜん) - Incomplete / Imperfect
A 'na-adjective' describing something that is not whole or has flaws.

Example: その計画はまだ不完全だ。(そのけいかくはまだふかんぜんだ。)

{
鈍感 (どんかん) - Insensitive/thick-skinned
This noun-adjective describes someone lacking sensitivity or slow to notice social cues. It combines the characters for "dull" and "feeling."
Memory Tip: Think of a "dull" (鈍) "feeling" (感) that makes someone thick-skinned and unaware.

自立-
{
自立 (じりつ) - Independence/self-reliance
This noun or suru-verb refers to being independent, whether financially, emotionally, or physically.

酢の物-
{
酢の物 (すのもの) - Vinegar-dressed dish
A combination of 酢 (vinegar) and 物 (thing/food), referring to a common Japanese side dish.

鉄板-
{
鉄板 (てっぱん) - Iron plate / A sure thing
Literally an iron (鉄) plate (板). In slang, it refers to something reliable or a "guaranteed hit" because it's solid as iron.
Memory Tip: An iron (鉄) plate (板) won't break, just like a sure-fire joke or a safe bet.
Example: この芸人のネタは鉄板だ。 (このげいにんのねたはてっぱんだ。)

{
骨格 (こっかく) - Skeleton/Framework

-The framework of the plan has finally come together.

拡張 (かくちょう) - Expansion

長寿-
{
長寿 (ちょうじゅ) - Longevity

三日月-
{
三日月 (みかづき) - crescent moon
Literally 'third-day moon'. The 'tsu' (written as 'ka' here) is an archaic possessive marker.
Memory Tip: On the 'third' (三) 'day' (日) of the lunar month, the 'moon' (月) appears as a thin crescent.
Example: 夜空に三日月が出ている。 (よぞらにみかづきがでている。)

手拭い-
{
手拭い (てぬぐい) - Japanese hand towel
Literally 'hand wipe'. A traditional cotton towel with many uses. 手 (hand) + 拭い (wiping).
Memory Tip: 'Te' is hand and 'Nugui' comes from 'nuguu' (to wipe). It is the 'hand-wiper'.
Example: 手拭いで汗を拭いた。 (てぬぐいであせをふいた。)
-I wiped away sweat with a hand towel.

原型 (げんけい) - prototype; original form

楽譜 (がくふ) - Sheet music, musical score

児童-

直接的 (ちょくせつてき) - Direct
This word combines 直接 (direct) with the suffix 的 (-ish/-like) to form a na-adjective describing straightforward methods or causes.

涼む-
{
涼む (すずむ) - To cool oneself; to enjoy the cool air
An intransitive godan verb used for the action of seeking out a cool breeze or shade to escape the heat.

原作-
{
原作 (げんさく) - Original work
Refers to the original source material (such as a novel or manga) upon which a film, play, or anime is based. It combines "origin" (原) and "work" (作).

原爆 (げんばく) - Atomic bomb

{

This noun combines "slender/fine" and "fungus/germ" to describe microscopic organisms.
Memory Tip: Bacteria are so fine (細) that you need a microscope to see these tiny germs (菌).
Example: この病気は細菌によって引き起こされる (このびょうきはさいきんによってひきおこされる)
-This disease is caused by bacteria.
}

除外-
{
除外 (じょがい) - Exclusion
Composed of "remove" and "outside," indicating the act of leaving something out of a specific group or scope.
Memory Tip: To exclude something is to remove (除) it and place it outside (外) the circle.
Example: 彼はリストから除外された (かれはりすとからじょがいされた)
-He was excluded from the list.

車庫-
{
車庫 (しゃこ) - Garage / carport
Combines the kanji for "car" and "warehouse/storehouse," referring to the building where vehicles are kept.
Memory Tip: Think of a car (車) being stored inside a dedicated warehouse (庫) or garage.
Example: 車を車庫に入れる (くるまをしゃこにいれる)
-Put the car in the garage.

近郊-
{
近郊 (きんこう) - Suburbs / outskirts
Combines "near" and "suburbs/rural area," referring to residential areas surrounding a large city.
Memory Tip: The residential area that is near (近) the city borders (郊) represents the suburbs.
Example: 東京の近郊に住んでいる (とうきょうのきんこうにすんでいる)
-I live in the suburbs of Tokyo.

羨む-
{
羨む (うらやむ) - To envy/be jealous of
A transitive Godan verb used to express a desire for something someone else possesses or to feel jealous of their situation.
Memory Tip: The kanji combines 'eye' (目) and 'deficient' (欠); your eyes see something you lack, causing envy.
Example: 彼は友人の成功を羨んでいる。 (かれはゆうじんのせいこうをうらやんでいる。)
-He is envious of his friend's success.

応募-
{
応募 (おうぼ) - Application/subscription
A noun referring to the act of applying for a job, contest, or advertisement.
Memory Tip: Responding (応) to a recruitment or public call (募).
Example: 応募の締め切りは明日です。 (おうぼのしめきりはあしたです。)
-The application deadline is tomorrow.

散らかす-
{
散らかす (ちらかす) - To clutter/mess up
A transitive Godan verb meaning to leave things lying around or to create a mess in a space.
Memory Tip: The kanji (散) means to scatter; you are 'scattering' items all over the room.

{
応募する (おうぼする) - To apply (for)
The suru-verb form of application, used when taking the action to enter a competition or apply for a position.
Memory Tip: Doing (する) the act of responding (応) to a recruitment call (募).
Example: その仕事に応募することにした。 (そのしごとに おうぼすることにした。)
-I decided to apply for that job.

投票する (とうひょうする) - To vote

Example: 選挙で投票することは重要だ。 (せんきょでとうひょうすることはじゅうようだ。)

Combines 'saki' (ahead) and 'mawari' (going around/circling). It means to take a shortcut to arrive before someone else or to anticipate their actions.
Memory Tip: You go 'around' (mawari) the path to get to the 'front' (saki) of the target.
Example: 犯人の行き先を予測して先回りする。 (はんにんのいきさきをよそくしてさきまわりする。)
-Predict the culprit's destination and get there ahead of them.
}

逆襲-
{
逆襲 (ぎゃくしゅう) - Counterattack
Combines 'gyaku' (reverse/opposite) and 'shuu' (attack). It describes turning the tables and attacking back after being on the defensive.
Memory Tip: A 'reverse' (逆) 'attack' (襲) is a counterattack. Think of a 'Gyakuten' (turnabout) attack.
Example: 弱小チームが後半に逆襲を開始した。 (じゃくしょうチームがこうはんにぎゃくしゅうをかいしした。)
-The weak team started a counterattack in the second half.
}

Composed of 株 (stump/share) and 式 (style/type). It refers to ownership interest in a corporation.
Memory Tip: Imagine a tree stump (株) split into many formal (式) shares for investors.
Example: 株式市場が下落した。 (かぶしきしじょうがげらくした。)
-The stock market dropped.
}

逆効果-
{
逆効果 (ぎゃくこうか) - Counterproductive, opposite effect
A combination of 逆 (reverse) and 効果 (effect). It describes a situation where an action produces the opposite of the intended result.
Memory Tip: When the effect (効果) goes in reverse (逆) of what you wanted.
Example: 叱りすぎると逆効果だ。 (しかりすぎるとぎゃくこうかだ。)
-Scolding too much is counterproductive.
}

第一印象-
{
第一印象 (だいいちいんしょう) - First impression
Formed by 第一 (the first) and 印象 (impression). 印象 literally means a "stamp" (印) of an "image" (象) on the mind.
Memory Tip: The very first (第一) image (象) stamped (印) into your memory of someone.
Example: 第一印象が重要です。 (だいいちいんしょうがじゅうようです。)
-The first impression is important.
}

潜水-
{
潜水 (せんすい) - Diving / Submerging
Refers to the act of going underwater, used for humans, animals, or submarines.
Memory Tip: '潜' (submerge/hide) plus '水' (water) equals hiding or moving under the water.
Example: 彼は海に潜水した。 (かれはうみにせんすいした。)
-He dove into the sea.
}

反則-
{
反則 (はんそく) - Foul / Rule violation
Commonly used in sports and games to indicate an action that breaks established rules.
Memory Tip: '反' (against) plus '則' (rule) creates the concept of going against the rules.
Example: 彼は反則で退場になった。 (かれははんそくでたいじょうになった。)
-He was sent off for a foul.
}

外務大臣-
{
外務大臣 (がいむだいじん) - Minister for Foreign Affairs
A formal compound noun referring to the high-ranking government official managing international relations.

Example: 外務大臣が訪米した。 (がいむだいじんがほうべいした。)

卸す-
{
卸す (おろす) - To sell wholesale
This transitive verb describes the action of a wholesaler supplying goods to a retailer. It implies a bulk transfer of goods at a lower price point.
Memory Tip: The kanji 卸 shows a 'stop' 止 and a 'kneeling person' 卩; imagine a delivery person stopping to unload bulk items.
Example: 問屋が小売店に商品を卸す。 (どんやがこうりてんにしょうひんをおろす。)
-The wholesaler sells goods to the retail store.
}

疎遠-
{
疎遠 (そえん) - Estrangement / Drifting apart
A noun/Na-adjective used to describe a relationship that has cooled or where contact has ceased over time. It can be used for friends or family.
Memory Tip: 疎 (sparse/alienate) + 遠 (far). When contact becomes sparse, the hearts become far apart.
Example: 卒業してから彼とは疎遠になった。 (そつぎょうしてからかれとはそえんになった。)
-I've drifted apart from him since graduation.

独裁-
{
独裁 (どくさい) - Dictatorship/Autocracy

{
洗脳 (せんのう) - Brainwashing

逃亡者-
{
逃亡者 (とうぼうしゃ) - fugitive / runaway
A noun composed of 'escape' (逃), 'flee' (亡), and 'person' (者).

Example: 警察が逃亡者を追跡している。 (けいさつがとうぼうしゃをついせきしている)
-The police are tracking the fugitive.

盗品-
{
盗品 (とうひん) - Stolen goods/Loot
A compound noun consisting of 盗 (to steal) and 品 (article/item).
Memory Tip: 'Tou' sounds like the start of 'took'—items that were 'took' (stolen) are 'Hin' (goods).
Example: 警察は盗品を回収した。(けいさつは とうひんを かいしゅうした。)

原子力-
{
原子力 (げんしりょく) - Atomic energy / Nuclear power
This term combines 原子 (atom) with 力 (power or energy).

Example: 原子力発電所を見学した。 (げんしりょくはつでんしょをけんがくした。)

自爆-
{
自爆 (じばく) - Self-destruction
Compound noun or suru-verb formed by 自 (self) and 爆 (explode/bomb).

必須-
{
必須 (ひっす) - essential, required, mandatory
A noun often used as a prefix or modifier (e.g., 必須項目) to denote something that is absolutely necessary.

価-

価 (あたい) - value, price, worth

Example: それは一見の価がある。 (それはいっけんのあたいがある。)

既存-

書評-
{
書評 (しょひょう) - Book review
A compound of 'book/write' (書) and 'evaluate/criticize' (評). It refers specifically to a critical review or assessment of a literary work.
Memory Tip: It is the 'evaluation' (評) of a 'written book' (書).
Example: 新聞でその本の書評を読んだ。 (しんぶんでそのほんのしょひょうをよんだ。)
-I read a review of that book in the newspaper.
}

微生物-
{
微生物 (びせいぶつ) - Microorganism, microbe
A scientific term combining 'tiny/micro' (微), 'living/life' (生), and 'thing/object' (物).
Memory Tip: Focus on 'micro' (微) as the key descriptor for these 'living things' (生物).
Example: 土の中には多くの微生物がいる。 (つちのなかにはおおくのびせいぶつがいる。)
-There are many microorganisms in the soil.
}

歌謡曲-
{
歌謡曲 (かようきょく) - Popular song / Showa-era pop
Refers specifically to a genre of Japanese popular music that flourished during the Showa period.
Memory Tip: Combine 歌 (song), 謡 (ballad), and 曲 (musical piece/track).
Example: 祖父は歌謡曲が大好きだ。(そふはかようきょくがだいすきだ。)
-My grandfather loves Showa-era pop songs.
}

触角-
{
触角 (しょっかく) - Antenna/Feeler
Composed of 'shoku' (touch) and 'kaku' (horn), referring to the sensory organs of insects.
Memory Tip: An insect's horn (角) that it uses to touch (触) and sense its surroundings.
Example: 蝶が触角を動かしている。 (ちょうがしょっかくをうごかしている。)
-The butterfly is moving its antennae.
}

編者-
{
編者 (へんしゃ) - Editor, compiler
This word combines 編 (edit/weave) and 者 (person), referring to someone who organizes or compiles text or data into a finished work.
Memory Tip: Think of a person (者) who weaves (編) different threads of information together into a book.
Example: 彼はその事典の編者の一人だ。 (かれはそのじてんのへんしゃのひとりだ。)
-He is one of the editors of that encyclopedia.
}

一人称-
{
一人称 (いちにんしょう) - First person (grammar)
Literally 'one-person-title.' It refers to grammatical perspectives like 'I' or 'we.'
Memory Tip: The title (称) used for the one (一) person (人) who is currently speaking.
Example: 彼は一人称に「僕」を使っている。 (かれはいちにんしょうに「ぼく」をつかっている。)
-He uses 'boku' as his first-person pronoun.
}

晩酌-
{
晩酌 (ばんしゃく) - An evening drink
Composed of 晩 (evening) and 酌 (serving/drinking alcohol). It specifically refers to having a drink with dinner at home.
Memory Tip: Pouring (酌) a drink for yourself in the evening (晩) after a long day.
Example: 父は毎日の晩酌を欠かさない。 (ちちはまいにちのばんしゃくをかかさない。)
-My father never misses his daily evening drink.
}

何遍-
{
何遍 (なんべん) - How many times, how often
A casual or emphatic alternative to 'nankai', often used in spoken Japanese to express frustration or frequency. 'Hen' (遍) refers to a cycle or occurrence.
Memory Tip: 'What' (何) + 'number of times' (遍). Think of it as 'how many laps' through a cycle.
Example: 何遍言ったらわかるの？ (なんべんいったらわかるの？)
-How many times do I have to tell you before you understand?
}

紛れ-
{
紛れ (まぎれ) - Confusion, diversion, distraction
This is the noun form of the verb 紛れる (magireru), often used in phrases like 'in the confusion of...'.
Memory Tip: The kanji combines 'thread' (糸) and 'divide' (分) to suggest threads becoming entangled and hard to distinguish.
Example: どさくさに紛れ、彼は逃げた。(どさくさにまぎれ、かれはにげた。)
-In the confusion of the moment, he escaped.
}

急増-
{
急増 (きゅうぞう) - Rapid increase
Composed of 急 (sudden/hurry) and 増 (increase/add).
Memory Tip: Think of a 'sudden' (急) 'growth' (増) in numbers, like a spike on a graph.
Example: 観光客が急増している。(かんこうきゃくがきゅうぞうしている。)
-The number of tourists is rapidly increasing.
}

言葉つき-
{
言葉つき (ことばつき) - Way of speaking, diction
Combines 言葉 (words) with the suffix 〜つき (manner/appearance).
Memory Tip: Think of it as the 'manner' (つき) that comes 'attached' to one's words.
Example: 彼女の言葉つきはとても丁寧だ。(かのじょのことばつきはとてもていねいだ。)
-Her way of speaking is very polite.
}

膝小僧-
{
膝小僧 (ひざこぞう) - Kneecap, knee
A colloquial term combining knee (膝) and little priest/youngster (小僧).
Memory Tip: Your round kneecap looks like the smooth, bald head of a little boy priest (小僧).
Example: 膝小僧を擦りむいた。 (ひざこぞうをすりむいた。)
-I scraped my knee.
}

握力-
{
握力 (あくりょく) - Grip strength
A literal compound of 'to grip/grasp' (握) and 'power/strength' (力).
Memory Tip: The kanji 握 contains the 'hand' radical on the left, emphasizing it's hand power.
Example: 彼は握力が非常に強い。 (かれはあくりょくがひじょうにつよい。)
-He has a very strong grip.
}

朗報-
{
朗報 (ろうほう) - Good news / Glad tidings
A formal and positive word for a welcome report or joyful information.
Memory Tip: A bright and clear (朗) report (報).
Example: ついに朗報が舞い込んだ。(ついにろうほうがまいこんだ)
-Finally, some good news has arrived.
}

来賓-
{
来賓 (らいひん) - guest, visitor
A formal word used to describe guests of honor or dignitaries attending an official event or ceremony.
Memory Tip: 来 (come) + 賓 (honored guest). A VIP guest who has 'come' to attend the event.
Example: 来賓が次々に到着した。 (らいひんがつぎつぎにとうちゃくした。)
-The guests of honor arrived one after another.
}

独創-
{
独創 (どくそう) - originality, creative
This noun refers to the capacity to create something entirely new and unique without imitating others.
Memory Tip: 独 (alone/original) + 創 (create). The act of creating something unique all by yourself.
Example: 彼の作品には独創がある。 (かれのさくひんにはどくそうがある。)
-There is originality in his work.
}

模擬-
{
模擬 (もぎ) - Mock, simulation
A noun or "no-adjective" used to describe trials or imitations. Often seen in 模擬試験 (mock exam).
Memory Tip: Both kanji involve imitation; 模 (model) and 擬 (mimic). Think of a "model mimic" of the real thing.
Example: 今日は模擬試験を受けた。 (きょうはもぎしけんをうけた。)
-I took a mock exam today.
}

悪影響-
{
悪影響 (あくえいきょう) - Bad influence, harmful effect
A combination of 悪 (bad) and 影響 (influence/impact). It is used to describe negative consequences or side effects.
Memory Tip: Aku (悪) is evil, and Eikyou (影響) is impact; together they make a bad influence.
Example: 子供に悪影響を与える。(こどもにあくえいきょうをあたえる。)
-To have a bad influence on children.
}

節々-
{
節々 (ふしぶし) - Joints / Points
Refers to physical body joints or specific points and parts of a conversation or argument.
Memory Tip: The kanji for 'node' (節) is doubled (々) to represent the many joints in a body or bamboo stalk.
Example: 風邪で体の節々が痛む。 (かぜでからだのふしぶしがいたむ。)
-My joints ache because of a cold.
}

便秘-
{
便秘 (べんぴ) - Constipation
This noun combines stool (便) with the idea of being hidden or secret (秘), indicating difficulty passing waste.
Memory Tip: Your stool (便) is a secret (秘) hidden away because it can't come out.
Example: 便秘で苦しんでいる。 (べんぴでくるしんでいる。)
-I am suffering from constipation.
}

新芽-
{
新芽 (しんめ) - New bud / sprout
A common word for young plant growth, combining 'new' (新) and 'bud' (芽).
Memory Tip: The very first new (新) growth (芽) you see appearing on a plant in spring.
Example: 木々に新芽が出てきた。 (きぎにしんめがでてきた。)
-New buds have appeared on the trees.
}

時限-
{
時限 (じげん) - Time limit / Period
Combination of 時 (time) and 限 (limit). It often refers to a specific time slot or class period in schools.
Memory Tip: Think of a clock (時) setting a hard boundary (限) on when you must stop.
Example: １時限目の授業は数学です。 (いちじげんめのじゅぎょうはすうがくです。)
-The first period class is math.
}

本塁打-
{
本塁打 (ほんるいだ) - Home run
A baseball term combining "main" (本), "base/fortress" (塁), and "strike/hit" (打).
Memory Tip: A hit (打) that circles back to the home (本) base (塁).
Example: 彼は逆転本塁打を放った。 (かれはぎゃくてんほんるいだをはなった。)
-He hit a come-from-behind home run.
}

全景-
{
全景 (ぜんけい) - Panorama/complete view
Combines 全 (all/whole) and 景 (scene/view) to describe a scene captured in its entirety from a single point.
Memory Tip: A view (景) of everything (全) is a panorama.
Example: 山頂から街の全景が見渡せる。 (さんちょうからまちのぜんけいがみわたせる。)
-A panoramic view of the town can be seen from the mountain top.
}

為替-
{
為替 (かわせ) - Foreign exchange
A method of settling payments or exchanging currency without moving physical cash.
Memory Tip: Doing (為) an exchange (替) of currency values.
Example: 為替レートが円高になった。(かわせれーとがえんだかになった。)
-The exchange rate shifted toward a strong yen.
}

庶民的-
{
庶民的 (しょみんてき) - Common / Down-to-earth
Describes something that is affordable, popular, or characteristic of ordinary people.
Memory Tip: Like (的) the common (庶) people (民).
Example: その店は庶民的な味で人気だ。(そのみせはしょみんてきなあじでにんきだ。)
-That shop is popular for its down-to-earth taste.
}

絶景-
{
絶景 (ぜっけい) - Superb view, picturesque scenery
Combines 絶 (surpassing/extreme) and 景 (scene). It describes a view so beautiful it is beyond compare.
Memory Tip: A scene (景) that is so great it cuts off (絶) all competition from other views.
Example: 山頂からの絶景に感動した。 (さんちょうからのぜっけいにかんどうした。)
-I was moved by the superb view from the mountain top.
}

悪循環-
{
悪循環 (あくじゅんかん) - Vicious circle, downward spiral
Combines 悪 (bad) and 循環 (circulation/cycle). It refers to a situation where one problem causes another, which makes the first problem worse.
Memory Tip: A bad (悪) cycle (循環) that keeps spinning you deeper into trouble.
Example: ストレスで眠れず、悪循環に陥る。 (すとれすでねむれず、あくじゅんかんにおちいる。)
-I can't sleep due to stress and fall into a vicious circle.
}

牧草-
{
牧草 (ぼくそう) - Pasture grass
Grass specifically grown for feeding livestock. It combines 'Boku' (pasture/herding) and 'Sou' (grass).
Memory Tip: Grass (草) found in the pasture (牧).
Example: 牛が牧草を食べている。(うしがぼくそうをたべている。)
-The cows are eating pasture grass.
}

冬至-
{
冬至 (とうじ) - Winter solstice
The day with the shortest daylight and longest night of the year. 'Tou' (winter) + 'Ji' (arrival/extreme).
Memory Tip: When winter (冬) reaches its extreme point (至).
Example: 冬至にはかぼちゃを食べる習慣がある。(とうじにはかぼちゃをたべるしゅうかんがある。)
-There is a custom of eating pumpkin on the winter solstice.
}

桑畑-
{
桑畑 (くわばたけ) - Mulberry field
A compound of 桑 (mulberry) and 畑 (field). These fields were historically vital in Japan for feeding silkworms for the silk industry.
Memory Tip: Kuwa (mulberry) + Hatake (field). A field dedicated to growing mulberry trees for silk production.
Example: 以前はこの辺り一面が桑畑だった。(いぜんはこのあたりいちめんがくわばたけだった。)
-Previously, this whole area was a mulberry field.
}

A medical noun composed of three characters representing height, blood, and pressure.

年次 (ねんじ) - Annual / Yearly

稲穂-
{
稲穂 (いなほ) - ear of rice
Composed of 稲 (rice plant) and 穂 (head of grain), it refers specifically to the grain-bearing part of the plant.
Memory Tip: Visualize the heavy head (穂) of the rice (稲) plant bowing down in the field.
Example: 秋風に稲穂が揺れている。 (あきかぜにいなほがゆれている。)
-The ears of rice are swaying in the autumn breeze.

清涼-
{
清涼 (せいりょう) - cool and refreshing
Often used as a na-adjective or in compounds like 清涼飲料水 (soft drinks) to describe a crisp coolness.
Memory Tip: Combining 清 (pure) and 涼 (cool) creates an image of crystal clear, cold water.
Example: 高原の清涼な空気を吸い込む。 (こうげんのせいりょうなくうきをすいこむ。)
-I inhale the cool, refreshing air of the plateau.

銅山-
{
銅山 (どうざん) - copper mine
Combines 銅 (dō, copper) and 山 (zan/yama, mountain).
Memory Tip: A mountain (山) full of copper (銅). Think of the 'Do' in 'Dō-medal' (bronze/copper).
Example: その銅山は数十年前に閉鎖された。 (そのどうざんはすうじゅうねんまえにへいさされた。)

節目-
{
節目 (ふしめ) - turning point, milestone
Combines 節 (fushi, joint/knot) and 目 (me, eye/mark), originally referring to bamboo joints.
Memory Tip: The 'eye' or mark of a 'joint' in bamboo, which marks a distinct new section or stage of growth.
Example: 二十歳は人生の大きな節目だ。 (はたちはじんせいのおおきなふしめだ。)
-Turning twenty is a major milestone in one's life.

上巻-
{
上巻 (じょうかん) - First volume
Refers to the first book in a two or three-volume set, typically followed by 中巻 (middle) or 下巻 (last).
Memory Tip: The 'top' (上) 'scroll/volume' (巻) is the one you must read first.
Example: この小説は上巻と下巻に分かれている。 (このしょうせつはじょうかんとげかんにわかれている。)
-This novel is divided into the first and second volumes.

感嘆符-
{
感嘆符 (かんたんふ) - Exclamation mark
A formal term for the '!' punctuation mark. It consists of 'emotion', 'gasp/sigh', and 'mark'.

敷金-
{
敷金 (しききん) - Security deposit
A deposit paid by a tenant to a landlord when renting an apartment. 'Spread/Lay' (敷) + 'Money' (金).

仏教徒-

国柄 (くにがら) - national character; nature of a country

国債-
{
国債 (こくさい) - Government bond
Noun. Formed by 国 (country) and 債 (debt/bond).

-Many people are purchasing government bonds.

私財-
{
私財 (しざい) - Private property, personal fortune
Noun. Refers to assets owned by an individual (私) rather than a group or the public.
Memory Tip: Personal (私) wealth/assets (財).
Example: 彼は私財を投じて図書館を建てた (かれはしざいをとうじてとしょかんをたてた)
-He spent his personal fortune to build a library.

大腸-
{
大腸 (だいちょう) - Large intestine
A anatomical noun combining 大 (large) and 腸 (intestine). It refers to the final portion of the digestive tract.
Memory Tip: Think of the "large" (大) tube that follows the small intestine in your "guts" (腸).
Example: 大腸の健康を保つ。(だいちょうのけんこうをたもつ)
-Maintain the health of the large intestine.

襟巻き-
{
襟巻き (えりまき) - Scarf
A compound of "collar" (襟) and "wrapping" (巻き). While "muffler" is more common in modern Japanese, this is a classic term for a neck wrap.
Memory Tip: An item you wrap (巻き) around your collar (襟) to keep your neck warm.
Example: 祖母は手編みの襟巻きをくれた。 (そぼはてあみのえりまきをくれた。)
-My grandmother gave me a hand-knitted scarf.

脂身-
{
脂身 (あぶらみ) - Fat (on meat)
This word refers specifically to the fatty part of meat, often seen as white sections on cuts like pork.
Memory Tip: The body (身) part that consists purely of animal fat (脂).
Example: 豚肉の脂身は甘い。(ぶたにくのあぶらみはあまい)
-The fat on pork is sweet.
}

敵役-
{
敵役 (katakiyaku) - Villain / Antagonist
Originally from Kabuki, it refers to the role of an enemy or bad guy in a story.
Memory Tip: The role (役) played by the enemy (敵).

-He played the villain's role perfectly.

湧水-
{
湧水 (ゆうすい) - Spring water
Formed by 湧 (to gush/well up) and 水 (water).

-There is spring water in this park.

欄外-

欄外 (らんがい) - Margin
Combines 欄 (column/blank/section) and 外 (outside).

暫定-
{
暫定 (ざんてい) - Provisional, temporary, tentative
Often used in formal or administrative contexts to describe measures or results that are not yet final.
Memory Tip: 暫 means "a short while" and 定 means "fixed." It is fixed only for a short while.
Example: 暫定的なスケジュールを発表する。 (ざんていてきなすけじゅーるをはっぴょうする。)

耐熱-
{
耐熱 (たいねつ) - Heat-resistant
Combines the kanji for endure (耐) and heat (熱). It describes materials designed to withstand high temperatures.
Memory Tip: Think of an object that can 'endure' (耐) the 'heat' (熱).

鉱業-
{
鉱業 (こうぎょう) - Mining industry
Formed by 'mineral/ore' (鉱) and 'industry/business' (業). It refers to the extraction of valuable minerals.

国益-
{
国益 (こくえき) - National interest
A formal compound noun joining '国' (country) and '益' (benefit/profit).

公示-

公示 (こうじ) - Public notice / Official announcement
A formal noun used primarily for official government or legal notifications to the public.

消化不良-

消化不良 (しょうかふりょう) - Indigestion
A four-kanji compound (yojijukugo) where 'digestion' (消化) is described as being 'bad or poor' (不良).
Memory Tip: If your 'digestion' (消化) is 'not good' (不良), you end up with a stomachache.
Example: 食べ過ぎて消化不良になった。 (たべすぎてしょうかふりょうになった。)

殺菌-

殺菌 (さっきん) - Sterilization / Disinfection

傷者-
{
傷者 (しょうしゃ) - injured person
A formal noun combining "wound/injury" (傷) and "person" (者).

甘党-

甘党 (あまとう) - Sweet tooth
Literally translated as the "sweet party," used for someone who loves sweets over alcohol.

御札-

Refers to paper charms from shrines meant for protection, or more generally to paper bills. It uses the honorific 'Go/O' (御) and 'tag/slip' (札).

投げ付ける-

投げ付ける (なげつける) - To throw at, to pelt
A compound verb combining 投げる (to throw) and 付ける (to attach/hit). It implies throwing something with force specifically to hit a target.
Memory Tip: You throw (nage) something so it "sticks" (tsukeru) to the target.

回数券-

回数券 (かいすうけん) - Book of tickets, commuter pass tickets

全壊-
{
全壊 (ぜんかい) - Complete destruction
This compound combines 全 (all) and 壊 (break). It specifically refers to buildings or structures being totally leveled or destroyed, often by natural disasters.
Memory Tip: 全 (all) + 壊 (broken). When the whole building is broken to pieces, it is 全壊.

脱字-

脱字 (だつじ) - Omitted character, missing word

油彩 (ゆさい) - Oil painting

一斤 (いっきん) - one loaf (of bread)

鯨肉-

鯨肉 (げいにく) - whale meat
Combines 鯨 (whale) and 肉 (meat). The character for whale contains the fish radical (魚).

Consists of 'most' (最) and 'deep' (深), used to denote the maximum depth of something like water or snow.

This noun/adverb describes an interval where one month is skipped between occurrences. It combines the kanji for 'distance/separate' and 'month'.

洗浄剤-

洗浄剤 (せんじょうざい) - Cleaning agent / Detergent
A compound of 洗浄 (washing/purification) and 剤 (chemical agent/medicine), often used for industrial or specialized cleaning liquids.

脇見-

脇見 (わきみ) - Looking aside / Looking away

A specific type of Keigo (honorifics) used to show respect toward the actions, status, or belongings of the person one is speaking to or about.

Example: 尊敬語を正しく使うのは難しい。 (そんけいごをただしくつかうのはむずかしい。)

惜しまない-
{
惜しまない (おしまない) - To not spare / To be unstinting
The negative form of the verb 'oshimu' (to grudge/regret). It is commonly used with 'effort' or 'cooperation' to show full dedication.
Memory Tip: 惜 (regret/be stingy) + ない (not). Not being stingy with one's resources or effort.

-He does not spare any effort.

謙譲語-
{
謙譲語 (けんじょうご) - Humble language
A specific category of Japanese honorifics (keigo) used to lower oneself or one's group to show respect to the listener.
Memory Tip: It is the 'language' (語) used for 'humility' (謙) and 'yielding/conceding' (譲) one's own status.

年代順-
{
年代順 (ねんだいじゅん) - Chronological order
Formed by 'era/period' (年代) and 'order/sequence' (順).
