遂行 (すいこう) - Accomplishment, execution, carrying out
Combines 遂 (attain/accomplish) and 行 (go/do). Used for the formal execution of a task or mission.
Memory Tip: You go (行) all the way until you attain (遂) your goal.
Example: 彼は与えられた任務を遂行した。 (かれはあたえられたにんむをすいこうした。)
-He carried out the mission he was given.
}

巧い-
{
巧い (うまい) - Skillful, clever, expert
Features the character 巧, which means adroit or ingenuity. It specifically highlights craftsmanship or technical skill.
Memory Tip: The radical for work (工) is inside 巧, signifying skillful work.
Example: 彼は料理の作り方が巧い。 (かれはりょうりのつくりかたがうまい。)
-He is skillful at cooking.
}

魔王-
{
魔王 (まおう) - Demon King
A noun often used in fantasy, combining 'demon/magic' (魔) and 'king' (王).
Memory Tip: The king (王) who rules over all things magical and demonic (魔).
Example: 勇者が魔王を倒した。 (ゆうしゃがまおうをたおした)
-The hero defeated the demon king.
}

隅々-
{
隅々 (すみずみ) - Every nook and cranny
A noun formed by repeating 'corner' (隅). The iteration mark (々) indicates the plural/extensive nature of the word.
Memory Tip: Not just one corner (隅), but every corner-corner (隅々) of the room.
Example: 部屋の隅々まで掃除する。 (へやのすみずみまでそうじする)
-Clean every corner of the room.
}

石垣-
{
石垣 (いしがき) - Stone wall
A compound noun referring specifically to walls made of stone, common in Japanese castle architecture.
Memory Tip: A fence or wall (垣) constructed entirely out of stones (石).
Example: お城の石垣はとても高い。 (おしろのいしがきはとてもたかい)
-The stone walls of the castle are very high.
}

想定-
{
想定 (そうてい) - Assumption/Hypothesis
This noun combines 'conception' and 'fix,' referring to a pre-determined scenario or assumption used in formal planning.
Memory Tip: You 'think' (想) of a scenario and 'fix' (定) it as your base premise.
Example: 最悪の事態を想定する。(さいあくのじたいをそうていする。)
-Assume the worst-case scenario.
}

欲求-
{
欲求 (よっきゅう) - Desire/Urge
Formed by 'greed' and 'request,' it refers to physiological or psychological needs. It is more academic and formal than 'hoshii.'
Memory Tip: A strong 'desire' (欲) that leads you to 'seek' (求) or request satisfaction.
Example: 睡眠の欲求を抑える。(すいみんのよっきゅうをおさえる。)
-Suppress the urge to sleep.
}

却って-
{
却って (かえって) - On the contrary/Instead
An adverb used when an action leads to a result opposite to what was expected, often implying an ironic twist.
Memory Tip: Imagine a 'return' (却) to the starting point because the result flipped backwards.
Example: 薬を飲んだら却って気分が悪くなった。(くすりをのんだらかえってきぶんがわるくなった。)
-I took medicine, but on the contrary, I felt worse.
}

烏-
{
烏 (からす) - Crow/Raven
A pictograph of a bird. Unlike 'bird' (鳥), this kanji lacks the horizontal line for the eye because a crow is so black its eye is hidden.
Memory Tip: It's a 'bird' (鳥) missing the 'eye' stroke because its black feathers hide it.
Example: 烏がゴミをあさっている。(からすがごみをあさっている。)
-A crow is scavenging through the trash.
}

賑わう-
{
賑わう (にぎわう) - To be crowded/To prosper
An intransitive verb used for places bustling with people. It implies a positive, lively atmosphere of prosperity and activity.
Memory Tip: When a place is 'rich' (賑) with people, it is 'bustling' with energy.
Example: 商店街が買い物客で賑わう。(しょうてんがいがかいものきゃくでにぎわう。)
-The shopping street is bustling with shoppers.
}

遺伝子-
{
遺伝子 (いでんし) - Gene
Literal breakdown: 'bequeath' (遺) + 'transmit' (伝) + 'particle/child' (子). It refers to the biological unit of heredity.
Memory Tip: The 'particle' (子) that 'bequeaths' (遺) traits and 'transmits' (伝) them to the next generation.
Example: 遺伝子の組み換えを行う。(いでんしのくみかえをおこなう。)
-Perform gene recombination.
}

街灯-
{
街灯 (がいとう) - streetlight
This noun combines 街 (town/street) and 灯 (lamp/light).
Memory Tip: Think of a town (街) with a bright lamp (灯) standing on the corner.
Example: 街灯が道を照らしている。 (がいとうがみちをてらしている。)
-The streetlights are illuminating the road.
}

銃弾-
{
銃弾 (じゅうだん) - bullet
Composed of 銃 (gun) and 弾 (bullet/projectile/spring).
Memory Tip: A gun (銃) shoots out a dangerous round (弾).
Example: 銃弾が壁に当たった。 (じゅうだんがかべにあたった。)
-A bullet hit the wall.
}

見通し-
{
見通し (みとおし) - prospect; outlook; view
The noun form of the verb 見通す, which literally means to see through to the end.
Memory Tip: Seeing (見) all the way through (通し) the clouds to get a clear view of the future.
Example: 来期の見通しは明るい。 (らいきのみとおしはあかるい。)
-The outlook for the next term is bright.
}

滅亡-
{
滅亡 (めつぼう) - downfall; ruin; extinction
A combination of 滅 (destroy) and 亡 (perish), typically used for civilizations or species.
Memory Tip: Total destruction (滅) leads to the complete death (亡) of a kingdom.
Example: 古代文明が滅亡した。 (こだいぶんめいがめつぼうした。)
-The ancient civilization fell into ruin.
}

平穏-
{
平穏 (へいおん) - peace; tranquility; calm
Combines 平 (flat/even) and 穏 (calm/gentle) to describe a stable, peaceful state.
Memory Tip: A flat (平) surface is calm and gentle (穏), much like a peaceful life without ups and downs.
Example: 平穏な日々が続いている。 (へいおんなひびがつづいている。)
-Peaceful days are continuing.
}

腹立つ-
{
腹立つ (はらだつ) - to get angry; to take offense
A compound verb literally meaning your "stomach (腹) stands up (立つ)."
Memory Tip: When you are so mad, you feel your stomach (腹) rising up (立つ) in anger.
Example: 彼の態度には本当に腹立つ。 (かれのたいどにはほんとうにはらだつ。)
-I am really angry at his attitude.
}

躍る-
{
躍る (おどる) - to leap; to bound; to throb (with joy)
Specifically refers to physical leaping or the heart jumping with excitement, distinct from "dancing" (踊る).
Memory Tip: The foot (足 radical) is ready to jump (躍) with excitement.
Example: 期待に胸が躍る。 (きたいにむねがおどる。)
-My heart leaps with expectation.
}

鉛-
{
鉛 (なまり) - lead (metal)
A single kanji noun representing the heavy chemical element lead.
Memory Tip: Gold (金 radical) is replaced by a much heavier, duller metal (鉛).
Example: このパイプは鉛でできている。 (このぱいぷはなまりでできている。)
-This pipe is made of lead.
}

堕落-
{
堕落 (だらく) - Corruption, depravity, downfall
A noun or suru-verb referring to a moral decline or falling into bad habits/ruin.
Memory Tip: Both kanji 堕 (collapse) and 落 (fall) emphasize a heavy downward descent into decay.
Example: 彼は酒で生活が堕落してしまった (かれはさけでせいかつがだらくしてしまった)
-His life fell into depravity because of alcohol.
}

寛大-
{
寛大 (かんだい) - Generous, tolerant, lenient
A na-adjective describing a personality that is broad-minded and forgiving toward others.
Memory Tip: Think of having a heart that is 'relaxed/wide' (寛) and 'big' (大).
Example: 先生は私のミスに寛大だった (せんせいはわたしのみすにかんだいだった)
-The teacher was lenient toward my mistake.
}

阻む-
{
阻む (はばむ) - To block, to prevent, to obstruct
A transitive godan verb used when something hinders progress or stops a path.
Memory Tip: The radical 阝 (mound/wall) on the left of 阻 shows a physical barrier preventing movement.
Example: 厚い壁が私たちの前進を阻んだ (あついかべがわたしたちのぜんしんをはばんだ)
-A thick wall blocked our progress.
}

鯨-
{
鯨 (くじら) - Whale
A noun representing the large marine mammal, historically important in Japanese culture and cuisine.
Memory Tip: The left side is 魚 (fish) and the right side 京 (capital), thinking of it as the giant "Capital Fish."
Example: 鯨が海で泳いでいる (くじらがうみでおよいでいる)
-A whale is swimming in the sea.
}

山荘-
{
山荘 (さんそう) - Mountain villa
Refers to a cottage or lodge located in the mountains, often used for vacations.
Memory Tip: 山 (mountain) + 荘 (villa/manor). Imagine a grand manor house nestled in the peaks.
Example: 冬休みは山荘で過ごした (ふゆやすみはさんそうですごした)
-I spent the winter vacation at a mountain villa.
}

墜落-
{
墜落 (ついらく) - Crash/Fall
Usually refers to a heavy object, like an airplane, falling from a high place and crashing.
Memory Tip: 墜 (fall down) + 落 (drop). Both kanji emphasize the downward motion toward the earth.
Example: 飛行機が山に墜落した (ひこうきがやまについらくした)
-The airplane crashed into the mountain.
}

妖しい-
{
妖しい (あやしい) - Bewitching/Mysterious
Describes something with a haunting, supernatural, or dangerously seductive beauty.
Memory Tip: The kanji 妖 contains 女 (woman) and 夭 (young/die young), suggesting a ghostly or fatal charm.
Example: 妖しい光が森に漂っている (あやしいひかりがもりにはだよっている)
-A bewitching light is drifting in the forest.
}

回想-
{
回想 (かいそう) - Recollection/Flashback
The act of looking back on past events or memories.
Memory Tip: 回 (round/go back) + 想 (thought). Your thoughts are going back in time.
Example: 彼は子供時代を回想した (かれはこどもじだいをかいそうした)
-He recollected his childhood.
}

差し伸べる-
{
差し伸べる (さしのべる) - To reach out/Extend
Mostly used in the context of offering help (extending a hand).
Memory Tip: 差す (to thrust/insert) + 伸びる (to stretch). Stretching your arm out toward someone.
Example: 困っている人に手を差し伸べる (こまっているひとにてをさしのべる)
-Reach out a hand to someone in trouble.
}

潔い-
{
潔い (いさぎよい) - Gracious/Resolute/Pure
Describes an admirable attitude of admitting defeat or acting with a clean conscience.
Memory Tip: The kanji 潔 (pure/clean) represents the clarity of a person's spirit.
Example: 彼は負けを認めて潔かった (かれはまけをみとめていさぎよかった)
-He was gracious in admitting his defeat.
}

露出-
{
露出 (ろしゅつ) - Exposure
Combines 露 (expose) and 出 (out); used in photography or referring to skin exposure.
Memory Tip: Something that was hidden is now "exposed" and coming "out".
Example: 彼は露出の多い服を着ている。 (かれはろしゅつのおおいふくをきている。)
-He is wearing revealing clothes.
}

改まる-
{
改まる (あらたまる) - To be renewed/To be formal
An intransitive verb meaning to change for the better or for a situation to become formal.
Memory Tip: Radical 改 (reform) suggests an update or a "formalizing" change.
Example: 彼の態度は急に改まった。 (かれはたいどはきゅうにあらたまった。)
-His attitude suddenly became formal.
}

狙撃-
{
狙撃 (そげき) - Sniping/Shooting
Combines 狙 (aim) and 撃 (strike/shoot).
Memory Tip: To "aim" (狙) carefully before a precision "strike" (撃).
Example: 狙撃兵が目標を狙っている。 (そげきへいがもくひょうをねらっている。)
-The sniper is aiming at the target.
}

無知-
{
無知 (むち) - Ignorance
Combines 無 (not/nothing) and 知 (know).
Memory Tip: Having a state of "nothing" (無) when it comes to "knowing" (知).
Example: 自分の無知を恥じる。 (じぶんのむちをはじる。)
-I am ashamed of my ignorance.
}

砂利-
{
砂利 (じゃり) - Gravel/Pebbles
Refers to small stones used in construction or landscaping.
Memory Tip: Small bits of stone found within "sand" (砂).
Example: 道に砂利が敷いてある。 (みちにじゃりがしいてある。)
-Gravel is laid on the road.
}

鑑定-
{
鑑定 (かんてい) - Appraisal/Expert judgment
Used for determining the value of art, antiques, or evidence.
Memory Tip: "Inspecting" (鑑) and "fixing/determining" (定) the truth or value.
Example: この絵を鑑定してもらう。 (このえをかんていしてもらう。)
-I will have this painting appraised.
}

暴走-
{
暴走 (ぼうそう) - Running wild, out of control
This noun/suru-verb combines 暴 (violence/outburst) and 走 (run), referring to machinery or behavior that loses restraint.
Memory Tip: A "violent" (暴) "run" (走) results in things spinning dangerously out of control.
Example: 彼の車が暴走した。(かれのくるまがぼうそうした。)
-His car went out of control.
}

領土-
{
領土 (りょうど) - Territory, domain
Combines 領 (jurisdiction/possession) and 土 (earth/soil), specifically referring to land owned by a state or sovereign.
Memory Tip: The soil (土) that is under the jurisdiction (領) of a specific country.
Example: 領土問題を解決する。(りょうどもんだいをかいけつする。)
-To resolve a territorial dispute.
}

腐敗-
{
腐敗 (ふはい) - Corruption/Decomposition
Used for biological rot as well as social or political decay. Breakdown: 腐 (rot) + 敗 (fail/decay).
Memory Tip: When a system fails (敗) and starts to rot (腐), you get corruption.
Example: 政治の腐敗を正す。 (せいじのふはいをただす。)
-Correcting political corruption.
}

野獣-
{
野獣 (やじゅう) - Wild beast
Refers to an undomesticated, often fierce animal. Breakdown: 野 (field/wild) + 獣 (beast).
Memory Tip: A beast (獣) that roams freely in the wild (野) fields.
Example: 彼は野獣のように叫んだ。 (かれはやじゅうのようにさけんだ。)
-He screamed like a wild beast.
}

寿命-
{
寿命 (じゅみょう) - Lifespan/Life expectancy
Refers to the natural length of life for living things or the service life of objects. Breakdown: 寿 (longevity) + 命 (life).
Memory Tip: Your life (命) longevity (寿) represents your total lifespan.
Example: この電球は寿命が長い。 (このでんきゅうはじゅみょうがながい。)
-This light bulb has a long lifespan.
}

中途半端-
{
中途半端 (ちゅうとはんぱ) - Half-baked, unfinished
This Na-adjective describes a state where something is left halfway or done without full commitment. It combines the words for 'midway' and 'odd fragment'.
Memory Tip: Imagine being stuck in the 'middle' (中) of the 'road' (途) with only 'half' (半) of the 'end' (端) in sight.
Example: 中途半端な仕事はするな。 (ちゅうとはんぱなしごとはするな。)
-Don't do half-baked work.
}

臨時-
{
臨時 (りんじ) - Temporary, special, extraordinary
Often used for unplanned or specific events that deviate from the normal schedule. It uses 'confront' (臨) and 'time' (時).
Memory Tip: Think of 'facing' (臨) a specific 'time' (時) that is not part of the daily routine, like a pop-up shop.
Example: 臨時休業のお知らせ。 (りんじきゅうぎょうのおしらせ。)
-Notice of temporary closure.
}

相互-
{
相互 (そうご) - Mutual, reciprocal
A noun/no-adjective indicating an action or feeling that goes both ways between two parties. Both kanji mean 'mutual'.
Memory Tip: Two people 'looking' (相) at each other through a 'reciprocal' (互) gate.
Example: 相互理解が重要だ。 (そうごりかいがじゅうようだ。)
-Mutual understanding is important.
}

供給-
{
供給 (きょうきゅう) - Supply, provision
Used in economic contexts or for providing necessities. It combines 'offer' (供) and 'grant/pay' (給).
Memory Tip: 'Offering' (供) goods to 'pay' (給) or satisfy the needs of the public.
Example: 需要と供給のバランス。 (じゅようときょうきゅうのバランス。)
-The balance of demand and supply.
}

連日-
{
連日 (れんじつ) - Day after day / for several days in a row
This noun combines 連 (to lead/connect) and 日 (day), describing an unbroken sequence of days.
Memory Tip: Think of connecting (連) one day (日) to the next in a continuous chain.
Example: 連日の猛暑で体が疲れています。 (れんじつのもうしょでからだがつかれています。)
-I am exhausted from the intense heat continuing day after day.
}

詐欺-
{
詐欺 (さぎ) - Fraud, scam, swindle
Consists of 詐 (lie/deceive) and 欺 (delude). It is a common term for financial or deceptive crimes.
Memory Tip: It sounds like 'saggy'; a scam makes your bank account look 'saggy' and empty.
Example: 彼は振り込め詐欺の被害に遭った。 (かれはふりこめさぎのひがいにあった。)
-He fell victim to a wire transfer scam.
}

激怒-
{
激怒 (げきど) - Rage / fury
A noun or Suru-verb indicating intense, violent anger. '激' means violent/intense and '怒' means anger.
Memory Tip: Anger (怒) that has become violent and extreme (激).
Example: 彼は嘘をつかれて激怒した。 (かれはうそをつかれてげきどした。)
-He was enraged at being lied to.
}

生存-
{
生存 (せいぞん) - Survival / existence
A noun or Suru-verb referring to the state of continuing to live, especially in difficult circumstances. '生' means life and '存' means exist.
Memory Tip: To live (生) and continue to exist (存).
Example: 事故の生存者は一人だった。 (じこのせいぞんしゃはひとりだった。)
-There was only one survivor of the accident.
}

卑劣-
{
卑劣 (ひれつ) - Mean / cowardly / despicable
A Na-adjective describing behavior that is unfair or lacks dignity. '卑' means low/vulgar and '劣' means inferior.
Memory Tip: Behavior that is both low (卑) and inferior (劣).
Example: そんな卑劣な真似はするな。 (そんなひれつなまねはするな。)
-Don't do such a despicable thing.
}

致命的-
{
致命的 (ちめいてき) - Fatal / lethal / critical
A Na-adjective referring to something that causes death or total failure. '致' means to cause/reach, '命' means life, and '的' is a suffix making it an adjective.
Memory Tip: Something that 'reaches' (致) for your 'life' (命).
Example: 彼は致命的なミスを犯した。 (かれはちめいてきなみすをおかした。)
-He made a fatal mistake.
}

視覚-
{
視覚 (しかく) - Sense of sight; vision
Formed by 視 (inspection/vision) and 覚 (sense/perception). It refers to the physical sense of seeing.
Memory Tip: The sensation (覚) you get when you use your vision (視).
Example: 視覚は五感の一つです。 (しかくはごかんのひとつです。)
-Vision is one of the five senses.
}

頂-
{
頂 (いただき) - Top; summit; peak
Refers to the highest point of a mountain or a person's head. Related to the verb いただく (to receive).
Memory Tip: You receive (いただく) the best view from the very top (いただき).
Example: 山の頂は雲に隠れている。 (やまのいただきはくもにかかれている。)
-The mountain peak is hidden in the clouds.
}

大空-
{
大空 (おおぞら) - Heavens; firmament; big sky
Literally "big" (大) "sky" (空). Often used poetically.
Memory Tip: The vast, big (大) blue sky (空) above us.
Example: 鳥が大空を飛んでいる。 (とりがおおぞらをとんでいる。)
-Birds are flying in the vast sky.
}

劇団-
{
劇団 (げきだん) - Theatrical company; troupe
Combines 劇 (drama/play) and 団 (group/organization).
Memory Tip: A group (団) of people who perform plays (劇).
Example: 彼は劇団に所属している。 (かれはげきだんにしょぞくしている。)
-He belongs to a theatrical troupe.
}

事実上-
{
事実上 (じじつじょう) - As a matter of fact; practically; de facto
Combines 事実 (fact) and 上 (from the viewpoint of). It means something is true in practice even if not officially.
Memory Tip: Based on (上) the actual facts (事実), regardless of the rules.
Example: それは事実上の降参だ。 (それはじじつじょうのこうさんだ。)
-That is a de facto surrender.
}

浴槽-
{
浴槽 (よくそう) - Bathtub
Combines 浴 (bathe) and 槽 (tank/vat). It refers to the actual tub container.
Memory Tip: A tank (槽) specifically used for bathing (浴).
Example: 浴槽にお湯をためる。 (よくそうにおゆをためる。)
-I fill the bathtub with hot water.
}

境界-
{
境界 (きょうかい) - Boundary; border
Combines 境 (boundary) and 界 (world/limit). It refers to the dividing line between areas.
Memory Tip: The limit (界) that marks the boundary (境) of a territory.
Example: ここが県の境界だ。 (ここがけんのきょうかいだ。)
-This is the prefectural border.
}

分裂-
{
分裂 (ぶんれつ) - Split; division; fission
Combines 分 (divide/part) and 裂 (rip/tear). Used for groups or physical cells breaking apart.
Memory Tip: To divide (分) by ripping (裂) into pieces.
Example: 党が二つに分裂した。 (とうがふたつにぶんれつした。)
-The party split into two.
}

皇太子-
{
皇太子 (こうたいし) - Crown Prince
A formal title for the heir apparent to the imperial throne.
Memory Tip: The Emperor's (皇) Great (太) Child (子) who will take the throne next.
Example: 皇太子がイギリスを訪問した。(こうたいしがイギリスをほうもんした。)
-The Crown Prince visited the UK.
}

雌-
{
雌 (めす) - female (animal)
Specifically used to denote the female gender of non-human animals.
Memory Tip: The radical on the left is used in ancient characters for 'female' or 'mother'.
Example: 雌のライオンが狩りをする。(めすのライオンがかりをする。)
-The female lion does the hunting.
}

不器用-
{
不器用 (ぶきよう) - clumsy/unskillful
A Na-adjective describing someone who lacks manual dexterity or social tact.
Memory Tip: Not (不) good at using tools (器用), implying a lack of skill.
Example: 私は不器用で料理が苦手だ。(わたしはぶきようでりょうりがにがてだ。)
-I am clumsy and bad at cooking.
}

理不尽-
{
理不尽 (りふじん) - unreasonable/unjust
Describes something that goes against reason or fairness.
Memory Tip: A situation where reason (理) is not (不) allowed to reach its end (尽).
Example: 理不尽な要求を断る。(りふじんなようきゅうをことわる。)
-Refuse an unreasonable demand.
}

哀れむ-
{
哀れむ (あわれむ) - to pity/feel compassion
A verb used to express sympathy or sorrow for someone's unfortunate state.
Memory Tip: Feeling the sorrow (哀) of someone else in your heart.
Example: 彼は捨て猫を哀れんだ。(かれはすてねこをあわれんだ。)
-He felt pity for the abandoned cat.
}

浦-
{
浦 (うら) - inlet/bay
Often used in coastal place names to denote a small bay or seashore.
Memory Tip: Water radical plus a field (甫), suggesting water near the land.
Example: 三浦半島は美しい。(みうらはんとうはうつくしい。)
-The Miura Peninsula is beautiful.

喪失-
{
喪失 (そうしつ) - loss/forfeiture
A formal term for losing something important, like rights, memory, or a loved one.

Example: 記憶を喪失してしまった。(きおくをそうしつしてしまった。)
-He has lost his memory.
}

狩猟-
{
狩猟 (しゅりょう) - hunting
Refers to the act of hunting animals for food or sport.

群集-
{
群集 (ぐんしゅう) - crowd/throng
A large group of people or animals gathered together in one place.

粗い-
{
粗い (あらい) - rough, coarse
Used to describe physical textures or work that is not delicate or precise.

出所-
{
出所 (しゅっしょ) - source, origin
Commonly used for the origin of information, rumors, or someone being released from prison.

茎-
{
茎 (くき) - stem, stalk
Refers to the main body or stalk of a plant or flower.
Memory Tip: The grass radical (艹) on top of 圣 (holy/ground). It's the part of the grass that rises from the ground.
Example: 花の茎を折る。 (はなのくきをおる。) - To break the stem of a flower.

奥深い-
{
奥深い (おくぶかい) - profound, deep
Describes something that has great depth, either physically or intellectually/spiritually.
Memory Tip: 奥 (inner/interior) + 深い (deep). It means going deep into the inner parts of a subject or place.
Example: この言葉は意味が奥深い。 (このことばはいみがおくぶかい。) - This word has a profound meaning.

膨大-
{
膨大 (ぼうだい) - enormous, huge
Describes a massive quantity or scale, often used for data, debt, or energy.
Memory Tip: 膨 (swell/expand) + 大 (big). Something that has swollen to a very large size.

桟橋-
{
桟橋 (さんばし) - pier, wharf
A structure built out from the shore into the water for boats to dock.

地価-
{
地価 (ちか) - land prices
A compound word referring to the market value of land.
Memory Tip: 地 (ground/land) + 価 (value/price). Simple combination of land and price.
Example: 都心の地価が上昇している。 (としんのちかがじょうしょうしている。) - Land prices in the city center are rising.

織る-
{
織る (おる) - to weave
To interlace threads to create fabric.
Memory Tip: The left side is 糸 (thread). You use thread to 'weave' together complicated patterns.
Example: 伝統的な手法で布を織る。 (でんとうてきなしゅほうでぬのをおる。) - To weave cloth using traditional methods.

腸-
{
腸 (ちょう) - intestines, bowels
The part of the digestive system that absorbs nutrients.
Memory Tip: The left radical is 月 (flesh/body part). The right side looks like the complicated internal pipes of the belly.
Example: 腸の調子を整える。 (ちょうのちょうしをととのえる。) - To improve the condition of one's intestines.
}

未熟-
{
未熟 (みじゅく) - inexperienced, immature
Literally 'not yet ripe'; used for fruit or a person's skill level.

繁栄-
{
繁栄 (はんえい) - prosperity

乳首-
{
乳首 (ちくび) - nipple
乳 (milk/breast) and 首 (neck/head). It refers to the anatomical nipple.

静止-

静止 (せいし) - stillness, rest

哲学者-
{
哲学者 (てつがくしゃ) - philosopher
哲学 (philosophy) plus 者 (person). It literally means a person who practices philosophy.

偏見-
{
偏見 (へんけん) - prejudice, bias
偏 (lean/partial) and 見 (view). It refers to a one-sided or prejudiced opinion.

及ぼす-
{
及ぼす (およぼす) - to exert, to cause
A transitive verb often used with 影響 (influence) to show an effect reaching a target.

魚雷-
{
魚雷 (ぎょらい) - torpedo
魚 (fish) and 雷 (thunder). An underwater weapon that moves like a fish.
Memory Tip: An underwater "fish" (魚) that carries the boom of "thunder" (雷).
Example: 潜水艦が魚雷を発射した。(せんすいかんがぎょらいをはっしゃした。)
-The submarine fired a torpedo.

初版-
{
初版 (しょはん) - first edition
初 (first) and 版 (printing block/edition). The very first release of a publication.

Example: その本の初版は貴重だ。(そのほんのしょはんはきちょうだ。)
-The first edition of that book is valuable.

全裸-
{
全裸 (ぜんら) - Stark naked / Complete nudity
Combines 'whole/all' (全) and 'naked' (裸). It emphasizes a state of being completely without clothes.

Example: 彼は全裸で泳いだ。 (かれはぜんらでおよいだ。)

妥協-
{

A noun describing the act of settling a dispute by mutual concession.

-There is no room for compromise.

妥協する-
{
妥協する (だきょうする) - To compromise
The verbal form created by adding the auxiliary verb 'suru' to the noun 'dakyou'.

-He never compromises.

潜水艦-

潜水艦 (せんすいかん) - Submarine

盲目-
{
盲目 (もうもく) - Blindness, blind

意欲-
{
意欲 (いよく) - Motivation, will
A compound of 'intent' (意) and 'desire' (欲), expressing a proactive drive or ambition.

現役-

現役 (げんえき) - Active duty / Current student

過剰-
{
過剰 (かじょう) - Excess / Over-
A na-adjective meaning surplus or more than needed. It combines 過 (surpass/exceed) and 剰 (surplus).

放射-

放射 (ほうしゃ) - Radiation/Emission
This noun/suru-verb refers to energy or light radiating outwards from a central point. It is commonly used in scientific contexts.

陶器 (とうき) - Pottery / Ceramics

奇襲-
{
奇襲 (きしゅう) - Surprise attack
Composed of 'strange/unexpected' (奇) and 'attack' (襲). It refers to a military tactic intended to catch an enemy off-guard.

孤児-
{
孤児 (こじ) - Orphan

画廊-

画廊 (がろう) - Art gallery

待遇-

待遇 (たいぐう) - Treatment / Working conditions

究極-

究極 (きゅうきょく) - Ultimate / Extreme
Formed by 究 (investigate/master) and 極 (pole/extreme). It refers to the final, absolute, or highest possible state.

右翼-

右翼 (うよく) - Right wing

暴力団 (ぼうりょくだん) - Gangster group / Yakuza
Combines 暴 (violent), 力 (power), and 団 (group). This is the formal legal term for organized crime syndicates in Japan.

上演-

上演 (じょうえん) - performance / staging (a play)
Formed by 上 (up/on) and 演 (performance), specifically used for theatrical plays on a stage.

壮大-

壮大 (そうだい) - magnificent / grand / epic
A na-adjective using 壮 (robust/magnificent) and 大 (big) to describe a massive scale or vision.

{
保持する (ほじする) - To maintain/hold

抑制-

抑制 (よくせい) - Control, suppression, restraint

心身-

A compound noun referring to the holistic state of a person. It is often used in health contexts.

記載-

記載 (きさい) - Mention, record, entry

野蛮-

野蛮 (やばん) - Barbaric

侵攻-

侵攻 (しんこう) - Invasion
Usually refers to a military movement into another territory with the intent of occupation or attack.

屈む-

屈む (かがむ) - To stoop / To bend down
An intransitive verb describing the physical act of lowering one's upper body or bending at the knees.

洗練-

洗練 (せんれん) - Refinement

資本-

猟-
{
猟 (りょう) - Hunting
猟 refers to the act of tracking and killing wild animals for food, sport, or pest control.

対等-
{
対等 (たいとう) - Equal / Equivalent
Describes a relationship or status where both parties are on the same level without hierarchy.
